The \$1.1B AUM in the October and November releases is value held, not volume. |
| [[issuers/ondo-global-markets\|Ondo Stocks]] (issuer, multi-venue) | Cumulative trading volume (CEX + DEX + primary mint/redeem) | \$27B; of which \$18B CEX | As of 14 Aug 2026, since the Sep 2025 launch | [Ondo PR Newswire, 14 Aug 2026](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ondo-stocks-surpasses-1-billion-in-value-as-ecosystem-surges-302852154.html) | Company-reported | No later official cumulative total was found (Ondo's 27 Oct 2026 blog updates TVL, not this volume total). An Assetera note of 7 Oct 2026 ([Assetera](https://www.assetera.com/media/assetera-x-ondo)) repeats the \$27B figure and should not be treated as a fresh October official print. Ondo's 11 May 2026 blog ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-tokenized-stocks-surpass-one-billion-tvl)) had an \$18B cumulative total at the \$1B TVL mark; that earlier overall total is not the same number as the August release's \$18B CEX subset. |

That is a narrower measure than Ondo's \$27 billion CEX+DEX+mint/redeem figure from mid-August, and the dashboard will move.

## Synthetic equity perps (not spot tokens)

These are cash-settled perpetual futures on a stock or index price. No share is held, and notionals are often leveraged, so they are not comparable to spot tokenized-stock volume and are not added to the figures above. See [[platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps|Equity perps (Hyperliquid HIP-3, Ostium)]].

Crude oil is among the six largest HIP-3 markets by volume in the same table but is not equity. |

## What we left out and why

- **Securitize's \$4.3 billion "Aggregate Transaction Volume" for Q3 2026** is defined in the 9 Nov 2026 earnings release as investments, redemptions, dividends and cross-chain movements of assets issued on Securitize's platform, not venue trading volume. The same footnote revised the Q2 2026 figure to \$4.4 billion from a previously reported \$5.3 billion. Securitize Stocks launched on 8 Oct 2026, after the quarter closed ([Securitize Q3 2026 results, 9 Nov](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx)).
- **An undated "\$47B+" transaction-volume figure on xstocks.fi**, seen on 11 Nov 2026, is not used. Dated Payward releases still said cumulative volume had passed \$45 billion as of 28 Oct and restated that mark on 11 Nov ([Payward, 28 Oct](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-surpasses-1-billion-aum), [Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)).
- **24-hour venue rankings that mix stock perps, index perps and spot tokenized stocks** (for example aggregator pages that put leveraged perp notional next to spot xStocks) are not used as wiki voice.
- **Live, undated dashboard prints** are not used as current official totals, other than the dated DefiLlama Ondo snapshot above ([DefiLlama](https://defillama.com/protocol/ondo-global-markets)). rwa.xyz monthly *transfer* volume, even if captured, would not be the same as trading volume.
- **Value held is not volume:** IMF tokenized-stock market size of about \$2.3B ([IMF GFSR Oct 2026, ch. 3](https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/publications/gfsr/2026/october/english/ch3.pdf)), Payward xStocks AUM, Ondo TVL, Bitquery holdings estimates, rwa.xyz tokenized Treasuries, and Broadridge's tokenized-repo daily settlement flow are all out of scope for this table.
- **No Kraken-only volume** was found; Payward's xStocks totals cover the wider framework.
- **No summed ranking of spot tokens plus equity perps** is given, because the units are not comparable.

*Reference information only, not legal or investment advice.*

# Tokenized stocks compared: xStocks vs Ondo vs Robinhood vs Dinari vs Securitize
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/tokenized-stocks-compared
description: Five stock-token products side by side: what you legally hold, who can buy, what you can redeem into, chains, and the main limits, with a source on every row.
type: comparison
last_checked: 2026-11-17

*Updated 17 Nov 2026.*

A token named after Apple or Nvidia can be five very different products. Among the five compared here, only Dinari dShares and Securitize Stocks give the holder a claim on the share itself; xStocks, Ondo Stocks and Robinhood Stock Tokens are issuer debt or note-style instruments that track the price without shareholder rights. Only Dinari is open to ordinary US investors today, and only xStocks and Securitize document a route out into real shares for regular holders. The table answers the practical questions in one place, and every row links to the issuer's own documents.

| Option | Best for | Cost / fees | Key strength | Key limitation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[issuers/xstocks-backed\|xStocks]] (Backed Assets (JE) Limited, Jersey) | Eligible non-US holders who want a widely listed, self-custody token on many chains | Direct issuer redemption: $5,000 minimum, fees currently 0 | Redeem for stablecoins, or in kind into an Alpaca brokerage account via xPort | A tracker certificate: no voting or other shareholder rights; not offered in the US, Canada, the UK or Australia | [xStocks FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions); [xPort](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/in-kind-flow-xport); [Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq) |
| [[issuers/ondo-global-markets\|Ondo Stocks]] (Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited) | Eligible non-US users who want the largest catalog and small tickets | Mint and redeem from $1; other fees: unknown | 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs on Ondo's registry (10 Nov 2026) | Structured notes, "not direct title" to the shares; redemption pays USDon or USDC, not a share, for ordinary users | [Ondo overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/overview); [investing and redeeming](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/investing-and-redeeming); [token registry](https://docs.ondo.finance/partner-docs/tokens) |
| [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens\|Robinhood Stock Tokens]] (Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited) | Non-US users already on Robinhood Chain or Robinhood Wallet | unknown | Transferable ERC-20 tokens; 190+ names | Debt securities with no rights in the underlying; cash only, physical delivery excluded; not US, Canada, UK or Switzerland | [Base prospectus, 25 June 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf); [Robinhood docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/) |
| [[issuers/dinari\|Dinari dShares]] (Dinari Inc. and Dinari Securities LLC, US) | Eligible US investors who want tokenized US stocks bought with USDC | unknown | Open to eligible US investors since 4 Aug 2026; cash dividends; proxy voting through Broadridge | US tokens are currently non-transferable; exit is a sale for stablecoin, with no in-kind delivery found in issuer docs | [Dinari launch](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-724-tokenized-stocks-available-to-u-s-investors-and-businesses); [US docs](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/us); [Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities) |
| [[issuers/securitize\|Securitize Stocks]] (Securitize broker-dealer) | Eligible US and EU investors who want a legal entitlement to the share | unknown | UCC Article 8 security entitlement, 1:1 backed; conversion to direct registration where available | 25 equities (2 Nov 2026), a much smaller catalog | [Securitize launch](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html); [Securitize, 2 Nov 2026](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Expands-Onchain-U-S--Stock-Offering-to-25-Equities/default.aspx) |

"Best for" describes who each product is built and documented for. It is not a recommendation.

## What should you look for in a tokenized stock?

Start with the legal claim: do you hold the share, an entitlement to it, or the issuer's own debt or note that tracks it? SEC staff draw the same line between custodial tokenized securities and synthetic ones issued by a third party ([SEC staff statement, 28 Jan 2026](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/speeches-statements/corp-fin-statement-tokenized-securities-012826-statement-tokenized-securities); [[concepts/legal-taxonomy|legal taxonomy]]).

Then check four things. Who may buy, because offshore products exclude US persons whatever app you reach them through ([[topics/who-can-buy|who can buy]]). What you can redeem into: a share, stablecoins, or only a sale on a market. How dividends arrive: cash, or a rising token multiplier ([[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]]). Which contract you hold, because the same ticker can belong to several issuers ([[comparisons/implementations-by-model#why-does-the-same-stock-have-several-tokens|same stock, different tokens]]).

## How did we compare them?

Each row uses only the issuer's own documents, prospectus or official release, as already recorded on this wiki's issuer pages and their raw snapshots; "unknown" means no fee or figure was found in those documents. Facts were last checked between 10 and 17 Nov 2026, as dated on each linked issuer page.

The five were chosen because they are the products readers most often ask about by name: whether a stock token is "a real share or an IOU", whether US residents can buy one, and why one stock has several tickers. Issuer-sponsored shares on a company's own register (for example [[issuers/superstate-opening-bell|Superstate Opening Bell]]) and venues such as [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]] are covered in [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations compared by model]].

## What do you hold with xStocks?

You hold a tracker certificate issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, not the share. The xStocks FAQ says the certificates give economic exposure but "do not convey shareholder rights, such as voting rights" ([xStocks FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions)).

After KYC, holders can redeem with the issuer for USDC, USDG or USDT, with a $5,000 minimum for the direct issuer flow and fees currently 0, or take shares in kind into an Alpaca brokerage account through xPort ([Market Flow](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/market-flow); [xPort](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/in-kind-flow-xport)). Most users exit on secondary markets instead.

Dividends show up through a multiplier rather than as cash ([multiplier docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/developers/multipliers)). Kraken's FAQ listed 131 xStocks on Solana, Ethereum, TON and Ink as of 25 Oct 2026, for eligible non-US clients, and not in the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)). Company counts in later releases differ; see the [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]] page.

## What do you hold with Ondo Stocks?

You hold a structured note from Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited, designed for economic exposure and "not direct title" to the underlying shares ([Ondo overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/overview)). Tokens use the `on` suffix, for example TSLAon.

Eligible users can mint and redeem directly with Ondo for USDon or USDC from a $1 minimum after KYC ([investing and redeeming](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/investing-and-redeeming)). Ondo also describes an in-kind conversion through Alpaca's ITN for approved institutions, which returns shares rather than cash ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-as-collateral-on-spout)).

US persons are excluded, and several markets, including the EEA, the UK and Singapore, require professional or qualified status ([legal and regulatory](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)). Ondo's registry listed 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs on 10 Nov 2026 ([token registry](https://docs.ondo.finance/partner-docs/tokens)).

## What do you hold with Robinhood Stock Tokens?

You hold a debt security issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited that gives no rights in the underlying shares ([base prospectus, 25 June 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf)). The tokens are ERC-20s on Robinhood Chain, and Robinhood advertises 190+ names ([Robinhood docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/)).

Redemption is cash only; the prospectus excludes physical delivery of the underlying. Ordinary holders generally sell on the secondary market, because direct issuer redemption applies only in limited cases, with KYC and AML checks. They are not offered in the US, Canada, the UK or Switzerland ([Robinhood docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/)).

Robinhood's separate EU Classic Stock Tokens are a different product, held inside the Robinhood app; see the [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens|Robinhood]] page.

## What do you hold with Dinari dShares?

You hold a token backed 1:1 by a share that Dinari's broker-dealer holds in custody, and eligible US investors have been able to buy since 4 Aug 2026. Dinari launched for US investors with 724 tokenized stocks ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-724-tokenized-stocks-available-to-u-s-investors-and-businesses)).

To exit, you sell or burn the token for payment tokens; the custodian sells the share, and no in-kind delivery was found in Dinari's docs ([placing orders](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/placing-orders)). US dShares are currently non-transferable, and US documentation restricts DeFi use ([US docs](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/us)).

Dividends are paid in cash, with USDC support, and eligible holders can vote the underlying shares through Broadridge's proxy process ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities)).

## What do you hold with Securitize Stocks?

You hold a UCC Article 8 security entitlement, backed 1:1 by the share, through Securitize's broker-dealer, settled in USDC on Solana ([Securitize launch](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)). That is the same kind of legal interest a regular brokerage customer holds.

Where available, holders can convert to direct registration on the company's books. On 2 Nov 2026 Securitize listed 25 equities, for eligible investors in the United States, the European Union and other permitted jurisdictions ([Securitize, 2 Nov 2026](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Expands-Onchain-U-S--Stock-Offering-to-25-Equities/default.aspx)).

Securitize also tokenizes issuer-sponsored shares for participating companies, which is a different model; see the [[issuers/securitize|Securitize]] page.

## How should you choose?

Match the product to the question you care about most, then read the issuer's own terms before buying. If shareholder rights matter, only Dinari dShares and Securitize Stocks in this table document votes or an entitlement to the share. If you are a US person, the offshore products (xStocks, Ondo Stocks, Robinhood Stock Tokens) are not offered to you, even when an app or exchange shows them.

If you want a way out into real shares, xStocks (xPort, into an Alpaca account) and Securitize (direct registration, where available) document one for regular holders. If you want the widest catalog or the smallest ticket, Ondo lists the most names and starts at $1. A regular brokerage share remains the simplest way to hold a US stock.

*Reference information only, not legal, tax or investment advice.*

## Frequently asked questions

### Is a tokenized stock a real share?

Usually not. Of the five here, xStocks, Ondo Stocks and Robinhood Stock Tokens are issuer instruments that track the price without shareholder rights, while Dinari dShares and Securitize Stocks give a claim on a share held in custody ([[concepts/legal-taxonomy|legal taxonomy]]).

### Can US residents buy tokenized stocks?

Yes, but only through US-registered routes. Dinari has offered dShares to eligible US investors since 4 Aug 2026, and Securitize Stocks are available to eligible US investors; xStocks, Ondo Stocks and Robinhood Stock Tokens exclude US persons ([[topics/who-can-buy|who can buy]]).

### Can I redeem a stock token for the actual share?

Sometimes. xStocks offers in-kind delivery into an Alpaca brokerage account through xPort, and Securitize offers conversion to direct registration where available; Ondo and Robinhood redeem for stablecoins or cash for ordinary holders, and Dinari exits by selling the share for stablecoin.

### Do tokenized stocks pay dividends?

Most reinvest them. xStocks and Robinhood raise a token multiplier, Ondo reinvests net of withholding tax, and Dinari pays cash dividends with USDC support ([[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions and dividends]]).

### Why does the same stock have several token tickers?

Each issuer mints its own token, so one stock can have several with different rights. Suffixes such as `x` (xStocks), `on` (Ondo) and `c` (Coinbase) are issuer conventions; identify a token by its contract address ([[comparisons/implementations-by-model#why-does-the-same-stock-have-several-tokens|same stock, different tokens]]).

## Sources

Issuer documents and releases linked in each row and section above; full field histories are on each linked issuer page.

# Trading venue architectures compared
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/trading-venue-architectures
description: How tokenized-stock venues are built, side by side: legal form of what trades, custody, matching design, settlement asset, chains, hours, KYC/allowlists, corporate actions and oracle, for 17 venues and platforms.
type: comparison
last_checked: 2026-11-20

*In plain English: the same tokenized stock can trade in very different ways. This table shows, venue by venue, what you actually hold, who holds the share, how orders meet and what pays for them.*

Details and sources are on each linked page; the design patterns are explained with diagrams in [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]]. `unknown` means no source checked yet. For the legal models behind each row, see [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## Matching designs at a glance
| Design | Examples | Where orders meet | Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Onchain order book | [[platforms-venues/21x\|21X]] | Smart-contract order book | Same transaction, against a stablecoin |
| Offchain match, onchain settle | [[platforms-venues/seturion\|Seturion]], [[issuers/dinari\|Dinari]] | Venue or broker systems | Onchain settlement layer |
| Permissioned AMM pool | [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv\|OKXICE TSV]], [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc\|TSV LLC]], [[platforms-venues/formation-securities\|Formation Securities]], [[infrastructure/fairmint\|Fairmint TSV]] (announced plans, not live) | Pool of allowlisted liquidity | Atomic swap in the pool |
| Issuer RFQ | JTX routing to [[issuers/ondo-global-markets\|Ondo]], [[issuers/backpack\|Backpack]], [[issuers/xstocks-backed\|xStocks]] | Quote from the issuer or its market maker | Onchain swap at the quoted price |
| P2P escrow (OTC) | Swarm open dOTC | Maker offer, taker fill | Escrow contract releases both legs |
| Perps engine | [[platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps\|HIP-3, Ostium]] | Perp order book or oracle-priced pool | Stablecoin margin, no shares |
| Exchange, same book | [[platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities\|Nasdaq]] | Existing exchange order book | DTC settlement |
| Broker-dealer ATS | [[platforms-venues/prometheum\|Prometheum]], [[issuers/securitize\|Securitize]] | Broker or ATS systems | Broker-dealer books and custody |
| Institutional RFQ plus prime broker (announced) | Talos, Marex and [[infrastructure/broadridge\|Broadridge]] DLX on [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot\|DTC]] tokenized Treasuries | Talos RFQ network | Atomic onchain settlement through the DLX orchestrator, synced to books and records ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-to-enable-institutional-trading-of-dtcc-tokenized-securities)) |

Securitize's 12 Nov 2026 comment letter on the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] asks the SEC to explicitly permit PropAMMs: AMMs that reprice onchain liquidity from an offchain model, with every swap still settling onchain, as described in Jump Crypto research the letter cites. Securitize says they are arguably already within the order's scope but should be unambiguously allowed, because they can keep TSV prices closer to the underlying stock ([Securitize](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-32/4927-1134705-4042498.pdf)). That is a comment-letter ask, not a change to the order. The Securitize Stocks row below already records a PropAMM on Solana with Jump as market maker.

## Full table
| Venue / platform | Legal form of what trades | Custody | Matching | Settlement asset | Chains | Hours | KYC / allowlist | Corporate actions | Oracle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[platforms-venues/21x\|21X]] | EU DLT financial instruments | unknown | Onchain CLOB ([21X](https://21x.eu/smart-contracts-and-the-role-of-regulated-market-infrastructures/)) | Stablecoin | unknown (pilot on private Zero) | unknown | Whitelisted wallets only | unknown | None needed (order book) |
| [[platforms-venues/seturion\|Seturion]] | Tokenized assets on connected EU venues | Participants' own wallets | Offchain at the venue ([Seturion](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion/)) | Central bank money/fiat or onchain cash | Public and selected private | 24/7 settlement (per Seturion) | Via connected venues | unknown | n/a |
| [[platforms-venues/prometheum\|Prometheum]] | Tokenized and digitally native securities | Prometheum Capital (broker-dealer, 15c3-3) | ATS; does not trade against customers ([Prometheum](https://www.prometheum.com/trading)) | unknown | unknown | unknown | Broker-dealer onboarding | unknown | n/a |
| [[issuers/securitize\|Securitize Stocks]] | UCC Art. 8 entitlements | Broker-dealer / RQD Clearing | PropAMM on Solana, Jump as market maker | USDC | Solana | see page | Broker-dealer onboarding | see page | see page |
| [[issuers/xstocks-backed\|Kraken / xStocks]] | Jersey tracker certificates | see page | Exchanges and Solana DeFi | Venue-dependent | Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, X Layer (Payward, 11 Nov 2026); OP Mainnet native (Optimism, 12 Nov 2026) | see page | Non-US eligible persons | Multiplier | see page |
| [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens\|Robinhood]] | Debt securities | US custody partner | RFQ, AMMs and Lighter on Robinhood Chain | see page | Robinhood Chain | see page | Not US, Canada, UK, Switzerland | Reinvested via multiplier | see page |
| [[issuers/dinari\|Dinari]] | Custodial dShares (US: secondary ledger) | Qualified custody | Dinari Financial Network order book (Avalanche L1) ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-the-dinari-financial-network-an-omni-chain-orderbook-powered-by-avalanche)) | unknown | Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, HyperEVM, HyperCore, Plume | see page | Broker-dealer KYC; US tokens non-transferable | Cash dividends; proxy voting via Broadridge | see page |
| [[issuers/backpack\|Backpack]] | Art. 8 entitlement plus separate 1:1 token | RQD Clearing and Atomic Vault Securities | Backpack platform; also quotes into JTX RFQ | USD | Solana | Selected names 24/7 | Backpack KYC; not US/UK/UAE/Japan/EU | Cash dividends on the entitlement | unknown |
| [[platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps\|Hyperliquid HIP-3]] | Synthetic perp | None (no shares) | HyperCore order book | Deployer's chosen quote asset (collateral) | Hyperliquid | Set by deployer (trading sessions) | unknown | None | Deployer-set (e.g. trade[XYZ] relayers, ~3 s) |
| [[platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps\|Ostium]] | Synthetic perp | None; USDC in vault | Oracle-priced, hedged offchain ([Ostium](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)) | USDC | Arbitrum | unknown | unknown | None | In-house consensus oracle |
| Swarm open dOTC | Tokenized RWAs (SX1155) | Escrow contract during trade | P2P maker/taker offers ([GitHub](https://github.com/SwarmMarkets/open-dotc)) | Counter-asset in the offer | Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BNB Chain | unknown | Offer-level counterparty restrictions | unknown | Allowlisted price feeds |
| JTX (RFQ terminal) | Issuer tokens (Ondo, Backpack, xStocks) | Issuer's model | RFQ to issuers, swaps up to \$1M ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/jtx-equities-discoverability-rfq-execution-1650-tokenized-stocks), Jito-affiliated) | unknown | Solana | Issuer-dependent (e.g. [Ondo hours](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/market-hours-and-trading-availability)) | Issuer-dependent | Issuer-dependent | Issuer quote |
| [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv\|OKXICE TSV]] | Security entitlement tokens (Securitize as tokenizer), backed 1:1 ([OKX, 11 Nov 2026](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)) | Self-custodial wallets; venue holds neither assets nor keys ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)) | Permissioned AMM (Uniswap v4 hook) on XLayer ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch); [OKXICE notice, 5 Nov](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)) | USDC, USDG, USDT | XLayer | 24/7 planned; announced launch beginning 23 Nov 2026 ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)); not yet trading as of that announcement | Eligible U.S. OKX Inc. customers: CeDeFi Wallet, identity verification and OKXICE onboarding; soulbound tokens / permissioning list ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch); [notice, 5 Nov](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)) | None at venue (tokenizer processes corporate actions, per the 5 Nov notice) | Pool price |
| [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc\|TSV LLC / Tradecraft]] | Issuer-sponsored shares (CNTN) | Register kept by [[infrastructure/fairmint\|Fairmint]] | Permissioned AMM pool on Tradecraft ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)) | USDC or SBC | Canton | Designed 24/7 with required stoppages | Transfer-agent-verified holders and wallets | Same rights as Nasdaq holders (issuer claim) | Pool price; Alpaca market data for caps |
| [[platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities\|Nasdaq]] | Same security, tokenized form | DTC | Same order book, same priority | Cash via DTC | unknown | unknown | DTC Pilot eligible participants | Same as the share | n/a |
| [[platforms-venues/formation-securities\|Formation Securities]] | Tokenized NMS Stock (issuer-sponsored or third-party tokenizer) | None at venue (non-custodial) | Permissioned concentrated-liquidity AMM (licensed Orca) plus offchain router ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)) | Non-security crypto asset or tokenized MMF | Solana | 24/7, subject to required stoppages | KYC/KYB, sanctions and wallet screening, plus tokenizer approval; Token-2022 transfer hook | Tokenizer, reviewed by the TSV; not at the venue | None for pricing (pool formula); third-party market data for halts and volume caps |
| [[infrastructure/fairmint\|Fairmint TSV]] (announced plans, not live) | Issuer-sponsored shares recorded by Fairmint TA (planned) | Register kept by Fairmint TA (planned) | Permissioned AMM; Tradecraft named as first AMM (planned) | unknown | Canton first, Ethereum planned | unknown | Fairmint TA would verify holders (planned) | unknown | unknown |

## Reading the table
- The Fairmint TSV row is an announced plan (20 Nov 2026), not a live venue; as of 2:59 PM ET that day it did not appear on the SEC's list of filed TSV notices ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html); [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/about/divisions-offices/division-trading-markets/innovation-exemption)).
- Dated, attributed trading-volume figures — which are not like-for-like and are not a league table — are in [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue|Reported trading volume by venue]].
- **Who holds the share** matters more than the chain: the rows run from no share at all (perps), through broker or entitlement custody, to the company's own register (TSV LLC/CNTN).
- **Hours** on most onchain venues follow either the venue's own design (24/7 pools and order books) or the underlying market's sessions (e.g. Ondo's four US sessions plus an Off-Hours session for selected assets, with halts during corporate actions: [Ondo docs](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/market-hours-and-trading-availability)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

# Anthropic's IPO as a tokenized-stock use case: one share, many legal wrappers
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/analyses/anthropic-ipo-tokenized-stock-use-case
description: Short answer. Anthropic sold its IPO shares through underwriters and named brokers. No token was part of that offering.
status: published
last_checked: 2026-11-20

**Short answer.** Anthropic sold its IPO shares through underwriters and named brokers. No token was part of that offering. On the first trading day, 19 Nov 2026, products from at least nine issuers or venue groups tracked the stock, and each gives holders a different legal claim ([[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]]). Crypto venues that offered "IPO access" published small or partial allocations: Bitget reported 153,774 shares, per Bitget, and delivered rANT rather than the shares themselves; xStocks could only partly fill requests; Binance Wallet refunded most of the money committed ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105); [xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208); [Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/f37d1230c2e542fbb1872fcde3ebf140); [Binance Wallet](https://t.me/binance_wallet_announcements/1955)). At the Nasdaq close on the first two days, the largest token pools traded within about 1% of the stock ([GeckoTerminal](https://www.geckoterminal.com/solana/pools/4v6geaGFiFfQP9HbrxSLdwFKsda8V7jr99ADYq9NtJV1)).

*Updated 21 Nov 2026 with day-one volume by issuer, holdings by issuer, close-time token prices, day-2 data and Bitget rANT (Reality, IPO Prime).*

## Who was allowed to sell Anthropic's IPO shares?

Only underwriters and the brokers Anthropic named.

- The final prospectus (Form 424B4) covers 980,000,000 Class A shares at \$83.00 on Nasdaq under "ANT". It does not mention tokens, blockchains or stablecoins ([424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)).
- For retail offerings outside the US, Anthropic's Help Center lists authorized brokers and says it "has not authorized any other firm or platform to offer, or to advertise access to, shares in the proposed retail offerings". No crypto venue or tokenizer is on the list ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents)).
- An older Help Center page, about private-stock transfers, warns that "tokenized securities" offering Anthropic shares may be an investment that "may have no value" ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13704655-unauthorized-anthropic-stock-sales-and-investment-scams)).
- Ondo and Securitize say Anthropic did not sponsor or endorse their products, Coinbase's prospectus says the underlying issuer "is not involved in the offer or sale" of its certificates, and Bitget says rANT "is not issued, offered, or managed by Anthropic" and "has not been approved, sponsored, or endorsed by Anthropic" ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).

## What legal models were used?

One ticker, many different claims.

| Product | What the holder has (issuer) | Who can buy | Vote |
|---|---|---|---|
| Securitize Stocks ANT | Security entitlement through a US broker-dealer (Securitize Markets) | Eligible investors in the US, EU and other permitted places | Passed through "under the product terms"; not registered shareholders ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx)) |
| Backpack ANT (Solana) | Brokerage security entitlement, converted 1:1 into a token (Backpack Securities) | Eligible Backpack users; not the US | Not stated ([Sunrise docs](https://docs.sunrise.xyz/equities/backpack-securities)) |
| Robinhood Anthropic Stock Token | Tokenised debt security, Series 218 (Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited) | Not the US; restricted in Canada, the UK, Switzerland and elsewhere | No ([Final Terms](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf)) |
| Coinbase ANTc | ADGM certificate over shares (Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd) | Authorised Participants in the ADGM; others buy in DeFi; not US persons | Only "Vested Holders" can instruct a vote ([prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)) |
| bStocks ANTB (Binance) | ADGM certificate, "not stocks or shares" (BTech Holdings Limited) | Permitted regions; not US persons | Not stated ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9); [ADGM list](https://www.adgm.com/financial-services-regulatory-authority/listing-authority/official-list-of-securities)) |
| xStocks ANTx (Kraken, Binance Wallet, OKX xANT) | Tracker certificate, "price exposure only" (Backed Assets (JE) Limited) | Outside the US, UK, Canada and some other countries | No ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access); [OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/help/okx-to-list-xant-for-spot-trading-and-convert-ant-pre-ipo-futures)) |
| Ondo ANTon | Ondo token, "not themselves stocks" (Ondo Global Markets (BVI)) | Eligible investors outside the US | No ([Ondo docs](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)) |
| Dinari ANT dShares | Dinari's tokenized representation; a "secondary ledger" in its US docs | US and more than 90 countries | Blog says preserved; US docs differ ([Dinari](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs)) |
| Reality rANT (Bitget IPO Prime) | Tokenized stock; Bitget says it is not equivalent to holding the shares and does not automatically confer shareholder status or voting rights (Reality, per Bitget) | Eligible users in permitted regions; restricted jurisdictions excluded; US eligibility not stated | No, not automatically ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381); [Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)) |
| Pre-IPO and equity perpetuals | Cash-settled derivative (the venue) | Varies by venue | None ([trade.xyz](https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md)) |

**Backing claims differ too.** Kraken says ANTx is "backed 1:1"; Binance's reported campaign terms allowed cash or other assets; Ondo includes "cash in transit"; Robinhood's shares may be lent out; Coinbase limits redemption to Vested Holders ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access); [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/exchanges/binance-wallet-500m-anthropic-ipo-xstocks-token-sale/); [Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Robinhood Final Terms](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)). The wiki does not rank them.

## Did crypto venues get IPO shares?

A little, not much. Relative to the 980,000,000-share offering, even the largest published crypto-venue figure is small.

- **Bitget** said it received a final allocation of 153,774 Anthropic shares (VIP 137,494 at 11.26%; public 16,280 at 1.36%), per Bitget, with unallocated funds to be refunded by 19 Nov 20:00 UTC in the public round and 20 Nov 16:00 UTC in the VIP round ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105)). The delivered asset is rANT, not the shares themselves ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).
- **xStocks** "received an allocation" but could "only partially fulfill" requests on Kraken and elsewhere, and released unfilled funds with no fees ([xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208); [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access)).
- **Binance Wallet** called its allocation "not ideal relative to total user commitments". It returned all 500,002,764 USDC committed and distributed "roughly 2,957" ANTB tokens at no cost, plus a \$1,000,000 ANTB airdrop ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/f37d1230c2e542fbb1872fcde3ebf140); [Binance Wallet](https://t.me/binance_wallet_announcements/1955)).
- **Ondo, Dinari and Coinbase** did not take part in the IPO; their products started after trading began ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Dinari FAQ](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)).

## When did each tokenized version of Anthropic go live?

**Short answer.** Tokenized Anthropic came in three waves. A pre-IPO token (PreStocks) and pre-IPO perpetuals traded before the listing. Bitget announced rANT via IPO Prime on 2 Nov ET (3 Nov, 10:00 UTC+8). Between 6 and 18 Nov, Ondo, Dinari, Kraken/xStocks, Backpack, Coinbase, OKX and Binance Wallet also announced products. On 19 Nov, Anthropic's first Nasdaq day, most went live within minutes to hours of the first trade, around 11:48 AM ET. None was part of the IPO itself ([424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)).

<a href="/diagrams/analyses/anthropic-ant-tokenized-timeline-2026-11.png" class="tap-enlarge" title="Open full size"><img src="/diagrams/analyses/anthropic-ant-tokenized-timeline-2026-11-1200.webp" alt="Swimlane timeline, 6 to 21 Nov 2026, one lane per issuer or venue. Hollow markers show announcements and filled markers show the go-live date; PreStocks and the pre-IPO perpetuals were already trading before 6 Nov. The chart predates Bitget rANT." width="1200" height="675" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:auto"></a>

The chart predates Bitget rANT (IPO Prime, issued by Reality), which Bitget announced for listing on 19 Nov during US regular market hours; the first trade time is not confirmed in the retrieved articles ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901016); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/spotlight/ipo-prime)).

Times are ET. "Announced" means the issuer or venue said it would launch. "Live" means a source shows it trading. "Reported" means the figure comes from the party itself or a third party.

Dates on the chart are from the issuers' and venues' announcements and from Nasdaq, including [424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm), [Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/newsroom/anthropic-marks-ipo-at-nasdaq), [Ondo](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html), [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access), [Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9), [Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx), [Robinhood](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf) and [Tom Wan on X](https://x.com/tomwanhh/status/2123722051823563073).

**What the timeline shows**

- **Announced early, live on the day.** Most issuers announced 1 to 13 days ahead and went live on 19 Nov, after the first Nasdaq trade. Backpack's ANT was trading on Solana about seven minutes after it, per SolanaFloor's reported times ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/anthropics-81-3-b-ipo-breaks-space-x-s-record-as-early-ant-trading-volume-on-solana-tops-29-m)).
- **Allocation and tokenization were separate steps.** Venues that took IPO orders published different outcomes: Bitget reported 153,774 shares, per Bitget; xStocks, via Kraken, got a partial fill; Binance Wallet called its allocation "not ideal" and refunded unfilled money. Ondo, Dinari and Coinbase did not take part in the IPO ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105); [xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208); [Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/f37d1230c2e542fbb1872fcde3ebf140); [Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Dinari FAQ](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)).
- **Exposure came before the listing.** PreStocks and the pre-IPO perps traded first, and neither gives holders a share: PreStocks offers "only economic exposure" and the perps are cash-settled ([PreStocks](https://prestocks.com/anthropic); [trade.xyz](https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md)).
- **Not confirmed in the sources retrieved:** Dinari's ANT going live; when OKX's and Kraken's perpetuals converted; rANT's first trade time (Bitget announced a 19 Nov listing during US regular hours, but the retrieved articles do not confirm the open); Reality's legal entity, chain and contract; and whether US persons can hold rANT.

## What happened on the first day of trading?

**On Nasdaq.** ANT opened at \$111.50 and closed at \$97.17 on 857,312,300 shares ([Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/ant/historical)). On day 2, 20 Nov, it closed at \$88.91 on 400,460,300 shares ([Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/ant/historical)). Tokens went live within minutes of the first trade, reported at about 11:48 AM ET ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/anthropics-81-3-b-ipo-breaks-space-x-s-record-as-early-ant-trading-volume-on-solana-tops-29-m); [Solana Compass](https://solanacompass.com/news/tokenized-anthropic-ant-goes-live-on-solana-on-ipo-day-from-backpack-ondo-xstocks-and-securitize)).

**Traded versus held.** The two measures rank the issuers differently. Backpack's ANT and Robinhood's token led day-one spot volume, but xStocks' ANTx was the most held onchain the next morning, and that count leaves out another \$39.1M of ANTx in Kraken's hot wallet.

<a href="/diagrams/analyses/anthropic-ant-traded-vs-held-2026-11-20.png" class="tap-enlarge" title="Open full size"><img src="/diagrams/analyses/anthropic-ant-traded-vs-held-2026-11-20-1200.webp" alt="Two bar charts of tokenized Anthropic by issuer, each on its own scale: day-one spot volume (TechFlow) and value held onchain on 20 Nov (Entropy Advisors). The same figures are in the table below." width="1200" height="651" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:auto"></a>

| Issuer | Day-one spot volume (reported) | Held onchain, 20 Nov (reported) |
|---|---|---|
| Backpack ANT | \$56.2M | \$6.0M |
| Robinhood ANT | \$36.3M | \$2.7M |
| xStocks ANTx | \$17.0M (Kraken \$13.13M) | \$9.2M, plus \$39.1M in Kraken's hot wallet |
| bStocks ANTB | \$15.6M (Binance spot \$9.97M) | \$5.7M |
| Coinbase ANTc | \$6.12M | not counted |
| Ondo ANTon | \$0.92M | \$0.7M |
| PreStocks ANTHROPIC | not counted | \$5.0M |

Volume: TechFlow, DEX and exchange spot, 24 hours to 12:40 AM ET on 20 Nov ([TechFlow](https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/145938)). Holdings: Entropy Advisors at the \$97.17 close, posted by Tom Wan ([Tom Wan on X](https://x.com/tomwanhh/status/2123722051823563073)). Neither publishes a method, and their times and scopes differ.

- **Small next to Nasdaq.** TechFlow put onchain DEX volume at about \$106M. Nasdaq traded 857.3M shares, worth between \$79B and \$99B at the day's low and high, so onchain trading was roughly 0.1% of it (our arithmetic; [TechFlow](https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/145938); [Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/ant/historical)).
- **Derivatives dwarfed spot.** TechFlow counted about \$1.75B of ANT perpetual volume on Hyperliquid in the same 24 hours ([TechFlow](https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/145938)).
- **A third traded while Nasdaq was closed.** Sunrise says 36% of the \$170M+ of pool volume in Backpack's ANT, from the debut to 9 AM ET on 21 Nov, came outside Nasdaq hours (Sunrise's own figure, from GeckoTerminal data; [Sunrise on X](https://x.com/sunrise/status/2124302840164180038)).
- **PreStocks is a pre-IPO token.** Its issuer says it gives "only economic exposure" and "trades at a discount to the public stock price" while the underlying shares are locked up ([PreStocks](https://prestocks.com/anthropic)). Its \$5.0M works out to about \$65 a token, not \$97.17 ([Tom Wan on X](https://x.com/tomwanhh/status/2123722051823563073)).

Supply snapshots by chain are on [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## What does the use case show?

- **The tokens sat outside the IPO.** The share sale ran through underwriters and named brokers; third parties issued the tokens under their own terms ([Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm); [Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents)).
- **"Tokenized Anthropic" is a family of claims.** One ticker covered entitlements, debt securities, certificates, tracker tokens and derivatives ([[concepts/legal-taxonomy|Legal taxonomy]]; [[comparisons/tokenized-stocks-compared|Tokenized stocks compared]]).
- **Prices held close to the stock.** At both closes, the largest Backpack, ANTB and ANTc pools were 0.4% to 1.0% below Nasdaq ([GeckoTerminal](https://www.geckoterminal.com/solana/pools/4v6geaGFiFfQP9HbrxSLdwFKsda8V7jr99ADYq9NtJV1)).
- **Trading and holding are different businesses.** The issuer with the most volume was not the issuer with the most held ([TechFlow](https://www.techflowpost.com/en-US/newsletter/145938); [Tom Wan on X](https://x.com/tomwanhh/status/2123722051823563073)).
- **Check the contract address.** Several tokens use "ANT"; issuers publish their own addresses ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9); [Robinhood Final Terms](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf)).
- **One venue converts between wrappers.** Binance converts eligible third-party tokens into ANTB 1:1 for a limited time, under a daily cap ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9)).

## Frequently asked questions

### Could you buy Anthropic's IPO shares as tokens?

Not as part of the IPO. Anthropic's authorized brokers include no tokenizer ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents)). Bitget said it received 153,774 shares, per Bitget, and delivered rANT, which it says is not equivalent to holding the shares ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)). xStocks could only partly fill requests, and Binance Wallet refunded all committed USDC ([xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208); [Binance Wallet](https://t.me/binance_wallet_announcements/1955)).

### Is a tokenized Anthropic share the same as a share?

No. Securitize says its holders are not registered shareholders of Anthropic, and Robinhood's Stock Token, xStocks, Ondo's token and Bitget's rANT give no voting rights (Bitget: not automatically) ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx); [Robinhood Final Terms](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf); [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access); [Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).

### Did Anthropic approve any of these tokens?

None of the sources retrieved says so. Ondo and Securitize say Anthropic did not sponsor or endorse their tokens, and Bitget says rANT has no official partnership with Anthropic and has not been approved, sponsored or endorsed by it ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).

### Can US residents hold a tokenized Anthropic share?

Only through products open to US persons, such as Securitize's ANT and Dinari's dShares. Robinhood's Stock Token, bStocks, xStocks, Ondo, Coinbase's ANTc and PreStocks exclude US persons ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx); [Dinari FAQ](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs); [Robinhood docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/rhj); [Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9); [Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf); [PreStocks](https://prestocks.com/anthropic)).

### Did the tokens trade at a premium to Nasdaq?

No. In the last minute before the 4:00 PM ET close, the largest pools for Backpack's ANT, ANTB and ANTc traded 0.5% to 0.7% below Nasdaq's \$97.17 close on 19 Nov and 0.4% to 1.0% below its \$88.91 close on 20 Nov ([GeckoTerminal](https://www.geckoterminal.com/solana/pools/4v6geaGFiFfQP9HbrxSLdwFKsda8V7jr99ADYq9NtJV1)). These are single-pool prices, not prices for a large order.

## What are the limits of this analysis?

Built from the wiki pages in `pages_used` and the raw captures they cite, retrieved 19-21 Nov 2026 (Bitget rANT sources retrieved 21 Nov). Volume and holdings figures are reported by third parties and were not verified onchain. Not covered: Securitize and Dinari supply, Robinhood, ANTx and ANTon close-time prices, an ANTB-specific prospectus, which was not found, and Reality's product documents, legal entity, chain and contract.

*Reference information only, not legal or investment advice.*

# Backpack Securities
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/backpack
description: on Backpack you own a real share through a brokerage-style entitlement. You can also turn selected stocks into a separate 1:1 token on Solana and back again.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Solana
status: Live; tokens accepted as Kamino collateral from 4 Nov 2026
last_updated: 2026-11-19
last_checked: 2026-11-19

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Solana  
> **Status:** Live; tokens accepted as Kamino collateral from 4 Nov 2026  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-19  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Backpack Securities |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Backpack Securities stocks and tokenized securities |
| structure | NY UCC Article 8 security entitlements; selected names also tokenized 1:1 on Solana as separate instruments |
| chains | Solana |
| who_can_buy | Eligible verified Backpack users in supported regions; not US, UK, UAE, Japan or Backpack EU |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: on Backpack you own a real share through a brokerage-style entitlement. You can also turn selected stocks into a separate 1:1 token on Solana and back again.*

Backpack Securities holds customers' US stocks and ETFs as [[concepts/glossary#security-entitlement|security entitlements]] under New York UCC Article 8, with cash dividends, corporate actions and ACATS/DTCC transfers ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)). The underlying holdings are cleared and custodied by RQD Clearing, LLC and Atomic Vault Securities, LLC, per Backpack Securities ([Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261104930970/en/Kamino-and-Backpack-Securities-Expand-Credit-for-Tokenized-U.S.-Equities)).

## Two instruments
- **Entitlement:** what you own when you buy a stock in the Backpack account ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)).
- **Token:** selected stocks can be tokenized 1:1 on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] (with Sunrise) and redeemed 1:1 by depositing the token back to a Backpack account. Backpack says the tokens "are distinct instruments from the security entitlement itself" ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)).
- Selected equities trade 24/7, including weekends and holidays, with USD settlement; off-hours liquidity may differ ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)).

## Where the tokens are used
- **Collateral:** since 4 Nov 2026 the tokens (starting with MU, SKHY, SPCX and SNDK) can back USDC loans in an isolated Backpack Market on Kamino, with liquidation risk even when the underlying market is closed ([Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261104930970/en/Kamino-and-Backpack-Securities-Expand-Credit-for-Tokenized-U.S.-Equities)).
- **RFQ quotes:** Backpack is named among the issuers quoting into JTX's request-for-quote swaps on Solana ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/jtx-equities-discoverability-rfq-execution-1650-tokenized-stocks), Jito-affiliated outlet).

Separately from its stock tokens, Backpack said on 16 Nov 2026 that the CFTC approved its US derivatives exchange (DCM) and clearing house (DCO), for crypto perpetual futures, not tokenized stocks ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/blog/backpack-receives-landmark-cftc-approval); [CFTC Chairman Selig's statement](https://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/SpeechesTestimony/seligstatement111626), which does not name the firm).

## Anthropic (ANT)
Backpack announced on 11 Nov 2026 that tokenized Anthropic stock (ANT) would come to Solana on IPO day, with Backpack Securities as issuer and Sunrise as distribution partner, according to [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/tokenized-anthropic-stock-solana-backpack-securities/) (secondary; the X announcement was not retrieved, [Sunrise docs](https://docs.sunrise.xyz/equities/backpack-securities)). Backpack and Sunrise docs do not name ANT. They describe the general design: investors hold "real security entitlements" with dividend eligibility and corporate action participation, and "every tokenized security issued by Backpack is redeemable 1:1 for the real underlying share" ([Sunrise docs](https://docs.sunrise.xyz/equities/backpack-securities)). Moving between account and token is a conversion: withdrawal carries an estimated platform fee of about \$0.50 paid in the token, and conversions pause around dividend rebases and stock splits ([Backpack support](https://support.backpack.exchange/backpack-securities/tokenized-securities/conversion-flow)). ANT-specific eligibility and voting terms were not found. Anthropic's 424B4 does not mention tokenized shares ([Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

Compare with SPV-note and wrapper models in [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]] and [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].

## What this means for holders
- In the account you hold an Article 8 entitlement; the onchain token is a separate instrument redeemable 1:1 ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)).
- Not available in the US, UK, UAE, Japan or Backpack EU ([Backpack](https://learn.backpack.exchange/articles/what-is-backpack-securities)).
- Borrowing against the token on Kamino can lead to liquidation, including when US markets are shut ([Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261104930970/en/Kamino-and-Backpack-Securities-Expand-Credit-for-Tokenized-U.S.-Equities)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

*In plain English: bStocks are certificates backed one-for-one by real US shares held at a custodian.*

bStocks are certificates issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, each backed 1:1 by a US share at a regulated [[concepts/glossary#custodian|custodian]], admitted to the FSRA Official List ([ADGM admission notice, 11 Jun 2026](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/anouncement/admission-of-securities-to-the-official-list--btech-holdings-limited_06_12_2026_18-11-40.pdf)). Each ticker has its own FSRA-approved prospectus, e.g. [NVIDIA bStocks, 11 Jun 2026](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/btech-holdings-prospectus----11-june---nvidia-bstocks_06_11_2026_16-44-54.pdf).

## What this means for holders
- bStocks are certificates from BTECH Holdings backed 1:1, admitted to the ADGM FSRA Official List ([ADGM prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/btech-holdings-prospectus----11-june---nvidia-bstocks_06_11_2026_16-44-54.pdf)).
- The offer is made only in ADGM and not to US persons ([ADGM prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/btech-holdings-prospectus----11-june---nvidia-bstocks_06_11_2026_16-44-54.pdf)).
- Cash dividends received on the underlying are reinvested into additional shares (net of a 30% US withholding tax applicable to non-US holders) and reflected through an adjustment to the Multiplier; holders do not receive cash dividends directly ([ADGM prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/btech-holdings-prospectus----11-june---nvidia-bstocks_06_11_2026_16-44-54.pdf)).

## Anthropic (ANTB) on Binance (19 Nov 2026)
Binance listed the bStocks Anthropic token, ANTB, on Binance Spot (ANTB/USDT) from 18:00 UTC on 19 Nov 2026, with deposits and withdrawals from 19:00 UTC on BNB Smart Chain (contract 0x38Dd26788Cf2d901E3aBf04efE3007d459d0Fc53). Holders of the stock directly can tokenize it into bStocks: "Conversion is 1:1 between each underlying stock and its bStocks, with zero conversion fees." ANTB was also added to Binance's supported assets for third-party conversion, so users "can deposit and convert eligible third-party tokenized securities into ANTB at a fixed 1:1 rate with zero fees for a limited time, subject to a daily promotional cap." Binance repeats that bStocks "are not stocks or shares", are not offered to US persons, and have no public offering outside the ADGM ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9)). From the same time, ANTB counts as collateral for Binance Cross Margin, Portfolio Margin and Portfolio Margin Pro; borrowing ANTB is not supported ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/c4a6afb79b32434a88e826b9632242c0)).

Binance Wallet also delivered ANTB to participants in its Anthropic IPO campaign: "roughly 2,957 Anthropic tokenized stocks (ANTB)" pro rata at no cost, plus a \$1,000,000 ANTB airdrop, after returning all committed USDC ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/f37d1230c2e542fbb1872fcde3ebf140); [Binance Wallet](https://t.me/binance_wallet_announcements/1955)). ADGM's Official List shows "Anthropic bStocks" from BTech Holdings Limited as Listed: Certificates over Shares, ISIN AE000A4AXWN5, on Nest Exchange Limited ([ADGM Official List](https://www.adgm.com/financial-services-regulatory-authority/listing-authority/official-list-of-securities), retrieved 21 Nov 2026). An ANTB-specific prospectus was still not found; the list does not link one, and Binance's announcements link only to its general prospectus page ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/830c320848af4257812d5b6e99e031f9)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

# Coinbase Tokenized Stocks
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks
description: Coinbase's stock tokens on Base are each backed by a real share held in custody.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: Abu Dhabi Global Market (FSRA-authorized, per Coinbase via Zerion)
chain: Base
status: live
last_updated: 2026-11-19
last_checked: 2026-11-19

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** Abu Dhabi Global Market (FSRA-authorized, per Coinbase via Zerion)  
> **Chain:** Base  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-19  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Coinbase Tokenized Stocks |
| jurisdiction | Abu Dhabi Global Market (FSRA-authorized, per Coinbase via Zerion) |
| product_name | B20 stock tokens |
| structure | Beneficial claim on backing shares |
| chains | Base |
| who_can_buy | Eligible jurisdictions outside the US; offered under Regulation S |
| num_assets | 58 prospectuses listed on coinbase.com/tokenize (2026-10-17) |

*In plain English: Coinbase's stock tokens on Base are each backed by a real share held in custody.*

Each [[concepts/glossary#b20|B20]] token on Base is a beneficial claim on a real share in [[concepts/glossary#bankruptcy-remote|bankruptcy-remote]] custody ([Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/tokenize); [Base](https://www.base.org/stocks)). Coinbase holds an [[concepts/glossary#fsra-adgm|FSRA]] permission in ADGM ([ADGM](https://www.adgm.com/media/announcements/coinbase-establishes-its-tokenization-hub-in-abu-dhabi-with-financial-services-permission-from-the-financial-services-regulatory-authority)).

A public read-only API publishes records, [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multipliers]] and prospectuses ([Base docs](https://docs.base.org/sdks/tokenized-stocks/overview)).

[[concepts/glossary#authorized-participant|Authorized participants]] (institutional market makers) buy the shares, which go to Alpaca, a regulated broker and [[concepts/glossary#custodian|custodian]] ([Base](https://blog.base.org/tokenized-stocks); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/08/24/coinbase-debuts-tokenized-stocks-on-base-network-joining-race-to-bring-equities-on-blockchain), news). Token format: [[standards/b20|B20]]. B20 tokens can point each policy scope (who may send, receive, mint or be seized) at a shared Policy Registry of allowlists and blocklists; scopes default to always-allow until they are bound, and the standard's events include seize, a freeze-style blocked burn, and pause ([Base updatePolicy](https://docs.base.org/specifications/b20/reference/interfaces/ib20/update-policy)). See [[concepts/token-primitives|token primitives]].

On Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network (ITN), "coinbase" is one of the issuer values an authorized participant can name in a mint request; Alpaca moves the shares from the AP's account to the issuer's Alpaca account, and the issuer mints the tokens to the AP's wallet ([Alpaca mint API](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/posttokenizationmintbroker); [Alpaca issuer guide](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/tokenization-guide-for-issuer)). The API value shows Coinbase is set up as an ITN issuer; it is not by itself a statement about Coinbase's custody terms. See [[build/trading-reference-architecture#primary-market-mint-and-redeem-broker-custodied-model|mint and redeem, step by step]].

Since 25 Sep 2026, seven Coinbase tokenized stocks (AAPLc, AMZNc, GOOGLc, METAc, MSFTc, NVDAc, TSLAc) can be posted as collateral to borrow USDC on Aave V4 on Base ([Aave](https://www.aave.com/blog/coinbase-tokenized-stocks)).

John D'Agostino, head of strategy at Coinbase Institutional, said the initial offering covers about seven stocks and is planned to grow to 2,000 (a stated plan, not a launched figure) ([TheStreet via Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/tokenized-stocks-turn-share-collateral-165759306.html), news, 27 Oct 2026).

## Coinbase research view (Jan 2026)
Coinbase Institutional's research team wrote that tokenized public equities were still under \$1B, versus about \$28B for tokenized Treasuries and private credit ([Coinbase Institutional, Major Trends in Tokenization](https://www.coinbase.com/institutional/research-insights/research/market-intelligence/major-trends-in-tokenization), 10 Jan 2026). It flagged three risks:
- **Market depth:** order books for tokenized stocks remain thin; [[concepts/glossary#slippage|slippage]] and volatility can be significantly higher than in the underlying stock, especially post-market or under stress.
- **[[concepts/glossary#oracle|Oracle]] risk:** off-chain prices must be brought onchain; errors, lags or manipulation can break the equivalence between token and underlying collateral.
- **Regulatory fragmentation:** jurisdictions differ on who can own what and how secondary transfers work.

The note says that if freely transferable designs are permitted, tokenized stocks could serve as collateral in lending markets; otherwise, with thin books, extended hours don't yet offset lower depth and higher friction ([Coinbase Institutional](https://www.coinbase.com/institutional/research-insights/research/market-intelligence/major-trends-in-tokenization)).

## Coinbase's SEC comment letter (3 Nov 2026)
In its letter on the SEC's proposed transfer agent rules (File S7-2026-30), Coinbase argues that a third-party tokenizer does not become a transfer agent just by issuing tokens that reference a security; that holders should be identifiable by wallet address "without a mandatory name and physical mailing address"; and that a blockchain record can itself be the master securityholder file ([Coinbase letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1119719-3983946.pdf)). This is advocacy, not law; see [[topics/regulation|Regulation]].

## Onchain Rights standard (16 Nov 2026)
On 16 Nov 2026 Coinbase and [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]] published a jointly developed open technical standard for delivering shareholder communications to wallets holding tokenized shares, and said they also submitted it as an Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP) for review. Broadridge also launched a supporting data oracle for aggregate evidence of distribution ([Broadridge / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/coinbase-and-broadridge-publish-proposed-standard-for-onchain-shareholder-communications-broadridge-launches-data-oracle-302939893.html)). The standard's site says Coinbase and Broadridge are the first authors, that standards are released under CC0, and that Ethereum comes first, "which includes EVM-compatible networks and layer 2s like Base" ([Onchain Rights](https://www.onchainrights.org/)). The FAQ says the standard announces and describes events and does not take votes or move money; onchain voting is the next phase ([Onchain Rights](https://www.onchainrights.org/)). As of 16 Nov 2026 the EIP texts and the canonical JSON schema were not yet published on the project's site ([EIP References](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs/specs/eip-references); [JSON Schema](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs/specs/json-schema)). See [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]].

## Anthropic (ANTc)
Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd, an ADGM company incorporated 17 June 2026, published a prospectus dated 18 Nov 2026 for "Anthropic CB Certificates (Certificates over Shares)", ticker ANTc, representing beneficial interests in Anthropic Class A shares; the offer commences 19 Nov, after Anthropic begins trading ([prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)). The PDF's file title reads "DRAFT 17NOV2026" and ADGM disclaims responsibility for its content.
- **Entities:** Onchain Marketplace Ltd is the tokenisation entity; Alpaca Securities LLC is custodian and broker.
- **Claim:** the certificates "do not constitute direct investments in the Underlying"; the Underlying Issuer "is not involved in the offer or sale of the Securities" and does not sponsor, endorse or promote them.
- **Who can buy:** the offer is to Authorised Participants only; everyone else buys onchain or in DeFi markets and is an Unvested Holder until meeting Vesting Conditions (including AML/KYC). Not offered to US persons.
- **Rights:** "Only Vested Holders may exercise any rights", including redemption and voting. Holders have no direct voting right; the issuer may "endeavour to vote" on Vested Holders' written instructions. Holders do not receive cash dividends directly.
- **Fees:** creation fee 0.01%, redemption fee 0.05%.
The prospectus text does not name the blockchain network. Anthropic's 424B4 does not mention tokenized shares ([Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## What this means for holders
- A B20 stock token is a beneficial claim on a share held in [[concepts/glossary#bankruptcy-remote|bankruptcy-remote]] custody, not a share on the company's register ([Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/tokenize); [Base](https://www.base.org/stocks)).
- Offered outside the US only; dividends are reinvested through a [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([Base](https://www.base.org/stocks)).
- [[concepts/glossary#redeem|Redemption]] terms are set in the issuer documents; check them before relying on redemption ([Base docs](https://docs.base.org/sdks/tokenized-stocks/overview)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Dinari dShares
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/dinari
description: Dinari issues tokens backed by US stocks and offers them to eligible US investors.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: United States (+85 jurisdictions per Fensory)
chain: Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Avalanche C-Chain, Base, HyperEVM, HyperCore, Plume
status: live (US launch 2026-08-04)
last_updated: 2026-11-19
last_checked: 2026-11-19

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (+85 jurisdictions per Fensory)  
> **Chain:** Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Avalanche C-Chain, Base, HyperEVM, HyperCore, Plume  
> **Status:** live (US launch 2026-08-04)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-19  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Dinari dShares |
| jurisdiction | United States (+85 jurisdictions per Fensory) |
| product_name | dShares |
| structure | Tokens backed by custodied securities; jurisdiction-specific rights |
| chains | Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Avalanche C-Chain, Base, HyperEVM, HyperCore, Plume |
| who_can_buy | Eligible US investors (since 2026-08-04); international per Fensory (secondary) |
| num_assets | 724 at US launch |

*In plain English: Dinari issues tokens backed by US stocks and offers them to eligible US investors.*

On 4 Aug 2026 Dinari launched 724 dShares, including the full S&P 500, to eligible US investors ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-724-tokenized-stocks-available-to-u-s-investors-and-businesses)). Dinari Inc. is the [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]]; Dinari Securities LLC is the [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealer]] ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/04/3338495/0/en/dinari-inc-opens-platform-licenses-to-u-s-financial-institutions.html)).

In its input to the SEC Crypto Task Force, Dinari describes tokens as secondary, non-transferable records mirroring authoritative off-chain brokerage books ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/ctf-written-input-dinari-inc-040226.pdf)). US clearing is through Alpaca Securities LLC ([Dinari](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/us)). See [What is a dShare](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/what-is-dshare).

## Which chains are dShares on?
Dinari's docs list supported chains as Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Avalanche C-Chain, Base, HyperEVM, HyperCore and Plume ([Dinari docs](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/blockchain)). In Aug 2025 Dinari launched the Dinari Financial Network, a Layer 1 on Avalanche that acts as an omni-chain order book and coordination layer for its partners' liquidity and settlement, governed by a consortium with Gemini, BitGo and VanEck as initial validators ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-the-dinari-financial-network-an-omni-chain-orderbook-powered-by-avalanche)). See [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]].

## Can dShare holders vote?
Broadridge and Dinari announced that eligible dShare holders can vote the underlying shares through Broadridge's proxy infrastructure; votes form part of the formal shareholder vote and are counted with traditional shareholders, and holders receive company disclosures ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities)). Wallet login to prove entitlements and vote directly is a future step, not live. See [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]].

## Anthropic IPO (legal model)
Dinari said on 6 Nov 2026 that ANT will go live as a dShare the day it starts trading, for eligible investors in the US and 90+ countries ([Dinari on X](https://x.com/DinariGlobal/status/2118853664232374570)). Its IPO FAQ calls ANT dShares "Dinari's tokenized representation of Anthropic stock", "backed by the underlying security", says only whole-share limit orders are accepted before the opening trade, and says "Direct IPO purchase is not available through Dinari": participation is through the secondary market once the stock trades ([Dinari FAQ](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs)).

In the US a dShare is "a secondary ledger for real ownership in the underlying securities" held through Dinari Securities, and issued tokens are currently non-transferable (docs last updated 22 Jun 2026; [Dinari docs](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/us)); it is not an issuer-sponsored Anthropic share. Dinari's 17 Nov 2026 blog says its model preserves dividends, corporate actions and "voting rights" ([Dinari blog](https://dinari.com/blog/anthropic-is-coming-to-dshares)); that is Dinari's own claim, and no ANT-specific legal document was found to confirm it.

## What this means for holders
- You can sell or burn dShares for payment tokens (stablecoin proceeds); the custodian sells the share. No in-kind delivery of the share was found in issuer docs ([placing orders](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/placing-orders); [dShares](https://dinari.com/dshares)).
- Eligible holders can vote the underlying shares through Broadridge's proxy process ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities)).
- Eligible US investors can buy dShares since 4 Aug 2026 ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-724-tokenized-stocks-available-to-u-s-investors-and-businesses)).
- Dinari describes its tokens as records that mirror its brokerage books, so your claim runs through Dinari as [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealer]] ([Dinari SEC input](https://www.sec.gov/files/ctf-written-input-dinari-inc-040226.pdf)).
- Dividends are paid in cash, with [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|USDC]] support ([Dinari](https://dinari.com/blog/dinari-launches-724-tokenized-stocks-available-to-u-s-investors-and-businesses)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*
