# Ondo Stocks (Ondo Global Markets)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/ondo-global-markets
description: Ondo Stocks are tokenized US stocks and ETFs: BVI structured notes for eligible non-US investors, not the shares themselves.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: British Virgin Islands
chain: Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, (select tokens transferable to HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain via bridge)
status: unknown
last_updated: 2026-11-19
last_checked: 2026-11-19

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** British Virgin Islands  
> **Chain:** Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, (select tokens transferable to HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain via bridge)  
> **Status:** unknown  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-19  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Ondo Stocks (Ondo Global Markets) |
| jurisdiction | British Virgin Islands |
| product_name | Ondo Stocks (tokenized US stocks and ETFs) |
| structure | Structured notes giving economic exposure; no shareholder voting/information rights |
| chains | Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, (select tokens transferable to HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain via bridge) |
| who_can_buy | Excludes US persons and other prohibited jurisdictions (including Canada and the sanctioned jurisdictions listed in Ondo docs); Brazil, the EEA, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland (entities only) and the UK require professional or qualified status |
| num_assets | 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs (Ondo registry, 2026-11-10); 7 Intelligent Portfolios are a separate product |

Ondo Stocks (previously Ondo Global Markets) are tokenized US stocks and ETFs: BVI structured notes for eligible non-US investors, not the shares themselves.

*In plain English: these tokens track US stocks and ETFs held at US brokers. You hold a note, not the share.*

Ondo tokenized stocks are structured notes issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited, a [[concepts/glossary#bankruptcy-remote|bankruptcy-remote]] BVI [[concepts/glossary#spv|SPV]]. They are backed 1:1 plus a buffer by the corresponding US stocks or ETFs (and cash in transit) held through US custodial [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealers]], with Ankura Trust Company as security agent and daily verification agent ([legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory); [trust and transparency](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/trust-and-transparency)). Tokenholder rights are governed by Swiss law under the issuer's Sales Terms. The tokens are offered under Regulation S and may not be sold to US persons or into the United States except under a registration or a valid exemption ([legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)). Ondo's legal notice also says the tokens are not themselves stocks, ETFs or ADRs and do not give holders a right to receive the underlying assets ([Ondo Stocks](https://ondo.finance/ondo-stocks)).

The issuer is 90.01% owned by Flux Finance Inc. (a wholly owned subsidiary of the Ondo Foundation) and 9.99% owned by Ondo Finance Inc. ([legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)). Ondo Finance is described as the technology and service provider, not the issuer ([trust and transparency](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/trust-and-transparency)). An EEA/EU base prospectus has been approved by the Financial Market Authority Liechtenstein (FMA), according to the same legal notice, and is published on each token page at [app.ondo.finance](https://app.ondo.finance) ([Ondo Stocks](https://ondo.finance/ondo-stocks)).

## How does minting and redemption work?

Direct [[concepts/glossary#mint|mint]] and [[concepts/glossary#redeem|redemption]] on the Ondo Stocks platform use signed quotes (IGMTokenManager). Purchases are in USDon, Ondo's 1:1 dollar stablecoin; USDC can be swapped 1:1 atomically when the swapper has liquidity. The minimum is \$1. Minting is instant and atomic; redemption to USDon is always instant, and redemption to USDC is instant if the swapper has enough USDC. Bank-wire redemption is not supported ([investing and redeeming](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/investing-and-redeeming); [API overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/api-reference/overview)).

A holder who redeems with Ondo receives USDon or USDC (stablecoin, not the underlying share). The tokens are structured notes, not title to the share ([investing and redeeming](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/investing-and-redeeming); [legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory); [Ondo Stocks](https://ondo.finance/ondo-stocks)).

Ondo says there are no mint or burn fees on this path. The quoted price is the price the investor pays or receives, and it may differ slightly from the price at which Ondo transacts in the underlying; any difference and any fees are retained by Ondo. Investors pay their own gas, and secondary-market venues may charge their own fees ([fees and taxes](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/fees-and-taxes); [overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/overview)).

Separately, "ondo" is one of the issuer values in Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network mint API, the broker-side flow in which an authorized participant's shares move to the issuer's Alpaca account before tokens are minted ([Alpaca mint API](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/posttokenizationmintbroker); [[build/trading-reference-architecture#primary-market-mint-and-redeem-broker-custodied-model|mint and redeem, step by step]]). That shows Ondo is set up as an ITN issuer, not which broker holds its backing assets.

On 12 Nov 2026 Ondo said it had already introduced in-kind conversion between tokenized stocks and underlying shares through Alpaca's ITN, adding a primary-market route alongside cash-funded minting. Approved institutions will be able to transfer existing shares from their Alpaca account and receive corresponding Ondo Stocks; redemptions on that route return shares rather than cash ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-as-collateral-on-spout)). That institutional path is distinct from direct mint and redeem on the Ondo platform, which still pay USDon or USDC.

The same post says Spout Finance will accept Ondo Stocks on Solana as collateral when it launches on Solana, with planned terms of USDC loans up to 50% LTV and no interest charged by Spout, funded by premiums from weekly covered calls sold on the underlying shares after an in-kind redemption into Spout's Alpaca brokerage account. If those calls are exercised, borrowers can be left with fewer tokens while their loan balance stays the same. Brokerage holdings and onchain records are to be reconciled before each options cycle. Spout's launch and lending terms are planned, as described by Ondo, not live ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-as-collateral-on-spout)).

## Who can buy Ondo Stocks?

Eligible non-US investors in supported jurisdictions. In several markets, only professional or qualified buyers. Ondo Stocks are not offered to US persons, to anyone acting for a US person, or to anyone placing a buy order from the United States. Ondo also prohibits subscribers, acquirers and redeemers in Canada and in a list of sanctioned or restricted jurisdictions that includes Afghanistan, Belarus, Cuba, Iran, Libya, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, and specified regions of Ukraine ([eligibility](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/eligibility); [legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)).

In Brazil, the EEA, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, buyers must meet a professional, qualified, accredited or equivalent test. Switzerland is entities only; Ondo says the tokens are not available to individuals there. Direct mint and redeem require [[concepts/glossary#kyc|KYC]] or KYB. As of 10 Nov 2026, Ondo's onboarding page says onboarding is open to institutional participants and to retail users and individuals in supported jurisdictions ([onboarding](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/onboarding-and-kyc); [eligibility](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/eligibility)). See also [[topics/who-can-buy|Who can buy]].

## Which chains are Ondo Stocks on?

Ondo Stocks are available on [[concepts/glossary#ethereum|Ethereum]], BNB Chain and [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] ([overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/overview)). The current Ondo API overview states that on-chain assets are issued as [[concepts/glossary#erc-20|ERC-20]] tokens for EVM-based chains and as SPL [[concepts/glossary#token-2022|Token-2022]] tokens on Solana ([API overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/api-reference/overview), retrieved 12 Nov 2026); the current Ondo Stocks overview and technical docs do not name the token standard. Select tokens are also transferable to HyperEVM and [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens|Robinhood Chain]] via bridge; Ondo says minting and redemption stay on Ethereum and BNB Chain for the Robinhood route ([overview](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/overview); [transferability](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/transferability); [Ondo blog, 27 Oct 2026](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-live-on-robinhood-chain-and-uniswap)). On 10 Nov 2026 Ondo said the Fidelity Center for Applied Technology (FCAT) is now a required verifier for Ondo Stocks transfers via the Ondo Bridge, with FCAT's LayerZero DVN participating alongside a quorum of verifiers: 35 Ondo Stocks to HyperEVM and all 450+ Ondo Stocks on other supported chains, in Ondo's wording (the vault already records 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs on Ondo's registry as of 10 Nov 2026). Cross-chain transfers are for eligible investors outside the United States ([Ondo blog, 10 Nov 2026](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-bridge-adds-fcat-as-required-verifier)).

As of 10 Nov 2026, Ondo's token registry lists 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs, plus 7 Ondo Intelligent Portfolios recorded as a separate product line ([token registry](https://docs.ondo.finance/partner-docs/tokens)). Older Ondo docs pages still say "100+"; that figure is stale and is not used here. A previous "450+" headline came from Zerion, a secondary source, and is superseded by the registry. Ondo says it currently tokenizes securities that trade on the NYSE and Nasdaq ([available assets](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/available-assets)).

## How are dividends and fees handled?

Dividends are reinvested, not paid out. Ondo Stocks track total return, net of withholding tax. Ondo Stocks are total-return trackers: dividends and similar income are reinvested in the underlying, net of withholding tax, so one token does not necessarily represent one share and the token price can diverge from the share price ([token and quote pricing](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/token-and-quote-pricing); [corporate actions](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/corporate-actions)). Ondo says the standard withholding rate on dividends from US companies to the BVI issuer is 30% ([fees and taxes](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/fees-and-taxes)). On Solana and BNB Chain, some wallets show a display [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]]; that changes the display only, not the onchain balance ([token and quote pricing](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/token-and-quote-pricing)). See also [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions and dividends]].

Trading may pause around ex-dividend dates and during other corporate actions; status is published at [status.ondo.finance](https://status.ondo.finance) ([corporate actions](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/corporate-actions)). Holders do not get shareholder voting or information rights ([legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)).

## When can Ondo Stocks be traded?

The platform is generally open from 8:05 pm ET Sunday to 7:59 pm ET Friday when US markets are open, across four sessions: pre-market, core, post-market and overnight, with the overnight session relying on the Blue Ocean ATS. A separate Off-Hours session covers weekends, market holidays and early-close days on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana. As of a 16 Nov 2026 snapshot of Ondo's Off-Hours docs, 32 assets were enabled (including AAPLon, NVDAon, TSLAon, SPYon, QQQon, IBITon and SPCXon); buys and sells are still quoted, minted and redeemed instantly, each asset has its own dynamic Off-Hours limit, and quotes can be declined at the limit, with spreads that may be wider. The enabled list and limits can change; current status is at [status.ondo.finance/market](https://status.ondo.finance/market) ([Ondo Off-Hours](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/off-hours-trading)). Trading halts outside regular hours and on NYSE holidays (except Off-Hours assets), at risk thresholds, for maintenance, and per asset during corporate actions ([market hours](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/market-hours-and-trading-availability)). Ondo said its tokenized stocks traded "about 10x its usual volume after the closing bell" on US election night, 4 Nov 2026 (company-reported, [Ondo on X](https://x.com/Ondo/status/2118090005071396987)). Ondo quotes are also reachable through Jito Labs' JTX RFQ terminal ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/jtx-equities-discoverability-rfq-execution-1650-tokenized-stocks), Jito-affiliated outlet); see [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].

On 7 Oct 2026 Assetera, an Austrian MiFID II firm, listed 100+ Ondo tokenized stocks and ETFs for eligible investors in 30 EEA countries, widening to 450+ through Q4 2026 ([Assetera](https://www.assetera.com/media/assetera-x-ondo)). Ondo's legal notice also says certain Ondo Stocks have been admitted to trading on Nest Exchange, a Binance-operated multilateral trading facility in Abu Dhabi Global Market ([Ondo Stocks](https://ondo.finance/ondo-stocks)).

On 27 Oct 2026 Ondo put 15 Ondo Stocks on [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens|Robinhood Chain]] via the Ondo Bridge (minting and redemption stay on Ethereum and BNB Chain). 11 of them, including NVDAon, SPYon, TSLAon and QQQon, sit in Uniswap v4 StablePair pools against the matching Robinhood Stock Token, with dynamic LP fees when the pair drifts from its expected rate. Ondo pitches this as a weekend supply and exit route while Robinhood's mint and redeem window is closed. Ondo also says it has \$1.3B in total value locked and over 450,000 cumulative holders (issuer claims) ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-live-on-robinhood-chain-and-uniswap)).

## How do Ondo Stocks compare with other tokenized-stock products?

Ondo Stocks are a synthetic / structured-note model: the token is a BVI note giving economic exposure, not title to the share ([[concepts/legal-taxonomy|legal taxonomy]]; [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|implementations by model]]). That is a different legal wrapper from [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]] (Jersey tracker certificates), [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens|Robinhood Stock Tokens]] (Jersey debt securities) and [[issuers/dinari|Dinari dShares]] (broker-dealer mirror records, with a US path). Like xStocks and Robinhood, Ondo excludes US persons; Dinari is the one in this set with a US route.

As of 10 Nov 2026 Ondo's registry lists 452 tokenized stocks and ETFs, more than the 131 assets on Kraken's xStocks FAQ as of 25 Oct 2026, but those counts are from different dates and should not be treated as a live league table ([Ondo registry](https://docs.ondo.finance/partner-docs/tokens); [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]]). For venue design and hours, see [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].

## What figures are published on size and trading?

Dated, attributed volume figures for Ondo Stocks and other venues are collected in [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue|Reported trading volume by venue]]; they are not like-for-like and are not a league table. Dated figures that are also on this page:

- On 14 Aug 2026 Ondo said Ondo Stocks had processed \$27B of cumulative trading volume since the September 2025 launch, across centralized exchanges, decentralized exchanges and primary mint/redeem activity, of which \$18B was CEX (company-reported, [Ondo PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ondo-stocks-surpasses-1-billion-in-value-as-ecosystem-surges-302852154.html)). An 11 May 2026 Ondo blog had an earlier \$18B cumulative total at the \$1B TVL mark ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-tokenized-stocks-surpass-one-billion-tvl)); that is not the same number as the August CEX subset.
- The IMF's October 2026 stability report put tokenized stocks at about \$2.3B in July 2026, with more than 70% from Ondo and xStocks, and said over half of tokenized-stock trading happened when US markets were closed ([IMF GFSR Oct 2026, ch. 3](https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/publications/gfsr/2026/october/english/ch3.pdf); also on the [[overview|overview]]).
- Bitquery estimated \$3.2B of tokenized stocks from six large issuers held outside issuer wallets on 31 Oct 2026; excluding exchange wallets, it put Ondo first at \$848M. That is a third-party on-chain estimate, not an issuer or regulator figure ([Bitquery](https://bitquery.io/investigations/tokenized-stocks-market-size); [[topics/who-can-buy|Who can buy]]).
- On 27 Oct 2026 Ondo claimed \$1.3B in total value locked and more than 450,000 cumulative holders (issuer claim) ([Ondo blog](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-live-on-robinhood-chain-and-uniswap)).
- Ondo said its tokenized stocks traded "about 10x its usual volume after the closing bell" on US election night, 4 Nov 2026 (company-reported, [Ondo on X](https://x.com/Ondo/status/2118090005071396987)).

## Anthropic IPO (legal model)
Ondo said on 6 Nov 2026 that Anthropic exposure would launch on IPO day through Ondo Stocks ([Ondo on X](https://x.com/Ondo/status/2118725675204919420)). Its 18 Nov 2026 release announced ANTon, "a token providing exposure to Anthropic stock", for "eligible investors outside the U.S.", from \$1, with zero mint fees and lowered redemption fees (network fees apply) and minting and redemption 24/7 ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html)).

Legally ANTon is an Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited token, not an Anthropic share. Ondo says its tokens "are not themselves stocks, ETFs or ADRs", that it "is not a participant in Anthropic's initial public offering", and that ANTon "is not issued, sponsored, or endorsed by Anthropic" ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html)). Anthropic's final prospectus (Form 424B4, 19 Nov 2026) lists the shares for Nasdaq under "ANT" and does not mention tokenized shares ([424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)). Separately, Anthropic's Help Center warns that third parties selling Anthropic shares to the public through "tokenized securities" are "likely offering an investment that may have no value due to our transfer restrictions"; that page is about private-stock transfers and does not mention Ondo or the IPO ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13704655-unauthorized-anthropic-stock-sales-and-investment-scams)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## What this means for holders
- You hold a structured note from a BVI [[concepts/glossary#spv|SPV]], described as [[concepts/glossary#bankruptcy-remote|bankruptcy-remote]] and overcollateralized by assets held at US [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealers]] ([Ondo docs](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)).
- Redeeming with Ondo on the direct platform path pays USDon or USDC, not the underlying share; you do not get shareholder voting or information rights ([investing and redeeming](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/investing-and-redeeming); [legal](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/legal-and-regulatory)). Ondo also describes an institutional in-kind conversion through Alpaca's ITN that returns shares rather than cash ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-as-collateral-on-spout)).
- Not offered to US persons; some other jurisdictions require professional or qualified status; buying from Ondo requires [[concepts/glossary#kyc|KYC]] ([eligibility](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/eligibility); [onboarding](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/onboarding-and-kyc)).
- Dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token may not equal one share ([fees and taxes](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/fees-and-taxes); [token and quote pricing](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/token-and-quote-pricing)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

## DTCC ecosystem
Ondo is named among the collaborators and partners in DTCC's Tokenization Service ecosystem at its 28 Oct 2026 launch ([[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC]]; [DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).

# Reality (rANT / rTokens)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/reality
description: Bitget says rANT is a token, issued by Reality, that tracks Anthropic stock 1:1.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: rANT listed on Bitget 19 Nov 2026, per Bitget; first trade time not confirmed in the retrieved articles
last_updated: 2026-11-21
last_checked: 2026-11-21

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** rANT listed on Bitget 19 Nov 2026, per Bitget; first trade time not confirmed in the retrieved articles  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-21  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Reality (rANT / rTokens) |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | rANT (Anthropic tokenized stock) and other rTokens, per Bitget |
| structure | Tokenized stock issued by Reality, per Bitget; Bitget says holding rANT is not equivalent to holding the share and does not automatically confer shareholder status or voting rights |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Eligible users in permitted regions, not residents of restricted jurisdictions, per Bitget's IPO Prime announcement; US eligibility is not stated in the retrieved articles |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Bitget says rANT is a token, issued by Reality, that tracks Anthropic stock 1:1. It is not the share itself, and Bitget says it does not automatically give you shareholder status or a vote.*

Reality is the issuer Bitget names for rANT, the Anthropic tokenized stock offered through Bitget's IPO Prime and listed on Bitget's spot market ([Bitget IPO Prime](https://www.bitget.com/spotlight/ipo-prime); [Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901016); [Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)). Bitget describes Reality as "a licensed RWA protocol." The retrieved pages do not give a legal entity name, jurisdiction or licence. A meta description on the rANT page also says "Reality Protocol."

## What does the holder have?

Bitget's rANT page says rANT "tracks the underlying ANT stock on a 1:1 basis" and "provides economic exposure to Anthropic stock, but holding rANT does not constitute direct ownership of Anthropic shares or confer shareholder voting rights" ([Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)). The 3 Nov IPO Prime announcement uses the same idea: "Holding rANT is not equivalent to directly holding Anthropic shares, and it does not automatically confer shareholder status, voting rights, or other rights. Specific rights, asset backing, and redemption arrangements are subject to the product documents" ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)). Those product documents were not retrieved.

Bitget's wording on backing is not identical across pages. The IPO Prime page says rANT is "issued by Reality, which custodies the underlying Anthropic shares" and that each token "maps 1:1 to a share and represents the holder's on-chain beneficial interest" ([Bitget IPO Prime](https://www.bitget.com/spotlight/ipo-prime)). The rANT page says "each tokenized stock is backed 1:1 by real shares held in custody with a licensed broker" and that Reality has a "partnership with compliant broker Alpaca" ([Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)). This page records both claims as Bitget's; it does not treat them as a single legal structure, and Alpaca has not been cited here in its own words.

The chain and contract address were not stated in the retrieved articles.

## Anthropic (rANT) and IPO Prime (19 Nov 2026)

Bitget announced on 3 Nov 2026 (10:00 UTC+8; 9:00 PM ET on 2 Nov) that the Anthropic IPO subscription was coming to IPO Prime, and that the asset delivered would be rANT ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)). The same announcement says the product "is not issued, offered, or managed by Anthropic," "has no official partnership or authorization relationship with Anthropic and has not been approved, sponsored, or endorsed by Anthropic."

A later announcement, timestamped 19 Nov 2026 06:59 UTC+8 (5:59 PM ET on 18 Nov), says Bitget "will list the stock spot asset rANT on November 19, 2026, with trading opening during US regular market hours" ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901016)). The 3 Nov announcement had said trading was "expected to open about one hour after the underlying stock completes its Nasdaq IPO Cross (opening auction)," subject to change. The retrieved articles do not confirm the first trade time.

On 19 Nov 2026 at 17:10 UTC+8 (4:10 AM ET), Bitget said it had "received a final allocation of 153,774 Anthropic shares": 137,494 in the VIP round at an 11.26% allocation rate, and 16,280 in the public round at 1.36%, with public-round distribution and refunds by 19 Nov 20:00 UTC (3:00 PM ET) and VIP by 20 Nov 16:00 UTC (11:00 AM ET), per Bitget ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105)). Those figures are Bitget's. The allocation article names "Anthropic shares" and IPO Prime; it does not name rANT or Reality.

See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]] and [[analyses/anthropic-ipo-tokenized-stock-use-case|Anthropic's IPO as a tokenized-stock use case]].

## What this means for holders
- Bitget says rANT is not the same as holding Anthropic shares and does not automatically confer shareholder status or voting rights ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381); [Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)).
- The product is available only to eligible users in permitted regions and is not offered to residents of restricted jurisdictions; the retrieved articles do not say whether US persons are included ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).
- Redemption and other rights are "subject to the product documents," which were not retrieved ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

# Robinhood Stock Tokens
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens
description: Robinhood's stock tokens are debt securities that track a stock's price. They give you no shareholder rights.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: Jersey
chain: Robinhood Chain
status: live
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** Jersey  
> **Chain:** Robinhood Chain  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Robinhood Stock Tokens |
| jurisdiction | Jersey |
| product_name | Stock Tokens |
| structure | Debt securities |
| chains | Robinhood Chain |
| who_can_buy | Not US, Canada, UK, Switzerland; other restrictions apply |
| num_assets | 190+ (Robinhood) |

*In plain English: Robinhood's stock tokens are debt securities that track a stock's price. They give you no shareholder rights.*

Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited under a [base prospectus](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf); they give economic exposure without rights in the underlying ([docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/); [product page](https://robinhood.com/rhj/stocktokens/)). Separately, EU **Classic** Stock Tokens are MiFID II derivatives ([FAQ](https://robinhood.com/eu/en/support/articles/stock-tokens-faq/)).

On Robinhood Chain, trading at launch is via [[concepts/glossary#rfq|RFQ]] plus [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMMs]] and Lighter, with onchain price feeds ([Robinhood](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/building-with-stock-tokens/)). Mainnet announcement: [Arbitrum](https://blog.arbitrum.io/robinhood-chain-mainnet/).

## How much do Robinhood Stock Tokens trade?
Bitwise's Q4 2026 staking report says issuer-matched DEX volume in Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain was \$526 million in July, \$2.21 billion in August and \$11.31 billion in September, or \$14.05 billion from 1 Jul to 30 Sep 2026, and that average daily volume rose just over 22x over those three months. The chain generated \$51.11 million in fees in that first quarter. Those monthly dollar figures are in the full report, which cites Allium; they are not on Bitwise's public summary page, and they match what [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html) cited on 21 Oct 2026. This is third-party analysis, not a Robinhood primary disclosure ([Bitwise full report](https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/static.bitwiseinvestments.com/Research/Bitwise-Staking-Report-Q4-2026.pdf); [summary page](https://bitwiseinvestments.com/crypto-market-insights/the-bitwise-staking-report-q4-2026); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html)). Dated volume figures for this and other venues are in [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue|Reported trading volume by venue]].

On 14 Sep 2026 Robinhood's CEO said in-kind redemption and voting are coming for Robinhood Stock Tokens ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/14/robinhood-plans-share-redemptions-voting-rights-for-stock-tokens-after-criticism), news). The current base prospectus, dated 25 June 2026, still excludes physical delivery of the underlying: at redemption, investors receive a cash amount in the specified currency ([base prospectus](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf), FAQ 3.10). Direct issuer redemption for ordinary holders is only available in limited no-authorised-participant or issuer-notice cases, plus KYC/AML.

Since 27 Oct 2026, 11 Robinhood Stock Tokens (e.g. NVDArh) have Uniswap v4 StablePair pools against the matching [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo]] token on Robinhood Chain. Ondo notes that when Robinhood's mint and redeem window is closed, Stock Tokens keep trading onchain but supply can't expand and holders can't redeem, which can cause price gaps; the pools give an exit through Ondo's 24/7 redemption ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-live-on-robinhood-chain-and-uniswap), issuer blog).

## Anthropic Stock Token (19 Nov 2026)
Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev posted on 19 Nov 2026 that Robinhood's Anthropic Stock Token was "already live on Robinhood Chain", adding that Stock Tokens "are tokenized debt securities" not available in the US or to US persons and restricted elsewhere, including Canada, the UK and Switzerland ([Vlad Tenev on X](https://x.com/vladtenev/status/2123560388318912562)). The Final Terms dated 19 Nov 2026 cover Series 218 (ISIN JE00C0C8R651), up to USD 5 billion of tokenised securities linked to Anthropic, PBC, issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited, with the securities ledger at 0xbbB6c29bCc3a1028A2B54310DF73F4F7A3bcB373 on Robinhood Chain. They name Bitstamp Global Ltd. as the only Authorised Offeror and Alpaca Securities LLC as custodian and broker, set the investor fee at 0.00% with no management fee, and base the redemption amount on the Nasdaq price. Collateral "primarily comprises the Underlying", and the shares "may be lent out to the Prime Borrower" against collateral. Investors "do not have any shareholder rights" and "are not entitled to exercise voting rights" ([Final Terms](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_final_terms_for_tokenised_debt_securities_linked_to_anthropic_pbc.pdf)). The issuer site lists a 0.05% redemption fee from 90 days after the date of issuance ([RHJ](https://docs.robinhood.com/rhj/product)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## What this means for holders
- Robinhood Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities from Robinhood Assets Jersey: you get economic exposure to the stock, with no rights in the underlying share ([Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/rhj/stocktokens/); [docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/)). Redemption is for cash only; physical delivery of the underlying is excluded ([base prospectus, 25 June 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf)). Ordinary holders generally sell on the secondary market.
- In the EU, Classic Stock Tokens are a separate product: MiFID II derivative contracts with Robinhood Europe. They cannot be redeemed for shares; you sell them back to Robinhood Europe in the app for euros (0.10% FX fee, €1 minimum) ([KID, 1 July 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/stock_tokens_kid_eu.pdf); [Robinhood EU FAQ](https://robinhood.com/eu/en/support/articles/stock-tokens-faq/)).
- Not offered to US persons ([Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/rhj/stocktokens/)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/securitize
description: Securitize acts as transfer agent and tokenization platform for funds and companies that issue tokens.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary)
status: live (Securitize Stocks launched 2026-10-08)
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary)  
> **Status:** live (Securitize Stocks launched 2026-10-08)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares) |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Securitize Stocks; issuer-sponsored tokenized shares |
| structure | Securitize Stocks: UCC Article 8 security entitlements, 1:1 backed, via Securitize's broker-dealer; also issuer-sponsored shares |
| chains | Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary) |
| who_can_buy | Eligible investors in the United States, the European Union and other permitted jurisdictions (Securitize, 2 Nov 2026) |
| num_assets | More than 50 U.S. equities (Securitize, 19 Nov 2026); 25 on 2 Nov 2026 |

*In plain English: Securitize acts as transfer agent and tokenization platform for funds and companies that issue tokens.*

Example: Exodus Class A common stock tokens on Algorand, with Securitize as [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/exodus-issues-security-token-on-algorand-expanding-access-to-the-growing-digital-security-ecosystem-301304582.html)); trading began on Securitize Markets in March 2022 ([Securitize](https://securitize.io/press-releases/exodus-begins-trading-on-securitize-markets)).

On 17 Nov 2026 Securitize said it had completed its acquisition of River One (River Credit Labs Inc.), a New York asset-backed warehouse lender founded in 2025 that aims to connect stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets; it is Securitize's first acquisition since becoming a public company in July 2026, and the release says River One's Harbor framework could bring structured credit products onchain for distribution through Securitize's existing infrastructure ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Completes-Acquisition-of-River-One-Expanding-Into-6-Trillion-Asset-Backed-Finance-Market/default.aspx)).

## What are Securitize Stocks?
Securitize Stocks, launched on 8 Oct 2026, are UCC Article 8 security entitlements to US stocks, 1:1 backed, held through Securitize's broker-dealer.

They launched on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]], settled in USDC, through Securitize's [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealer]]; Jump makes markets on the PropAMM; conversion to direct registration where available; an NYSE venue was planned in that launch release ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html); [RQD](https://rqdclearing.com/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-u-s-stocks-with-security-entitlements/)). The structure is called a convertible [[concepts/glossary#entitlement-token|entitlement token]] (CET). Securitize says it is open to eligible investors in the US, EU and other permitted jurisdictions, the backing shares will not be lent out, and lending and collateral use on markets like Aave is planned ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)). CoinDesk reported 12 companies at launch ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/10/08/securitize-brings-apple-nvidia-and-tesla-to-solana-with-nyse-trading-in-the-works), news). A 2 Nov 2026 Securitize release says a second wave adds 13 security-entitlement tokens on Solana, bringing the total offering to 25 stocks for eligible investors in the United States, the European Union and other permitted jurisdictions. The 13 names added are Arista Networks (ANET), Flex Ltd. (FLEX), Exxon Mobil (XOM), GameStop (GME), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), Lockheed Martin (LMT), Lumentum (LITE), Merck & Co. (MRK), Salesforce (CRM), Seagate Technology (STX), Texas Instruments (TXN), The Walt Disney Company (DIS) and Uber Technologies (UBER). The release says those join the original 12 launched in October: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOG, TSLA, META, AMZN, NFLX, CRCL, SPCX, MSTR and PLTR ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Expands-Onchain-U-S--Stock-Offering-to-25-Equities/default.aspx)).

Securitize's Q3 2026 10-Q says its broker-dealer, Securitize Markets, received FINRA approval to custody tokenized securities after SEC staff's December 2025 custody statement ([10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2094496/000162828026073910/secz-20260930.htm)).

On 16 Nov 2026, Apple's dividend pay date, Securitize paid that dividend in USDC on Solana to holders of its Apple token; see [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends#securitize-apple-dividend-16-nov-2026|Corporate actions]] for the reported figures ([Bitquery](https://bitquery.io/investigations/securitize-apple-dividend-onchain); [Carlos Domingo on X](https://x.com/carlosdomingo/status/2123822462194643349)).

On 11 Nov 2026 OKX said Securitize will provide the tokenization infrastructure for [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]], with trading due to begin on 23 Nov 2026. Each token on that venue will represent a security entitlement backed one-to-one by an underlying U.S. share, with applicable shareholder rights including dividends, voting and corporate actions ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)). That is a tokenizer role for the TSV, distinct from Securitize Stocks on Solana.

## Anthropic (ANT) on Securitize Stocks (19 Nov 2026)
On 19 Nov 2026, Anthropic's first day of trading, Securitize said Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT) was available through Securitize Stocks on Solana, alongside new additions Amgen and Fox, bringing the offering to more than 50 U.S. equities. It describes the tokens as "security entitlements, not shares registered directly in the holder's name, backed 1:1 by corresponding underlying securities held through Securitize Markets' brokerage infrastructure", offered through Securitize Markets, LLC, a FINRA/SIPC member broker-dealer, to "eligible investors in the United States, European Union (EU) and other permitted jurisdictions". "Rights" means "applicable economic benefits and voting entitlements passed through under the product terms"; holders "are not registered shareholders of Anthropic, and Anthropic has not sponsored, authorized or endorsed Securitize Stocks". Jump Trading supports liquidity, transactions settle in USDC, and trading "is initially available beyond traditional market hours, with plans to move toward 24/7 availability" ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Tokenizes-Anthropic-Stock-Onchain-on-First-Day-of-Public-Trading/default.aspx)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## TSV APIs and CET infrastructure (13 Nov 2026)
A 13 Nov 2026 article on Securitize's Medium publication describes infrastructure and APIs that TSV operators can integrate under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). Current developer documentation is at [developers.securitize.io](https://developers.securitize.io) (retrieved 13 Nov 2026).

In that article, CET is used both as a custodial entitlement token — a [[concepts/glossary#security-entitlement|security entitlement]] to a real share held through a broker-dealer and custody structure — and, "at Securitize," as a convertible [[concepts/glossary#entitlement-token|entitlement token]], designed so a CET can later convert into an issuer-sponsored token while keeping the same onchain identity ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). The convertible structure was already described in the 8 Oct 2026 launch release above.

The article names three APIs. Current docs describe them as follows ([Securitize docs](https://developers.securitize.io)):
- **SecId API** (called SecID in the article): investor onboarding, screening, eligibility and wallet permissioning, including a hosted onboarding option. The docs are not labelled Beta. They say Securitize can rely on a platform's existing identity verification, subject to an agreement, and still screens every investor against sanctions and PEP lists ([Securitize docs](https://developers.securitize.io/secid-api/overview); [Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)).
- **CET Underlying API**: authorized market makers buy and sell the underlying stocks or ETFs over an authenticated WebSocket, and Securitize mints or burns the corresponding CETs to match. The docs are not labelled Beta. The article says minting and burning happen through Securitize, outside the TSV, and that this separation matters under the Innovation Exemption, which restricts primary issuance activity on the venue ([Securitize docs](https://developers.securitize.io/cet-underlying-api/overview); [Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)).
- **Corporate Actions API**: event-driven information on corporate actions, dates and terms, changes, and trading restrictions such as halts, with signed webhooks, replay and a sandbox of scripted scenarios. The current overview is labelled **Beta**: the API and its webhooks are in development and subject to change, and paths, fields, enumerations and event names can change before 1.0.0 ([Securitize docs](https://developers.securitize.io/corporate-actions-api/overview); [Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)).

The same documentation site also has a **Stocks API**, for trading tokenized US-listed stocks, issuer-sponsored tokens and convertible entitlement tokens for investors onboarded through the SecId API. The current overview is labelled **Beta**: the endpoints are being opened to partners through the partner gateway, and paths, fields and errors can change before release. Production access requires a UI audit by Securitize Compliance of the live screens, including disclosures and market data (NBBO included) ([Securitize docs](https://developers.securitize.io/stocks-api/overview)).

On splits, the article says that on supported EVM deployments Securitize uses display [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multipliers]] based on the ERC-8056 approach, and on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] it can use Scaled UI Amount, so the economic representation can change without liquidity providers withdrawing and recreating positions ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). Dividends and other entitlements, in the same article, are handled through Securitize's corporate-actions processing rather than described as reinvested into that multiplier.

The article says this is the mechanism Securitize is using to support the [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]] launch, and the same infrastructure it is leveraging in its work supporting [[platforms-venues/formation-securities|Formation's TSV]], "enabling both stocks and ETFs to trade through the same CET infrastructure" ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). The OKX tokenizer role is already recorded from OKX's 11 Nov 2026 announcement above ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)). The stocks-and-ETFs wording is Securitize's description; Formation's official 9 Nov 2026 notice names only three Tokenized NMS Stocks for launch (FWDI, GLXY and EXOD) and does not mention ETFs ([[platforms-venues/formation-securities|Formation Securities]], [Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).

The article also says the exemption requires a public notice at least 30 calendar days before operations start, and that the SEC expects the venue to be operationally ready when that notice is published. The notice period is not the build window: the integration should be ready before filing ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). The services described are subject to regulatory requirements, agreements, eligibility criteria and technical availability, and TSV operators remain responsible for the exemption conditions ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)).

On 12 Nov 2026 Securitize filed a comment letter on the Innovation Exemption (File 4-927). It supports testing AMM-based TSVs and says it does not itself need the relief, because it already trades tokenized securities onchain under existing rules. The letter asks the SEC to require permissioning in the token itself rather than only in a pool allowlist, with freeze, burn and reissue as the fallback; to explicitly permit PropAMMs; to define "permissionless" with objective criteria; and to let issuers waive the 30-day wait by affirmative consent ([Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-32/4927-1134705-4042498.pdf)). That is advocacy, not a change to the order; see [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]].

## What this means for holders
- Securitize Stocks are UCC Article 8 security entitlements backed 1:1, held through Securitize's broker-dealer, on Solana and settled in USDC ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)).
- Where available, holders can convert to direct registration, i.e. hold the share on the company's register ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)).
- Eligible investors in the US, EU and other permitted jurisdictions, subject to local rules ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)).
- The shares backing the tokens are not lent out ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html)).

## NYSE digital transfer agent
On 24 Mar 2026 NYSE named Securitize the first digital transfer agent eligible to mint blockchain-native securities for corporate or ETF issuers on its planned tokenized securities platform, with Securitize Markets expected to join as a broker-dealer ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/New-York-Stock-Exchange-and-Securitize-Agree-to-Memorandum-of-Understanding-to-Support-Tokenized-Securities/default.aspx)). By 2 Nov 2026 NYSE had five more transfer agent partners ([[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#transfer-agent-partners|NYSE / ICE]]).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

## DTC direct-registration comment letter (25 Oct 2026)
Securitize's issuer-sponsored tokens (ISTs) record the investor, not [[concepts/glossary#cede--co|Cede & Co.]], as the registered holder on the issuer's books ([Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/SR-DTC-2026-012/srdtc2026012-1108719-3924407.pdf)). To turn an existing brokerage position into an IST, the shares must first leave [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] through the [[concepts/glossary#direct-registration-system-drs|Direct Registration System (DRS)]], which today can take several days ([Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/SR-DTC-2026-012/srdtc2026012-1108719-3924407.pdf)). Securitize supports DTC's proposal to cut DRS processing "from days to minutes" ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)) but asked the SEC for more ([Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/SR-DTC-2026-012/srdtc2026012-1108719-3924407.pdf)):
- One instruction that burns a DTC-tokenized position and starts the DRS withdrawal, with a real-time completion message to the transfer agent ("Instant Burn-and-Notify").
- Published DRS processing targets and operating hours, reporting of actual times by stage, and the same modernization for [[concepts/glossary#dwac|DWAC]].
- A timing expectation for brokers to submit customer withdrawal requests, or letting the transfer agent start one on the investor's documented authorization.
- An equally fast path back to [[concepts/glossary#street-name|street name]].
- The tokenization link live by the commercial launch of DTCC's tokenization service, or a published timeline or follow-on filing within three months.

See [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC / DTC tokenization pilot]]. Context: Brett Redfearn's [LinkedIn post](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/time-dtc-modernization-now-brett-w-redfearn-a3tse) (28 Oct 2026, opinion).

# Superstate Opening Bell
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/superstate-opening-bell
description: Superstate's Opening Bell puts real company shares on a blockchain, with Superstate keeping the official shareholder register.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Ethereum, Solana
status: live
last_updated: 2026-11-18
last_checked: 2026-11-18

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Ethereum, Solana  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-18  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Superstate Opening Bell |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Tokenized company shares (e.g. GLXY) |
| structure | Actual company shares (e.g. Galaxy Class A common) |
| chains | Ethereum, Solana |
| who_can_buy | KYC-verified investors in self-custody wallets |
| num_assets | 3 on RWA.xyz |

*In plain English: Superstate's Opening Bell puts real company shares on a blockchain, with Superstate keeping the official shareholder register.*

Galaxy (GLXY) Class A common stock is tokenized on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] via Opening Bell; Superstate, an SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]], updates ownership records ([Galaxy](https://www.galaxy.com/newsroom/galaxy-superstate-launch-glxy-tokenized-public-shares); [Superstate docs](https://docs.superstate.com/investors/tokenized-equities)).

Superstate acts as SEC-registered transfer agent and keeps the cap table onchain ([Superstate](https://www.superstate.com/opening-bell)). Galaxy's research describes [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allowlisted]] self-custody and transfer-agent mechanics ([Galaxy](https://www.galaxy.com/insights/research/tokenized-glxy)); launch exhibit on EDGAR ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859392/000185939225000052/galaxyxsuperstateoblaunchf.htm)).

## FundOS: a registered fund's official register (Nov 2026)
Superstate's FundOS platform now also runs a registered fund. Invesco's Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund (IROXX), a Rule 2a-7 government money market fund launched 17 Nov 2026 and aimed at stablecoin reserves, is the first publicly registered fund on FundOS ([Invesco](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/invesco-launches-the-invesco-stablecoin-reserves-onchain-fund-bringing-invescos-established-liquidity-management-onchain-302941734.html)). It is a fund, not a stock, but its prospectus spells out the register design ([IROXX prospectus, 485BPOS](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/205007/000110465926117813/tm2627770d1_485bpos.htm)):
- Superstate, as sub-transfer agent, keeps the official record. The Ethereum token records "together with an off-chain register associating wallet addresses with shareholder personal identifying information, will constitute the official shareholder register."
- Only wallets on an allowlist can hold shares. Superstate's smart contracts enforce transfer restrictions, can freeze shares, and can burn and re-mint them if a holder loses control of the wallet.
- Orders must reach Superstate by 5:00 p.m. ET for that day's NAV; purchases in USDC go through a third-party intermediary, and holders pay gas for their own transactions.

## Exposure on Solana (announced 16 Nov 2026)
Superstate, Formation (described in the release as "Formation by Orca") and Corda announced Exposure, which the release calls the official Solana RWA Launchpad. It is a design, not a live product: as of the release, no Exposure Token was live, and the first was "expected to go live in the coming weeks" ([Superstate](https://superstate.com/newsroom/superstate-formation-and-corda-join-forces-to-launch-exposure-the-official-solana-rwa-launchpad)).
- **Permissioned at the edges.** Third-party issuers mint each Exposure Token against tokenized real-world assets, at launch funds tokenized with Superstate. Only authorized non-US persons can mint and burn ([Superstate](https://superstate.com/newsroom/superstate-formation-and-corda-join-forces-to-launch-exposure-the-official-solana-rwa-launchpad); [Exposure](https://exposuretokens.com/)).
- **Open in the middle.** Once minted, Exposure Tokens "are permissionless": they can trade on Solana DEXs and be used in lending markets, vaults and Earn products ([Exposure](https://exposuretokens.com/)).
- **What a holder has.** The disclaimer says holders "have no claim on any backed asset, on the issuer, or on Superstate," and tokens "may trade at prices that differ from the value of any backed asset." Superstate says it is only a technology provider here and does not act as transfer agent for Exposure Tokens ([Superstate](https://superstate.com/newsroom/superstate-formation-and-corda-join-forces-to-launch-exposure-the-official-solana-rwa-launchpad)).

## What this means for holders
- Tokenized GLXY is the actual Class A share recorded by Superstate as SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]]: a [[concepts/glossary#native-token|native token]], not a [[concepts/glossary#wrapper|wrapper]] ([Galaxy](https://www.galaxy.com/newsroom/galaxy-superstate-launch-glxy-tokenized-public-shares)).
- You need [[concepts/glossary#kyc|KYC]] and a self-custody [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallet]] ([Superstate docs](https://docs.superstate.com/investors/tokenized-equities)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# xStocks (Backed)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/xstocks-backed
description: xStocks are tokens, issued by Backed, that are backed one-for-one by listed stocks and ETFs, now including a first batch of UK and EU names.
type: issuer
jurisdiction: Jersey
chain: Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, X Layer, OP Mainnet (native mint and redeem, Optimism Foundation blog, 12 Nov 2026), (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025)
status: live (since 2025-06-30)
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** Jersey  
> **Chain:** Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, X Layer, OP Mainnet (native mint and redeem, Optimism Foundation blog, 12 Nov 2026), (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025)  
> **Status:** live (since 2025-06-30)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | xStocks (Backed) |
| jurisdiction | Jersey |
| product_name | xStocks |
| structure | Tokenized certificates/tracker tokens backed by custodied securities |
| chains | Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, X Layer, OP Mainnet (native mint and redeem, Optimism Foundation blog, 12 Nov 2026), (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025) |
| who_can_buy | Eligible non-US persons; excluded in US, UK, Canada, Australia and sanctioned jurisdictions |
| num_assets | Company counts differ by source and date: Kraken FAQ listed 131 as of 25 Oct 2026; Payward's 11 Nov 2026 UK/EU release claims more than 1,500 tokenized assets; Payward's 11 Nov 2026 DAX 40 release claims more than 1,300 xStocks; the 12 Nov 2026 Optimism blog claims 1,500+ (attributed there to Dune) |

*In plain English: xStocks are tokens, issued by Backed, that are backed one-for-one by listed stocks and ETFs, now including a first batch of UK and EU names.*

xStocks are stock and ETF tokens issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, backed 1:1 by the underlying asset. They launched on Bybit, Kraken and [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] DeFi on 30 June 2025 ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

On 2 December 2025 Kraken announced it **agreed to acquire** Backed Finance AG ([Kraken](https://blog.kraken.com/news/backed-acquisition); [Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251202666578/en/Kraken-to-Acquire-Backed-Accelerating-xStocks-Expansion-and-Unlocking-Global-Demand-for-Tokenized-Equities)); completion status not confirmed here.

At that date xStocks offered more than 60 assets, live on Solana and [[concepts/glossary#ethereum|Ethereum]]. xStocks are not available in the US ([Kraken press release](https://www.payward.com/press-release/kraken-acquires-backed-xstocks-expansion)). Kraken's xStocks FAQ listed 131 assets (100 stocks, 27 ETFs, 4 specialist assets) on Solana, Ethereum, TON and Ink as of 25 Oct 2026, for eligible non-US clients in 110+ countries; not the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).

On 11 Nov 2026 a Payward press release said xStocks had deployed its first batch of tokenized equities representing UK and European publicly listed assets, a first wave of 200+ companies listed in the UK and EU, with further listings to be added on a rolling basis. The release does not name the individual UK or EU issuers. It says the new tokens are available to trade across Kraken and supporting xStocks Alliance platforms from day one, and in the DeFi ecosystems where xStocks already trade, including Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, X Layer and other chains. Payward reports that this launch takes xStocks past 1,500 tokenized assets in total, with over $1.1 billion in assets under management, total transaction volume past $45 billion, and more than 550,000 unique holders; those figures are company-reported ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)). The $45 billion cumulative mark was first stated in a 28 Oct 2026 Payward release ([Payward, 28 Oct](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-surpasses-1-billion-aum)). Dated volume figures, and earlier company marks, are in [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue|Reported trading volume by venue]]. A figure of 1,100 assets advertised earlier elsewhere ([Zerion](https://zerion.io/blog/best-tokenized-stock-platforms/), secondary) is unverified and is not used.

The same release describes the UK and EU names as the first expansion markets under Payward Services' partnership with GTN, "which handles global execution and custody of the traditional assets that underpin each token." That is Payward's description of the partnership; this page does not treat it as an independently confirmed custody chart for every historic xStock, and earlier issuer docs did not name a custodian. The release also says each issued token is matched by a purchase of the underlying share "held at a regulated custodian," without naming the firm in that sentence ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)). Payward says hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities will follow in the coming weeks, and that in 2027, subject to regulatory approval, the London Stock Exchange intends to list xStocks and start trading them on LSE 24. Distribution and eligibility are unchanged, and the tokens remain unavailable to investors in the United Kingdom and are not available in the U.S. or to U.S. persons ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)).

A separate Payward release, also dated 11 Nov 2026, says xStocks has deployed tokenized equities representing every constituent of the DAX 40, as part of that UK and EU expansion. The DAX 40 tokens "will be immediately available on 360X, a company of Deutsche Börse Group, as well as Xetra-Gold as xStocks." Named examples available from day one include SAP (SAPx), Siemens (SIEx), Allianz (ALV.DEx) and Deutsche Telekom (DTE.DEx). The same release describes 360X as "the Deutsche Börse-backed venue regulated under the EU's DLT Pilot Regime since February 2026," and says xStocks already trade there; that is Payward's description of the venue, not a claim that the DAX 40 admission itself is a new Pilot Regime authorisation ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-dax-40)). Catalog figures in this DAX 40 release, company-reported as of 11 Nov 2026, are "more than 1,300 xStocks," "over \$1 billion" in assets under management, "more than \$45 billion of total transaction volume," and "more than 500,000 unique holders." Those counts differ from the same-day UK/EU release ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)) and should be quoted with this date, not flattened into one current number.

On 12 Nov 2026 the Optimism Foundation, in a joint announcement with xStocks and ether.fi, said xStocks' full catalog of 1,500+ tokenized equities has been natively minted and redeemed on OP Mainnet for several months, with no OFT bridge in the path, and that the teams were confirming that publicly that day. The post says the catalog covers the full Russell 1,000 plus examples such as NVDAx, TSLAx, QQQx, SPYx and TBLLx. ether.fi, which had offered wrapped xStocks in a summer 2026 release, went live with native mint and redeem in-app that day. The post also says xStocks is deployed on 12 chains and cites Dune for the 1,500+ catalog count and for "\$46B+" total transaction volume since June 2025; it does not list the 12 chains ([Optimism](https://optimism.io/blog/xstocks-native-op-mainnet-ether-fi-launch)). Quote those figures with this 12 Nov 2026 date. The post also says xStocks are not available in the US, the UK, or other restricted jurisdictions.

Separately, Kraken's xStocks FAQ, last updated 11 Nov 2026, says underlying shares are held by Alpaca Securities LLC (FINRA-regulated, SIPC member), with supplemental coverage by Lloyd's of London up to $175 million aggregate, and names InCore Bank as a secondary custodian. It also says the SPV structure is designed so that if Kraken or Backed goes bankrupt, users can still claim the underlying value of their assets directly with Alpaca. That is Kraken's FAQ wording. It is not in the official xStocks issuer FAQ, which still refers to "regulated custodians" without naming them ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq); [xStocks FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions)). These company statements are recorded side by side, not reconciled here.


Corporate actions use a [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/developers/multipliers)): dividends are reinvested net of withholding and raise the multiplier ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/dividends-and-stock-splits)); holders get no voting rights ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)); see [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]]; exchange integration and API: [integration](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/exchange-integration), [OpenAPI](https://docs.xstocks.fi/apis/openapi.md).

## Primary market and trading routes
"xstocks" is one of the issuer values in Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network mint API, in which an authorized participant's shares move to the issuer's Alpaca account before tokens are minted to the AP's wallet ([Alpaca mint API](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/posttokenizationmintbroker); [[build/trading-reference-architecture#primary-market-mint-and-redeem-broker-custodied-model|mint and redeem, step by step]]). That shows xStocks is set up as an ITN issuer, not which custodian holds all backing shares. xStocks also quote into Jito Labs' JTX RFQ terminal on Solana ([SolanaFloor](https://solanafloor.com/news/jtx-equities-discoverability-rfq-execution-1650-tokenized-stocks), Jito-affiliated outlet).

Alpaca's co-founder Hitoshi Harada told The Block on 17 Nov 2026 that the network has processed more than \$10B in cumulative minting and redemption (excluding secondary trading), that xStocks was a launch partner in 2025, and that Alpaca has more than 90% of custody of the shares backing tokenized stocks offered outside the US. These are Alpaca's own claims, not independently verified ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-17-alpaca-says-tokenization-network-tops-10-billion-minting-redemption-volume-442667)).

**Anthropic IPO (legal model):** xStocks' Anthropic token, ANTx, reached customers through three distributors, each described by that distributor. These are Backed tracker certificates, not Anthropic shares.
- **Kraken "IPO Access"** (support article updated 12 Nov 2026): eligible clients outside the US, UK, Canada, Japan, Australia and New Zealand submit interest at the offering price plus a 5% spread; allocation "is not guaranteed" and "is decided by the IPO underwriters based on demand"; unallocated funds are refunded. Kraken says each xStock is "backed 1:1 by the underlying share, held in custody by a regulated entity (Backed Assets (JE) Limited)", gives "price exposure only" and carries no voting rights ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access)).
- **Binance Wallet campaign (reported):** Bitcoin.com and CoinDesk report that Binance Wallet's Anthropic xStocks campaign gave price exposure without voting or dividend rights, that the reserves may be cash or other assets rather than the shares, and that xStocks may deliver bStocks instead of ANTx. Binance's own FAQ page could not be retrieved, so these terms are reported, not confirmed ([Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/exchanges/binance-wallet-500m-anthropic-ipo-xstocks-token-sale/); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/19/cz-says-tokenized-anthropic-is-coming-to-bnb-chain-on-ipo-day)).
- **OKX xANT:** OKX's "Unified Tokenized Stocks" asset, "powered by xStocks"; OKX says it "is not a token issued by OKX", does not confer ownership or voting, and includes a right to withdraw xStocks on Solana or X Layer ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/help/okx-to-list-xant-for-spot-trading-and-convert-ant-pre-ipo-futures)).
- **Outcome (19 Nov 2026):** xStocks said it "received an allocation" but could "only partially fulfill xStocks IPO Access requests", with funds for unfilled requests "released in full" and no fees charged ([xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208)). Binance Wallet returned all USDC committed to its campaign and delivered about 2,957 tokens, which it labels ANTB (bStocks), plus a separate ANTB airdrop ([Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/f37d1230c2e542fbb1872fcde3ebf140); [Binance Wallet](https://t.me/binance_wallet_announcements/1955)).

Anthropic's 424B4 does not mention tokenized shares ([Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)), and its list of authorized retail-offering brokers names no tokenizer or crypto platform ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

## What this means for holders
- You hold a 1:1-backed [[concepts/glossary#wrapper|wrapper]] certificate issued by Backed Assets (Jersey), not the share itself ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq); [xStocks FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions)).
- After KYC, you can redeem with the issuer for USDC, USDG or USDT ($5,000 minimum stated for direct issuer flow; fees currently 0) or, via xPort after Alpaca onboarding, for the underlying shares in an Alpaca brokerage account ([FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions); [Market Flow](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/market-flow); [xPort](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/in-kind-flow-xport)). Most users exit on secondary markets.
- Dividends and splits are reflected by adjusting the token's [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/dividends-and-stock-splits)).
- Not offered in the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).
- Tokens can be withdrawn to a self-custody [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallet]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# 21X
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/21x
description: 21X runs a regulated EU market where orders are matched and settled by smart contracts on the blockchain itself, not on a private server.
type: venue
jurisdiction: EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime, BaFin/ESMA oversight)
chain: unknown (multi-chain; pilot on a private-permissioned instance of Zero)
status: Live in the EU; onchain CLOB pilot on Zero reported 4 Nov 2026
last_updated: 2026-11-09
last_checked: 2026-11-09

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime, BaFin/ESMA oversight)  
> **Chain:** unknown (multi-chain; pilot on a private-permissioned instance of Zero)  
> **Status:** Live in the EU; onchain CLOB pilot on Zero reported 4 Nov 2026  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-09  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | 21X |
| jurisdiction | EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime, BaFin/ESMA oversight) |
| product_name | DLT Trading and Settlement System (DLT TSS) |
| structure | Regulated DLT trading and settlement venue with a fully onchain central limit order book |
| chains | unknown (multi-chain; pilot on a private-permissioned instance of Zero) |
| who_can_buy | Whitelisted wallets of admitted participants |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: 21X runs a regulated EU market where orders are matched and settled by smart contracts on the blockchain itself, not on a private server.*

21X AG says it was the first venue licensed under the EU [[concepts/glossary#dlt-pilot-regime|DLT Pilot Regime]] to run both trading and settlement, opening its DLT Trading and Settlement System in September 2025 under BaFin and ESMA oversight ([21X](https://21x.eu/21x-ag-and-layerzero-deliver-institutional-grade-onchain-trading-pilot-on-private-permissioned-deployment-of-zero/)). The system combines a DLT multilateral trading facility and a DLT settlement system ([21X docs](https://docs.21x.eu/participant-docs/participant-docs)).

## How it works
- **Matching:** a fully onchain central limit order book. Order entry, matching and settlement run on the blockchain for security-token-to-[[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoin]] pairs, with deterministic matching and [[concepts/glossary#atomic-settlement|atomic settlement]] ([21X](https://21x.eu/smart-contracts-and-the-role-of-regulated-market-infrastructures/)).
- **Access:** only whitelisted wallets can interact with the contracts. Admin keys use multi-signature protection, and an emergency circuit breaker can pause the system ([21X](https://21x.eu/smart-contracts-and-the-role-of-regulated-market-infrastructures/)).
- **Participants:** issuers, listing sponsors, trade participants, orderflow providers, market makers and liquidity providers, and stablecoin issuers ([21X docs](https://docs.21x.eu/participant-docs/participant-docs)).

## Zero pilot (Nov 2026)
On 4 Nov 2026 21X and LayerZero reported a month-long pilot on US equity tokens that ran 21X's order book on a private-permissioned instance of LayerZero's Zero chain with no offchain matching. **Company-reported figures:** 10,000 order matches per second, "up to a 45x improvement" over the L2 EVM baseline, with matching and settlement in the same transaction ([21X](https://21x.eu/21x-ag-and-layerzero-deliver-institutional-grade-onchain-trading-pilot-on-private-permissioned-deployment-of-zero/); [LayerZero](https://layerzero.network/blog/21x-zero-trading-pilot)). It was a pilot; 21X keeps operating its live venue on its existing chains alongside it ([21X](https://21x.eu/21x-ag-and-layerzero-deliver-institutional-grade-onchain-trading-pilot-on-private-permissioned-deployment-of-zero/)).

How this compares with other venue designs: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]] and [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].

## What this means for holders
- Trading happens only between whitelisted wallets, and each trade settles at once against a stablecoin ([21X](https://21x.eu/smart-contracts-and-the-role-of-regulated-market-infrastructures/)).
- The throughput numbers come from 21X and LayerZero and were not independently tested ([21X](https://21x.eu/21x-ag-and-layerzero-deliver-institutional-grade-onchain-trading-pilot-on-private-permissioned-deployment-of-zero/)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

## Sources

*In plain English: Bitget ran an Anthropic IPO subscription through IPO Prime and said it would list rANT, a Reality token, for spot trading on 19 Nov 2026 during US market hours.*

Bitget is a crypto exchange. The retrieved sources cover only its Anthropic IPO Prime offering and the rANT spot listing, not Bitget's wider business.

## IPO Prime

IPO Prime is "Bitget's global asset subscription platform, focused on investment opportunities in companies before listing and during their initial public offering (IPO)." For the IPO section, Bitget says "subscriptions are settled at the official issue price, and allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real shares" ([Bitget IPO Prime](https://www.bitget.com/spotlight/ipo-prime)).

The Anthropic round, announced 3 Nov 2026 (10:00 UTC+8), had a VIP round (eligible VIP1–VIP7 users; $100 to $3,000,000 per person; $1,000,000,000 total commit cap; 12% underwriting fee) and a public round (all eligible users; $100 to $25,000; $200,000,000 cap; 5% fee), settled in USDT or USDGO at the final IPO issue price plus applicable fees, allocated pro rata, with the total commitment cap "not represent[ing] the platform's allocation" ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)). Bitget says the product is available only to eligible users in permitted regions and "is not offered to residents of restricted jurisdictions." It does not name those regions in the announcement, including whether US persons can take part.

On 19 Nov 2026 at 17:10 UTC+8 (4:10 AM ET), Bitget said it had "received a final allocation of 153,774 Anthropic shares": VIP 137,494 shares at 11.26%, public 16,280 shares at 1.36%, with public-round distribution and refunds by 19 Nov 20:00 UTC and VIP by 20 Nov 16:00 UTC, per Bitget ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105)). Those figures are Bitget's.

## rANT listing

Bitget said it "will list the stock spot asset rANT on November 19, 2026, with trading opening during US regular market hours" ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901016)). The earlier IPO Prime announcement had expected trading to open "about one hour after the underlying stock completes its Nasdaq IPO Cross (opening auction)," subject to change. The retrieved articles do not confirm the first trade time. Bitget's rANT page describes a rANT/USDT spot pair ([Bitget rANT page](https://www.bitget.com/price/anthropic-tokenized-stock-reality)). The issuer Bitget names is [[issuers/reality|Reality]].

See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]] and [[analyses/anthropic-ipo-tokenized-stock-use-case|Anthropic's IPO as a tokenized-stock use case]].

## What this means for holders
- IPO Prime delivered a token (rANT), not Anthropic shares, per Bitget ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603899381)).
- Bitget published a 153,774-share allocation and said unallocated subscription funds would be refunded by the stated UTC deadlines ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603901105)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.
