# Bullish Exchange
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bullish
description: Bullish runs a crypto exchange in Gibraltar where its own shares now trade as tokens that are real, registered shares.
type: venue
jurisdiction: Gibraltar
chain: unknown
status: live (first trades 2026-08-12)
last_updated: 2026-11-09
last_checked: 2026-11-09

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** Gibraltar  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** live (first trades 2026-08-12)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-09  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Bullish Exchange |
| jurisdiction | Gibraltar |
| product_name | Tokenized BLSH shares |
| structure | Issuer-sponsored shares recorded at the registry level |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | 1 (BLSH) at launch |

*In plain English: Bullish runs a crypto exchange in Gibraltar where its own shares now trade as tokens that are real, registered shares.*

On 12 Aug 2026 market participants traded Bullish's tokenized BLSH shares on Bullish Exchange, settled against a USD stablecoin; Bullish says this was the first tokenized equity traded on a Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) regulated digital asset exchange ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)). Bullish says it received GFSC approval for tokenized securities trading in June 2026 (not confirmed on a GFSC page), and the registry side depends on its pending acquisition of Equiniti ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).

On 24 Sep 2026 Bullish and Equiniti formed the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]] to set standards for [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]]. Bullish expects its \$4.2B Equiniti acquisition, agreed in May 2026, to close in January 2027 ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)).

On 9 Nov 2026 Bullish appointed Stacey Cunningham, former President of NYSE Group, as its President, as it "advances its strategy to connect traditional capital markets infrastructure with blockchain technology" ([Bullish](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/09/3398203/0/en/bullish-appoints-former-nyse-president-stacey-cunningham-as-president.html)).

## Why it matters
- **The register.** Bullish is buying Equiniti, a transfer agent that keeps companies' official shareholder records, for \$4.2B. The deal is expected to close in January 2027 ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)). Once it closes, Bullish will own the business that records who holds the shares. Equiniti is also one of NYSE's transfer agent partners for issuer-sponsored tokens as of 2 Nov 2026, so it backs a rival venue too ([[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#transfer-agent-partners|NYSE / ICE]]; [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/)).
- **The model the rules favor.** The SEC's [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] requires a tokenized stock to carry the same rights as the share, and lets issuers object to tokens made without them ([SEC order](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/exorders/2026/34-106402.pdf)). Through the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]], Bullish pushes tokens issued by the company itself and tied to its register ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)).
- **No objection problem.** Third-party tokens can be blocked: 67 issuers had objected to [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE]] by 5 Nov 2026 ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)). Issuer-sponsored tokens skip that step.
- **First live example.** Canton Strategic Holdings (CNTN) is sponsoring its own token on [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc|TSV LLC]], with Fairmint as transfer agent ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm); [TSV notice](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)). That deal doesn't involve the coalition.
- **Nothing issued yet that we've found.** We haven't found any security issued through the coalition so far. It's a non-binding working group ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)).
- *Analysis, not reported fact:* if issuer-sponsored tokens catch on, Bullish could earn twice, from register and tokenization work through Equiniti and from trading on its exchange. Bullish hasn't said this.

## What this means for holders
- The tokens are issuer-sponsored and recorded at the share registry, so holders own shares directly, not a wrapper or derivative ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).
- Only BLSH trades this way so far; trading runs 24/7 with near-instant settlement ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Formation Securities TSV
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/formation-securities
description: Formation Securities has filed to run a US onchain stock venue on Solana under the SEC's Innovation Exemption.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States (TSV Exemption)
chain: Solana
status: TSV notice published 2026-11-09; trading not commenced as of that notice
last_updated: 2026-11-13
last_checked: 2026-11-13

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (TSV Exemption)  
> **Chain:** Solana  
> **Status:** TSV notice published 2026-11-09; trading not commenced as of that notice  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-13  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Formation Securities TSV |
| jurisdiction | United States (TSV Exemption) |
| product_name | Formation Securities Tokenized Securities Venue |
| structure | Permissioned concentrated-liquidity AMM (licensed Orca) plus licensed Orca router, on Solana |
| chains | Solana |
| who_can_buy | Permissioned retail and institutional participants after KYC/KYB, sanctions, AML/CFT and wallet screening; tokenizer approval also required to hold tokens |
| num_assets | 3 named for launch (EXOD, FWDI, GLXY); not yet trading |

*In plain English: Formation Securities has filed to run a US onchain stock venue on Solana under the SEC's Innovation Exemption. Trading had not started as of its 9 Nov 2026 notice, which describes permissioned Orca liquidity pools.*

[[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice by Formation Securities LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and wholly owned subsidiary of Valcrest, Inc., dated 9 Nov 2026, under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)). The SEC lists it as the fourth written notice of intent to operate as a TSV, with a 9 Nov 2026 submission date ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/about/divisions-offices/division-trading-markets/innovation-exemption)). Inclusion on that list does not mean the person meets the TSV definition or the exemption conditions ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/about/divisions-offices/division-trading-markets/innovation-exemption)). Neither Formation nor the TSV is registered with the SEC in any capacity for the activities performed under the TSV Exemption, and the SEC has not passed upon the merits or accuracy of the notice ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).

## How it works
- Permissioned [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMM]] liquidity pools on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]], using licensed versions of the permissioned concentrated-liquidity AMM ("Orca AMM") smart contracts developed by Orca Management Company S.A., together with a licensed version of Orca's router (the "Formation Router"). Only the TSV may create those pools, and only wallets permissioned by the TSV may trade or provide liquidity ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- The TSV will not operate an order book, hold or take custody of participants' assets or private keys, extend credit, or conduct primary offerings. The interface is non-custodial: a participant connects a wallet it or its custodian controls ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Each pair is one Tokenized NMS Stock against a non-security crypto asset or a tokenized money market fund. Trades settle atomically on Solana, or neither leg moves ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Wallet and transfer restrictions are enforced with Solana Token Extensions (Token-2022) transfer hooks. Prices in the pools come from a concentrated-liquidity formula; the notice says the TSV's smart contracts do not use pricing oracles. The Formation Router is an offchain route-selection service; quotes are expected to refresh after about 15 seconds ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Hours are 24 hours a day, seven days a week, subject to trading stoppages. The TSV will pause trading when the underlying NMS stock is halted or suspended on its primary listing exchange, including Limit Up-Limit Down pauses, and when required by the exemption's volume caps. During a stoppage, liquidity providers may withdraw liquidity but may not deposit or reposition it ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Tokenized NMS Stock may be tokenized by or on behalf of the issuer or by an unaffiliated third-party tokenizer. For third-party tokens, the TSV will give the required issuer notice and will not start trading until the notice period has elapsed without a timely objection. Before admission, the TSV will review evidence that the token provides the same rights and privileges as traditional NMS stock of the equivalent class. Neither the TSV nor any affiliate issues or tokenizes the stocks traded on it. As of the 9 Nov 2026 notice, the TSV had not received a Notice of Issuer Objection ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- The notice says the TSV does not intend to be the exclusive trading venue for any Tokenized NMS Stock ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Service providers named in the notice include Predicate (identity verification), TRM Labs (wallet screening), Orca (AMM and router), Solidus Labs (market surveillance) and Sec3 (smart-contract audit), plus cloud and Solana infrastructure providers ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).

## Named launch stocks and company-release plans
The 9 Nov 2026 notice says the TSV intends to make the following Tokenized NMS Stocks available upon launch: Forward Industries, Inc. (FWDI), Galaxy Digital Inc. (GLXY) and Exodus Movement, Inc. (EXOD). It will update the notice before adding any further stock or paired asset. The notice does not say trading has started and does not give a launch date ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).

A company press release the same day, not the official notice, says trading is expected to begin in early 2027; Superstate and Securitize are expected to make tokenized shares available; and verified investors are expected to be able to access the venue through the Formation platform and additional channels including Alpaca, Passage by CoinList, Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A., BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, Fireblocks, Jito's JTX, Solflare and Squads ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/formation-securities-notifies-sec-of-intent-to-operate-first-tokenized-securities-venue-on-solana-302932902.html)). Those are company plans, subject to the release's forward-looking-statements caveat. The release's headline calls this the first TSV on Solana; that "first" wording is the company's, not the official notice or the SEC list.

A 13 Nov 2026 Securitize article says Securitize is leveraging the same CET infrastructure in its work supporting Formation's TSV, "enabling both stocks and ETFs to trade through the same CET infrastructure" ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). That is Securitize's description. Formation's official 9 Nov 2026 notice names only three Tokenized NMS Stocks for launch (FWDI, GLXY and EXOD) and does not mention ETFs ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).

How other TSV designs compare: [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]]. The exemption itself: [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]].

## What this means for holders
- This is a planned venue, not a tokenizer. As of the 9 Nov 2026 notice, trading had not commenced ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Only permissioned, screened wallets can trade, and a tokenizer must also approve a wallet before it can hold that tokenizer's Tokenized NMS Stock ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- The TSV itself does not hold customer assets or keys, and it does not issue the tokens ([Formation notice](https://www.formationsecurities.com/notice.pdf)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

- <https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/formation-securities-notifies-sec-of-intent-to-operate-first-tokenized-securities-venue-on-solana-302932902.html>

# Equity perps (Hyperliquid HIP-3, Ostium)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps
description: these are bets on a stock or index price, settled in stablecoins. You never own the share, and no one holds a share for you.
type: venue
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Hyperliquid (HyperCore), Arbitrum (Ostium)
status: Live (docs read 9 Nov 2026)
last_updated: 2026-11-19
last_checked: 2026-11-19

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Hyperliquid (HyperCore), Arbitrum (Ostium)  
> **Status:** Live (docs read 9 Nov 2026)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-19  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Equity perps (Hyperliquid HIP-3, Ostium) |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetuals (e.g. trade[XYZ] 'xyz'); Ostium perpetual instruments |
| structure | Synthetic perpetual futures on equities and indices; no share custody |
| chains | Hyperliquid (HyperCore), Arbitrum (Ostium) |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: these are bets on a stock or index price, settled in stablecoins. You never own the share, and no one holds a share for you.*

Perpetual futures ("perps") give price exposure without any share behind them: a [[concepts/glossary#synthetic-wrapper|synthetic]] model in the [[concepts/legal-taxonomy|legal taxonomy]]. Two onchain designs:

## Hyperliquid HIP-3
- Builders deploy their own perp markets on HyperCore. The deployer defines the market (including the [[concepts/glossary#oracle|oracle]]) and operates it: it sets oracle prices and leverage limits and can settle the market with `haltTrading` ([Hyperliquid docs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals)).
- HyperCore supplies the order book, margining and liquidation. Deployers must stake 500k HYPE on mainnet, and validators can slash that stake for malicious or irregular operation ([Hyperliquid docs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals)).
- Example: trade[XYZ]'s `xyz` deployment sets listings, oracle sources, leverage and trading sessions; HyperCore runs matching, margin, liquidations, funding and settlement onchain; trade[XYZ] relayers publish oracle and mark prices about every three seconds ([trade[XYZ] docs](https://docs.trade.xyz/architecture)).

## Ostium
- Perps on stocks, ETFs, indices, commodities, FX and crypto that settle in USDC on Arbitrum ([Ostium docs](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)).
- Ostium's in-house consensus oracle has several publishers pull market feeds and sign prices, which are fetched when a trader opens a position ([Ostium docs](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)).
- Directional flow is hedged offchain with institutional partners. A daily settlement run moves USDC between the onchain vault and the offchain hedging book ([Ostium docs](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)).

## Off-hours demand (attributed)
Around the US election results (4-5 Nov 2026), analyst Tom Wan reported that the trade[XYZ] S&P 500 perp on Hyperliquid did \$458M of volume overnight, 5.7x a normal night ([Tom Wan on X](https://x.com/tomwanhh/status/2118301097131418094), third-party figure, unverified). For tokenized stocks, Ondo said Ondo Stocks traded "about 10x its usual volume after the closing bell" on election night ([Ondo on X](https://x.com/Ondo/status/2118090005071396987), company-reported).

## Pre-IPO perpetuals (trade[XYZ])
trade[XYZ] lists pre-IPO perps, including "ANT" referencing one Anthropic Class A share. Its docs say they "are not shares", "not IPO allocations" and not "tokenized equity, securities entitlements, or rights to receive any security", and give no ownership, voting, dividend or allocation rights. After the stock lists and external data suffices, the contract is "expected to convert into a normal equity perpetual", "typically the first regular session after listing"; the specification page gives up to 60 days (no later than 19 Jan 2027) for a listing before alternative settlement applies ([trade[XYZ] docs](https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

See [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]] and [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]]. Dated, attributed volume figures for trade[XYZ] and other equity perps — which are notional and not comparable to spot tokenized-stock volume — are in [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue#synthetic-equity-perps-not-spot-tokens|Reported trading volume by venue]].

## What this means for holders
- A perp position is a contract on price, not a share: no shareholder vote and no redemption into stock ([Hyperliquid docs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals); [Ostium docs](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)).
- Prices come from the deployer's or protocol's oracle, not from the stock exchange directly ([Hyperliquid docs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals); [Ostium docs](https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals>
- <https://docs.trade.xyz/architecture>
- <https://docs.ostium.com/protocol/how-ostium-works>
- <https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/static.bitwiseinvestments.com/Research/Bitwise-Staking-Report-Q4-2026.pdf>
- <https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md>

# Kraken
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/kraken
description: Kraken is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.
type: venue
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: live (xStocks listed 2025-06-30)
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** live (xStocks listed 2025-06-30)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Kraken |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | xStocks listing |
| structure | unknown |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Eligible non-US clients; EEA clients after a questionnaire, fiat-only via Convert |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Kraken is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.*

Kraken listed xStocks on 30 June 2025 with 24/5 trading and withdrawals ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

On 18 Aug 2026 Kraken opened 7,000+ US-listed stocks to eligible EEA customers under MiFID II through Payward Europe Digital Solutions (CY) Limited, next to 700+ xStocks in the same account ([Kraken](https://blog.kraken.com/product/equities/announcing-us-listed-stock-trading-for-eea-customers)). EEA clients must pass a questionnaire and can trade xStocks only with fiat via Convert, not on Pro order books or the API ([Kraken support](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-availability)).

Kraken said on 22 Oct 2026 that its xStocks lineup exceeds 1,000 tokenized instruments ([The Defiant](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/kraken-says-its-xstocks-lineup-now-exceeds-1-000), news; not yet confirmed on a Kraken page). A Payward press release on 11 Nov 2026 said a first batch of tokenized UK and EU-listed equities is available to trade across Kraken from day one ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-uk-eu-equities)); see [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]].

On 12 Nov 2026 Kraken's support pages described "IPO Access" for Anthropic: eligible clients outside the US, UK, Canada, Japan, Australia and New Zealand submit interest in ANTx (an xStocks token) at the offering price plus a 5% spread, with allocation "decided by the IPO underwriters" and refunds for unallocated funds ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access)). Kraken also lists pre-IPO perpetual futures on Anthropic (PF_ANTHROPICXUSD, settled 13 Nov; PF_ANTXUSD, to convert to an xStock perpetual "once there is a viable index") that give no right to shares or tokenized equities ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/pre-ipo-perpetual-futures-faq)). See [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]].

On 19 Nov 2026 xStocks said it could only partially fill IPO Access requests, releasing reserved funds for unfilled requests with no fees ([xStocks on X](https://x.com/xStocksFi/status/2123440937213059208)); Kraken's updated support article tells participants to check their email for allocation information and gives no fill rate ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access)).

On 18 Nov 2026 Payward, Inc. said it had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Tribe Capital Management, Inc., a venture capital and asset manager with \$2.7 billion in assets under management; Tribe is expected to operate within Payward's Asset Management pillar, and Payward said it plans to develop private-market offerings that connect investment origination and asset management with capabilities across custody, trading, collateral, and tokenization. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions including required consents; financial terms were not disclosed, and no tokenized product was announced ([Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/payward-to-acquire-tribe-capital)). CNBC reported that Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi is also chairman and co-founder of Tribe ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/acquisition-of-tribe-capital-flags-new-chapter-in-evolution-of-crypto-exchanges.html)).

## What this means for holders
- Kraken lists xStocks, so what you hold is an xStock with Backed's terms: see [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]].
- Trading is 24/5 and tokens can be withdrawn to a self-custody [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallet]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Nasdaq tokenized securities rule
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities
description: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18
last_updated: 2026-11-09
last_checked: 2026-11-09

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-09  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Nasdaq tokenized securities rule |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | SR-NASDAQ-2025-072 |
| structure | Same security, tokenized form; same CUSIP/ticker/rights, same order book |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | DTC Pilot eligible participants |
| num_assets | Russell 1000 constituents + certain ETPs |

*In plain English: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.*

The SEC approved Nasdaq's rule on 18 March 2026, enabling tokenized trading during [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]]'s tokenization pilot ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).

Original notice: [SEC Rel. 34-103989](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2025/34-103989.pdf). The approval keeps tokenized shares on the same book with the same priority, [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]], symbol and rights, settling through the DTC pilot; see [[concepts/post-trade-reg-nms-model|post-trade / Reg NMS model]].

On 10 Sep 2026 Nasdaq agreed to invest \$100M in Payward, Kraken's parent, to build Nasdaq Equity Tokens (NETs) linked to xStocks; NETs are expected in Q2 2027 ([Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/nasdaq-deepens-relationship-payward-advance-tokenized-equities-and-always)).

## Comment letter on transfer agent rules (5 Nov 2026)
In its letter on the SEC's proposed transfer agent rules (File S7-2026-30), Nasdaq asks the SEC to require interoperability among onchain and offchain master securityholder files, tokenized and non-tokenized settlement rails, and the national clearance and settlement system, and to require fungibility at the recordkeeping layer, consistent with the trading-layer fungibility in its tokenization plans ([Nasdaq letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1122619-3995826.pdf)). It also argues issuers should be able to choose the transfer agent that keeps the master file separately from tokenization agents, custodians and venues. This is advocacy, not law; see [[topics/regulation|Regulation]].

## What this means for holders
- A tokenized share on Nasdaq trades on the same order book, with the same [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]], symbol and shareholder rights as the regular share ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).
- Settlement runs through the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] tokenization pilot, so the token is an entitlement recorded via DTC ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

- <https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-03-23/html/2026-05563.htm>
- <https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/nasdaq-receives-sec-nod-trading-tokenized-securities-2026-03-18/>

# NYSE / ICE tokenized securities
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform
description: NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: Settlement ledger: Avalanche (for the clearing firm); issuance: multiple chains (unnamed)
status: rule filed; platform in development
last_updated: 2026-11-13
last_checked: 2026-11-13

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** Settlement ledger: Avalanche (for the clearing firm); issuance: multiple chains (unnamed)  
> **Status:** rule filed; platform in development  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-13  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | NYSE / ICE tokenized securities |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | SR-NYSE-2026-17; planned 24/7 platform |
| structure | Same security, tokenized form (DTC pilot); planned 24/7 venue |
| chains | Settlement ledger: Avalanche (for the clearing firm); issuance: multiple chains (unnamed) |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot. Separately it is building a 24/7 tokenized platform whose trades are to be recorded and settled on an Avalanche-based ledger.*

NYSE filed SR-NYSE-2026-17 (Rel. 34-105260), an immediately effective rule along the lines of Nasdaq's and tied to the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] pilot ([NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/markets/nyse/rule-filings/sec-approvals/2026/%28SR-NYSE-2026-17%29_34-105260.pdf)).

Separately, ICE announced on 19 Jan 2026 that NYSE is developing a platform for 24/7 trading of tokenized equities and [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] with instant settlement and [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoin]] funding, subject to approval and DTC readiness ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/The-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Develops-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/)).

## Settlement ledger: Avalanche
On 9 Nov 2026 NYSE said Avalanche "will provide the core ledger technology for the clearing firm on the NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform", which is designed, subject to regulatory approvals, to support 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement for its subscribers ([NYSE on X](https://x.com/NYSE/status/2119812983224213903)). NYSE's advisory describes the platform as an upcoming [[concepts/glossary#ats|ATS]] and the aim as bringing clearing of tokenized equities onchain ([NYSE](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/avalanche-to-support-nyses-affiliated-upcoming-digital-ats-nyse-content-update-302933387.html)); Ava Labs describes the same clearing-ledger role ([Ava Labs](https://www.avalanche.com/about/blog/wall-streets-next-chapter-is-being-built-on-avalanche)).

Avalanche is the settlement ledger, not the only chain. The venue is meant to support stocks issued on a range of blockchains, while the Avalanche-based ledger records and settles trades (news reports: [The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-09-nyse-settle-tokenized-stocks-avalanche-planned-24-7-market-436208); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/09/nyse-picks-avalanche-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-amid-wall-street-s-blockchain-race)). Trades are to be matched on NYSE's existing technology, which CoinDesk names as its Pillar trading engine (news reports: [The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-09-nyse-settle-tokenized-stocks-avalanche-planned-24-7-market-436208), citing The Wall Street Journal; [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/09/nyse-picks-avalanche-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-amid-wall-street-s-blockchain-race)). NYSE's Dennis Lee said the ledger that records and settles trades needs to be fast, reliable, predictable in cost and able to control who participates ([Ava Labs](https://www.avalanche.com/about/blog/wall-streets-next-chapter-is-being-built-on-avalanche)).

The Wall Street Journal reports Avalanche will be the only chain used for settlement on the planned platform (issuance remains multi-chain) and that NYSE picked it after testing several providers, citing speed, throughput and support for a permissioned network that meets compliance rules ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/finance/regulation/nyse-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-on-avalanche-blockchain-038ce412)).

On 9 Nov 2026 Avalanche also published an Avalanche Originals interview with Michael Blaugrund of the New York Stock Exchange, with an official transcript on the episode page (the YouTube video was uploaded at 7:59 AM ET that day) ([Avalanche Originals](https://www.avalanche.com/originals/the-invisible-layer-of-global-financial-infrastructure/)). Blaugrund said onchain settlement and onchain post-trade are "really the unlock." He described NYSE's matching system, Pillar, as processing "millions of messages per second, with tens of microseconds in latency," and said that after the trade "the post trade systems are running on mainframes" and "we can do better now." He said the NYSE tokenized equities platform is going to allow 24/7 trading, fractional share orders, orders "on dollar terms instead of share quantity terms," and "settlement versus stablecoin," which he called attractive retail use cases. The first thing an ordinary investor would notice, he said, is that after selling a stock "they could immediately use that cash to buy another stock, to withdraw, purchase something in the real economy," an instant reuse that had until then been available only for digital assets. He said transactions on the platform must be "reliable, dependable, and regulatory compliant," and that "Avalanche checks a lot of those boxes in a way that many other protocols don't yet do."

Dennis Lee also said, in a 9 Nov statement, "At the NYSE, we're looking at how blockchain technology can expand what we offer in equities, and we're picking the right technology for each job" ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/09/nyse-picks-avalanche-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-amid-wall-street-s-blockchain-race)). In a 10 Nov Cointelegraph interview, John Nahas of Ava Labs said "The NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche" ([Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/interview/ava-labs-nyse-general-purpose-chains)). On 9 Nov he told Paul Barron that Ava Labs had been "working with the team at NYSE for over a year, give or take" ([Paul Barron](https://www.paulbarronnetwork.com/network-update/nyse-chooses-avalanche-for-tokenized-equities-interview-ava-labs-john-nahas)). That duration is Ava Labs' account. It is consistent with Charley Cooper's earlier remark to The Block in September ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-09-nyse-settle-tokenized-stocks-avalanche-planned-24-7-market-436208)) and with the Journal's report that NYSE tested several providers, but NYSE itself has not published a testing timeline.

On the same Paul Barron show, Nahas said "the exclusivity refers to the fact that they are building their own layer one blockchain on Avalanche" (formerly called a subnet), "powered by the Avalanche network," and that this "will be the backbone of their 24-7 ATS system." He also said "every L1 will burn a specific amount of AVAX per validator that they run," and declined to discuss NYSE-specific token operations until those come from NYSE. Official NYSE and ICE materials published as of 13 Nov 2026 describe Avalanche as the core ledger technology for the clearing firm and do not themselves call that ledger an Avalanche layer-1 or describe an exclusivity arrangement. Avalanche's NYSE page defines an Avalanche L1 in a general FAQ but does not say the NYSE platform is one ([Avalanche](https://www.avalanche.com/nyse/)). Those points are therefore recorded as Ava Labs' claims.

No technical spec has been published, and the clearing firm is not named. The Wall Street Journal reports a fourth-quarter launch target but the year is not stated ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/finance/regulation/nyse-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-on-avalanche-blockchain-038ce412)); NYSE and ICE have not given a launch date. Asked about timing, Nahas said he did not want to get ahead of NYSE and left it to the exchange and its regulators ([Paul Barron](https://www.paulbarronnetwork.com/network-update/nyse-chooses-avalanche-for-tokenized-equities-interview-ava-labs-john-nahas)). As of 13 Nov 2026 the platform still needs regulatory approval ([NYSE on X](https://x.com/NYSE/status/2119812983224213903)).

## Transfer agent partners
For [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]], the company's [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] mints the token and keeps the official record, so NYSE is lining up approved "digital transfer agents". As of 2 Nov 2026 there are six:

- **Securitize** (24 Mar 2026): first digital transfer agent eligible to mint blockchain-native securities for corporate or ETF issuers, and design partner for NYSE's digital transfer agent standards. Securitize Markets is expected to be a broker-dealer on the platform ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/New-York-Stock-Exchange-and-Securitize-Agree-to-Memorandum-of-Understanding-to-Support-Tokenized-Securities/default.aspx)). See [[issuers/securitize|Securitize]].
- **tZERO** (31 Aug 2026): design partner for transfer agent and broker-dealer infrastructure, expected to be designated an approved digital transfer agent once requirements are met. ICE is also investing in tZERO and licensing its blockchain patents ([tZERO](https://www.tzero.com/news/tzero-and-ice-agree-to-collaborate-on-infrastructure-for-public-tokenized-securities-markets)). See [[infrastructure/tzero|tZERO]].
- **Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate** (2 Nov 2026) joined the network ([NYSE on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/for-more-than-two-centuries-the-nyse-has-ugcPost-7523072207032619009-W2YY/); [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/)). Per NYSE, Broadridge, Computershare and Equiniti together serve nearly 5,000 listed companies, including almost 99% of the S&P 500 ([Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/)). Equiniti is being bought by [[platforms-venues/bullish|Bullish]] and co-founded the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]].

Broadridge will also run on-chain shareholder voting for the platform: governance smart contracts tie tokens to meeting agendas, voting rules and results, and holders vote through supported wallets, broker apps or ProxyVote ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)). See [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]].

No release from NYSE or ICE on the 2 Nov additions was on ICE's press page as of 2 Nov 2026; the partner list comes from NYSE's own post and press coverage.

## What this means for holders
- NYSE's rule SR-NYSE-2026-17 follows Nasdaq's and is tied to the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] pilot ([NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/markets/nyse/rule-filings/sec-approvals/2026/%28SR-NYSE-2026-17%29_34-105260.pdf)).
- If your company's shares are tokenized through one of NYSE's six digital transfer agents, the token is meant to carry the same votes and dividends as a regular share, and Broadridge plans to handle on-chain voting ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx); [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/)).
- The planned 24/7 tokenized platform is subject to regulatory approval, so holders cannot use it yet ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/The-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Develops-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/)).
- Per Blaugrund, that platform is also meant to allow fractional share orders, dollar-denominated orders, settlement versus stablecoin, and immediate reuse of sale proceeds, once it is approved ([Avalanche Originals](https://www.avalanche.com/originals/the-invisible-layer-of-global-financial-infrastructure/)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# OKXICE TSV
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/okxice-tsv
description: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States (TSV Exemption)
chain: XLayer
status: Announced launch beginning 2026-11-23
last_updated: 2026-11-14
last_checked: 2026-11-14

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (TSV Exemption)  
> **Chain:** XLayer  
> **Status:** Announced launch beginning 2026-11-23  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-14  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | OKXICE TSV |
| jurisdiction | United States (TSV Exemption) |
| product_name | Tokenized Securities Venue |
| structure | Permissioned AMM (Uniswap v4 hook) |
| chains | XLayer |
| who_can_buy | Eligible U.S.-based OKX Inc. customers who have activated a CeDeFi Wallet, completed identity verification and completed onboarding with OKXICE; access also uses soulbound tokens per the TSV notice |
| num_assets | More than 70 assets expected to be listed (OKX, 11 Nov 2026) |

*In plain English: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools. OKX has announced that trading for eligible U.S. customers is due to begin on 23 November 2026.*

The first public [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], dated 4 Oct 2026 ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)). Design per the notice: Uniswap v4 pools with an OKXICE TSV hook, access via soulbound tokens, pairs against USDC/USDG/USDT, no order book and no custody; it describes admin-key governance.

The notice lists 63 symbols for 62 companies, since Alphabet has two share classes (GOOG and GOOGL) (counted from the [OKXICE notice, 4 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)). Cerebras is not among them; OKXICE's own notices list it as an objector (see below). Coverage: [Ledger Insights](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/ice-okx-venture-plans-trading-of-tokenized-us-stocks-via-uniswap-pools/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/okx-ice-uniswap-v4-hooks-tokenized-stocks/) (news).

## When does OKXICE TSV launch?
On 11 Nov 2026 OKX published an announcement that, beginning 23 Nov 2026, eligible U.S. customers will be able to trade digital securities around the clock through the OKXICE Tokenized Securities Venue, directly in the OKX app. More than 70 assets are expected to be listed, including securities from Better.com, BitGo, Circle, Coinbase, Robinhood, Securitize and Strategy, as well as 59 Direxion ETFs; Strategy will also list its preferred stocks ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)). A spokesperson said not all of those assets will be available at the start ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/10/okxice-to-debut-tokenized-stock-trading-with-strategy-coinbase-circle-this-month)). The official post does not give a clock time on 23 Nov.

[[issuers/securitize|Securitize]] will provide the tokenization infrastructure. Each token will represent a security entitlement backed one-to-one by an underlying U.S. share, with applicable shareholder rights and economic benefits, including dividends, voting rights and participation in corporate actions. A 13 Nov 2026 Securitize article says Convertible Entitlement Tokens (CETs) are "the mechanism we're using to support the OKXICE TSV launch," and that the same infrastructure can enable "both stocks and ETFs to trade through the same CET infrastructure" ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). That is Securitize's description of its tokenizer role. Trading will take place through automated market maker liquidity pools built on Uniswap v4 on X Layer. Customers will hold the tokens in self-custodial wallets; the venue will hold neither their assets nor their private keys. Access is limited to eligible U.S.-based OKX Inc. customers who have activated a CeDeFi Wallet and completed onboarding with OKXICE; it requires identity verification and is subject to geographic and other eligibility requirements. The venue's smart contracts restrict trading and liquidity provision to eligible wallets ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)). The same announcement's footer says the venue is offered by OKXICE LLC under a temporary SEC exemption, is not a registered exchange or broker-dealer, and is not approved by the SEC.

As of the 5 Nov 2026 notice, Coinbase Global, Robinhood Markets, Circle Internet Group, Strategy Inc., Securitize Corp. and BitGo Holdings appear on OKXICE's 4 Oct list of Tokenized NMS Stocks to be made available for trading, and none of them is among the 67 issuers listed as objectors ([OKXICE notice, 4 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf); [OKXICE notice, 5 Nov](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)). Better.com and the 59 Direxion ETFs named in the 11 Nov announcement were not on that 4 Oct list.

CoinDesk described OKXICE as set to be the second venue to start under the Innovation Exemption, following Canton-based TSV LLC earlier in November ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/10/okxice-to-debut-tokenized-stock-trading-with-strategy-coinbase-circle-this-month)). That ranking is CoinDesk's.

A Reuters item, captured via [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/okxice-to-launch-247-trading-in-tokenized-us-securities-5018819) syndication because the [original Reuters URL](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/okxice-launch-247-trading-tokenized-us-securities-2026-11-11/) returned HTTP 401 (paywalled) on 11 Nov 2026, also reports the 23 Nov launch.

## Which issuers have objected to OKXICE trading their stock?
OKXICE's public notice of 5 Nov 2026 lists **67** issuers that objected (Alphabet counted once), up from 50 on 30 Oct. The 17 additions include Amazon, Apple, Tesla, Netflix, Meta, Palantir, S&P Global, KLA, Super Micro, Nebius, Boeing, ServiceNow, Lam Research, Home Depot, GE Vernova and SpaceX. That notice itself gave no trading start date ([OKXICE notice, 5 Nov](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)). The same notice describes the venue as Uniswap v4 pools on XLayer, a public blockchain, with 24/7 operation planned ([OKXICE notice, 5 Nov](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)). A later OKX announcement of 11 Nov set a beginning date of 23 Nov 2026 (see [[#when-does-okxice-tsv-launch|When does OKXICE TSV launch?]]).

CoinDesk tallied objections from 56 of the 62 companies on the original list, which differs from the 67 objectors on the 5 Nov notice; CoinDesk also reported that total objections reached 67, including companies outside that initial selection ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/10/okxice-to-debut-tokenized-stock-trading-with-strategy-coinbase-circle-this-month)). This page keeps the notice's count of 67.

Applied Optoelectronics is the one issuer in this record to have given an on-the-record reason. A spokesperson previously told Fortune that the framework's potential impact on the stock's pricing, liquidity and volatility remained unclear, and that the company was concerned investors might mistakenly believe it sponsored or endorsed the offering: "At this stage, we don't see a clear benefit to AOI or our shareholders that justifies these uncertainties" ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/11/05/apple-home-depot-list-objectors-tokenized-stock-plan-nyse-owner/), 5 Nov 2026). Fortune's own objector counts in that article differ from the 5 Nov notice and are not used here.

OKXICE's public notice of 30 Oct 2026 lists **50** issuers that objected, up from 38 on 28 Oct. New since 28 Oct: CrowdStrike, Corning, Micron, IREN, USA Rare Earth, Bloom Energy, NIKE, NVIDIA, Palo Alto Networks, Costco, Reddit and Hewlett Packard Enterprise. That notice also gave no trading start date ([OKXICE notice, 30 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.30.pdf)).

OKXICE's public notice of 28 Oct 2026 lists **38** issuers that objected, up from 22 on 23 Oct. New since 23 Oct: IBM, IonQ, Oracle, Intel, JPMorgan, AMD, Applied Materials, Coca-Cola, Adobe, Dell, Sandisk, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, Walmart and Cigna. That notice also gave no trading start date ([OKXICE notice, 28 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.28.pdf)).

OKXICE's public notice of 23 Oct 2026 lists **22** issuers that objected: Cerebras (CBRS), AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, Verizon, Applied Optoelectronics, Broadcom, UnitedHealth, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's, Western Digital, Alphabet (GOOG/GOOGL), Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell ([OKXICE notice, 23 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.23.pdf)).

The first 16 were already on its 19 Oct notice; Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell are new ([OKXICE notice, 19 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.19.pdf)). Wells Fargo and Arm were not on the 4 Oct list, so not every objection removes a listed stock ([OKXICE notice, 4 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf); [OKXICE notice, 23 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.23.pdf)). CNBC's 21 Oct count of 16 matches the 19 Oct notice ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html), news).

Cerebras appears as an objector even though it was not among the 63 symbols in the 4 Oct notice; neither notice says why (possibly an objection filed ahead of a listing; unverified). Under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] the venue must notify each issuer and wait 30 days after receipt before trading ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html)). Per Nasdaq's issuer FAQ, objections go directly to the venue that sent the notice and count only for that venue; there is no blanket opt-out across all TSVs ([Nasdaq FAQ](https://www.nasdaq.com/docs/listings/faq-sec-innovation-exemption)).

## ICE investment in OKX (March 2026)
On 5 Mar 2026, before the TSV notices, Intercontinental Exchange announced a strategic relationship and a minority investment in OKX at a stated \$25 billion valuation, with the terms undisclosed, and said ICE would have a board seat on OKX's board. ICE said the minority position was not expected to have a material impact on its 2026 financial results or capital return plans ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/ICE-Makes-Investment-in-OKX-Establishing-Strategic-Relationship/)). That investment is separate from the 50/50 OKXICE LLC joint venture that operates this venue, which is described in later OKXICE notices (see [[#which-issuers-have-objected-to-okxice-trading-their-stock|Which issuers have objected?]]). The same March release also mentions, subject to regulatory approval, OKX providing access to ICE's U.S. futures and NYSE tokenized equities markets; that is NYSE's separate issuer-sponsored platform, not this TSV ([[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform|NYSE / ICE tokenized platform]]).

## What this means for holders
- OKXICE is a [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] under the [[concepts/glossary#innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]]: access is controlled through non-transferable access tokens, and trading pairs are [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoins]] (USDC, USDG, USDT) ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)). The 11 Nov announcement limits access at launch to eligible U.S.-based OKX Inc. customers who have activated a CeDeFi Wallet, completed identity verification and completed onboarding with OKXICE ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)).
- Customers hold the tokens in self-custodial wallets; the venue does not hold their assets or private keys ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)).
- Each token is described as a security entitlement backed one-to-one by an underlying U.S. share, with applicable shareholder rights including dividends, voting and corporate actions ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)).
- Issuers can object to third-party tokens of their stock: 67 had objected by 5 Nov 2026, which can keep those stocks off the venue ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.11.05.pdf)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Prometheum
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/prometheum
description: Prometheum lets ordinary US brokers offer tokenized securities by clearing and holding them for those brokers, under the same customer-protection rules as…
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: Correspondent clearing offered (pages read 9 Nov 2026)
last_updated: 2026-11-09
last_checked: 2026-11-09

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** Correspondent clearing offered (pages read 9 Nov 2026)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-09  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Prometheum |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | Correspondent clearing for broker-dealers; Prometheum ATS (ProATS) |
| structure | Broker-dealer custody, clearing and settlement of crypto assets incl. tokenized securities, plus an ATS |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Customers of broker-dealers that clear through Prometheum Capital; ATS subscribers |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Prometheum lets ordinary US brokers offer tokenized securities by clearing and holding them for those brokers, under the same customer-protection rules as stocks.*

Prometheum Capital, a FINRA member and SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealer]], offers omnibus and fully disclosed correspondent clearing so other broker-dealers can offer crypto assets, including tokenized and digitally native securities, subject to Customer Protection [[concepts/glossary#rule-15c3-3|Rule 15c3-3]] ([Prometheum](https://www.prometheum.com/correspondent-clearing)).

## How it works
- Prometheum Capital provides clearing, custody and settlement; the introducing broker keeps the customer ([Prometheum](https://www.prometheum.com/correspondent-clearing)).
- The Prometheum [[concepts/glossary#ats|ATS]] "does not trade against its customers or make markets"; customer funds and blockchain securities are kept separate under 15c3-3 ([Prometheum ATS](https://www.prometheum.com/trading)).
- Prometheum describes ATS settlement as instant (T+0) and offers a WebSocket trade API ([Prometheum ATS](https://www.prometheum.com/trading)).

This is the US broker-dealer-native model: eligibility, custody and books sit with a regulated broker rather than in the token. See [[concepts/legal-taxonomy|Legal taxonomy]] and [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].

## What this means for holders
- You would hold through a broker-dealer account, with 15c3-3 segregation, not in a self-custodied wallet ([Prometheum ATS](https://www.prometheum.com/trading)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://www.prometheum.com/trading>

# Seturion
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/seturion
description: Seturion lets existing European trading venues keep matching orders as they do today and settle tokenized trades on a blockchain, without each venue needing…
type: venue
jurisdiction: EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime licence granted by BaFin)
chain: Public and selected private chains (unnamed)
status: DLT TSS licence obtained 20 Oct 2026
last_updated: 2026-11-09
last_checked: 2026-11-09

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime licence granted by BaFin)  
> **Chain:** Public and selected private chains (unnamed)  
> **Status:** DLT TSS licence obtained 20 Oct 2026  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-09  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Seturion |
| jurisdiction | EU (Germany; DLT Pilot Regime licence granted by BaFin) |
| product_name | Seturion settlement platform |
| structure | Pan-European DLT settlement layer for trading venues (offchain trading, onchain settlement) |
| chains | Public and selected private chains (unnamed) |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Seturion lets existing European trading venues keep matching orders as they do today and settle tokenized trades on a blockchain, without each venue needing its own DLT licence.*

On 20 Oct 2026 Boerse Stuttgart Group, which started Seturion, obtained a DLT Trading and Settlement System licence under the EU [[concepts/glossary#dlt-pilot-regime|DLT Pilot Regime]], granted by BaFin after a process with ESMA and the ECB ([Boerse Stuttgart](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion-blog/boerse-stuttgart-group-obtains-dlt-tss-license-and-lays-regulatory-basis-for-seturion/)). Venues that connect can offer tokenized assets "without requiring their own DLT license" ([Boerse Stuttgart](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion-blog/boerse-stuttgart-group-obtains-dlt-tss-license-and-lays-regulatory-basis-for-seturion/)).

## How it works
- Bridges offchain trading and onchain settlement; assets stay in participants' own wallet infrastructure, and no central securities depository is needed, per Seturion ([Seturion](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion/)).
- Supports public and selected private chains, and settlement against central bank money/fiat or onchain cash ([Seturion](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion/)).
- Already used by SeturionX, a Swiss DLT trading facility ([Seturion](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion/)).
- Strategic partners named: flatexDEGIRO, Nasdaq, Société Générale and SG-FORGE ([Boerse Stuttgart](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion-blog/boerse-stuttgart-group-obtains-dlt-tss-license-and-lays-regulatory-basis-for-seturion/)).

See [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]] and [[concepts/international|International]].

## What this means for holders
- Holders would reach Seturion through a connected venue or broker, not directly ([Boerse Stuttgart](https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion-blog/boerse-stuttgart-group-obtains-dlt-tss-license-and-lays-regulatory-basis-for-seturion/)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

- <https://group.boerse-stuttgart.com/en/seturion/>

# TSV LLC
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/tsv-llc
description: TSV LLC is an onchain venue on Canton under the SEC's Innovation Exemption.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States (TSV Exemption)
chain: Canton
status: Operating; first trades (CNTN) executed 2026-11-04
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (TSV Exemption)  
> **Chain:** Canton  
> **Status:** Operating; first trades (CNTN) executed 2026-11-04  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | TSV LLC |
| jurisdiction | United States (TSV Exemption) |
| product_name | Tokenized Securities Venue on Canton |
| structure | Permissioned concentrated-liquidity AMM (Tradecraft, Uniswap v3-style) |
| chains | Canton |
| who_can_buy | Approved Canton parties verified by the issuer's transfer agent plus TSV LLC screening |
| num_assets | 1 named (CNTN) in notice v1.3 |

*In plain English: TSV LLC is an onchain venue on Canton under the SEC's Innovation Exemption. Its first stock is Canton Strategic Holdings, tokenized by the company's own transfer agent; the first trades happened on 4 Nov 2026.*

TSV LLC (organized in Puerto Rico) filed the first [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] on 23 Sep 2026 ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/about/divisions-offices/division-trading-markets/innovation-exemption)). Founders: Ali Abrar (CEO) and Ryan Trinkle ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm)).

## How it works
- Permissioned [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMM]] pools on [[concepts/glossary#canton|Canton]]; at commencement a concentrated-liquidity, Uniswap v3-style design using Tradecraft software licensed from its affiliate Obsidian Software LLC. Only TSV LLC creates pools and sets their parameters ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).
- Paired assets at commencement: USDC (Circle) and SBC (Brale), as issued on Canton ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).
- Settlement is atomic: both sides of a trade move together or neither does ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm)).
- The issuer's [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] verifies participants and keeps the register; TSV LLC adds its own screening. Neither TSV LLC nor any affiliate trades for its own account at commencement ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).
- Service providers named: IntellectEU (Canton node hosting), AWS (cloud), Alpaca (market data, also used for the volume caps), Halborn (security audit of Tradecraft) ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).

## First stock: CNTN
Version 1.3 of the notice (29 Oct 2026) names tokenized Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CNTN) as the stock it will make available, with Fairmint TA LLC, an SEC-registered transfer agent, as transfer agent ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)). Shares are tokenized only voluntarily, by the issuer's transfer agent with the issuer's authorization, so this is an [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored token]] and the 30-day third-party objection process that has hit [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]] does not apply to it ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).

CNTN's press release (filed with its 8-K, 29 Oct 2026) says Fairmint will issue the tokenized shares, keep the official onchain ownership record and run compliance on every transfer; holders would get the same rights as holders of CNTN on Nasdaq; trading is expected "as early as Monday, November 2" ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm)). Fairmint TA LLC's SEC transfer-agent file number is 084-06901 ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm)). The notice itself still said on 29 Oct that operations had not commenced and no assets were available for trading ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).

## First trades (4 Nov 2026)
CNTN announced the first trades of its issuer-sponsored tokenized common stock on TSV LLC on 4 Nov 2026, through a permissioned pool on the Tradecraft AMM, settled atomically on Canton ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)):
- **Seller:** Five North, an existing shareholder, which asked for its shares to be registered in tokenized form. [[infrastructure/fairmint|Fairmint]], for the company, recorded them with Five North's verified Loop Wallet, "moving its position from a broker-dealer account onto the Company's onchain shareholder register" ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- **Buyer:** DRW Cumberland. **Liquidity provider:** Flowdesk Liquidity Solutions LLC, in the pool ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- **Size and price:** not disclosed ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- **Who does what:** Fairmint TA LLC, the company's SEC-registered transfer agent, keeps the official onchain ownership record, runs the allow list of verified holders and wallets and applies transfer controls; TSV LLC operates the venue; Tradecraft (Obsidian Software) is the AMM software ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html); [Fairmint](https://www.fairmint.com/blog/fairmint-brings-public-equity-onchain-with-canton-strategic-holdings/)).
- On 20 Nov 2026 Fairmint said Tradecraft's technology "powers the existing TSV LLC venue" and named Tradecraft as the first AMM for a planned separate venue, Fairmint TSV, which had not begun trading ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html)). See [[infrastructure/fairmint#fairmint-tsv-announced-plans-nov-2026|Fairmint]].
- **Claims, attributed:** the company and TSV call these the first trades of their kind under the Innovation Exemption, and say holders "receive the same rights and privileges as those holding the Company's stock via Nasdaq" ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- TSV is designed for 24/7 availability, subject to required stoppages, maintenance, risk controls and volume limits ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).

How the register side works, step by step: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#issuer-sponsored-register-permissions-and-recovery|Issuer-sponsored register]].

## Notice versions
- v1.0, 23 Sep 2026: initial notice. v1.1, 19 Oct: affiliate, liquidity, verification, paired assets and other changes. v1.2, 23 Oct: ledger disclosures. v1.3, 29 Oct: names CNTN and Fairmint TA LLC ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).

## What this means for holders
- Tokenized CNTN would be issued by the company's own transfer agent, and the press release says it carries the same rights as Nasdaq-held shares ([CNTN 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1861657/000149315226049196/ex99-1.htm)).
- Only approved, verified participants can trade, against USDC or SBC stablecoins ([TSV LLC notice v1.3](https://www.tokenizedstockvenue.com/notice.html)).
- Trading started on 4 Nov 2026 with CNTN; only transfer-agent-verified, allowlisted holders can trade, and trades settle atomically ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

# Broadridge
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/broadridge
description: Broadridge runs most shareholder voting in the US, and plans to let holders of tokenized NYSE shares vote from their wallets.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: NYSE partner announced 2 Nov 2026; platform awaiting approval
last_updated: 2026-11-18
last_checked: 2026-11-18

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** NYSE partner announced 2 Nov 2026; platform awaiting approval  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-18  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Broadridge |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | On-chain governance, digital transfer agency, DLX / Distributed Ledger Repo |
| structure | Proxy voting, transfer agency and tokenization infrastructure |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Broadridge runs most shareholder voting in the US, and plans to let holders of tokenized NYSE shares vote from their wallets.*

On 2 Nov 2026 Broadridge said it will bring on-chain shareholder governance and digital [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agency]] to NYSE's tokenized securities platform once it launches after regulatory approval ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)).

- **Voting:** governance smart contracts link tokens to meeting agendas, voting rules and verifiable results. Proxy materials go out and wallets are checked against verified voting entitlements. Holders vote through supported wallets, broker apps or ProxyVote ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)).
- **Transfer agency:** NYSE-listed issuers can tokenize their stock through Broadridge's digital transfer agency, alongside its traditional transfer agency and proxy services ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)).
- **Scope:** Broadridge says its governance platform serves issuer-listed tokens, synthetic securities issued outside the US, and third-party tokenized shares in the US ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)).
- **DLX and DLR:** DLX is its tokenization platform. Its Distributed Ledger Repo settles over \$360B a day, by Broadridge's count ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge-ir.com/news/news-details/2026/Broadridge-to-Bring-OnChain-Governance-and-Digital-Transfer-Agency-to-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/default.aspx)).

**Dinari dShares (5 Nov 2026):** Broadridge brought proxy voting to [[issuers/dinari|Dinari]]'s custodial dShares: eligible holders vote the underlying shares through Broadridge's proxy infrastructure, and their votes are counted in the formal shareholder vote alongside traditional shareholders ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities)). Wallet login to vote directly is a future step. Broadridge calls its onchain proxy voting "the first platform in the U.S. to support all models of tokenization, including custodial tokenized securities and issuer-sponsored tokens" (Broadridge's claim, not independently checked). Comparison of voting paths: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#holder-rights-and-compliance-controls|Holder rights and compliance controls]].

**Onchain Rights standard (16 Nov 2026):** Coinbase and Broadridge published a jointly developed open technical standard for delivering shareholder communications directly to wallets holding tokenized shares, and said the standard was also submitted as an Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP) for review. In parallel, Broadridge launched a data oracle "designed to help participating firms demonstrate, in aggregate, the distribution of shareholder communications" ([Broadridge / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/coinbase-and-broadridge-publish-proposed-standard-for-onchain-shareholder-communications-broadridge-launches-data-oracle-302939893.html)). The announcement "builds on Broadridge's existing onchain governance capabilities, which integrate ProxyVote into digital wallets so investors can receive materials, confirm holdings and submit votes," including the 5 Nov 2026 Dinari integration above ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-brings-proxy-voting-to-dinaris-dshares-tokenized-us-equities)). Implementation "will depend on the applicable share structure, intermediaries and legal requirements" ([Broadridge / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/coinbase-and-broadridge-publish-proposed-standard-for-onchain-shareholder-communications-broadridge-launches-data-oracle-302939893.html)).

The standard's own site, Onchain Rights, describes two building blocks: Onchain Announcements, which let a token contract publish a structured notice, and a Corporate Action Schema for the linked document. The overview says the specifications "communicate the action" and "do not establish legal rights, calculate a particular holder's entitlement, determine eligibility, or submit votes and elections." The document format "uses corporate action vocabulary from ISO 15022 and ISO 20022, with type names from the Broadridge BRx data model" ([Onchain Rights docs](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs)). The FAQ says the standard "announces and describes events" and "doesn't take votes or move money"; "Onchain voting is the next phase" ([Onchain Rights](https://www.onchainrights.org/)). As of a 16 Nov 2026 snapshot, the project's EIP References page lists both "Onchain Announcements" and "Corporate Action Announcement Content" as "Coming soon," and the canonical JSON schema is marked "Publication pending" ([EIP References](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs/specs/eip-references); [JSON Schema](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs/specs/json-schema)). See [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]] and [[issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks|Coinbase tokenized stocks]].

**Financing DTCC-tokenized Treasuries with Talos and Marex (17 Nov 2026):** Talos, Marex and Broadridge announced a collaboration to let institutions trade and finance tokenized securities, and move collateral, outside traditional market hours, on top of the [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC Tokenization Service]]. The initial focus is financing tokenized U.S. Treasuries ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-to-enable-institutional-trading-of-dtcc-tokenized-securities)). The roles, per the release:
- **Execution:** Talos connects trading counterparties through its request-for-quote (RFQ) network.
- **Financing:** Marex acts as prime broker to clients financing tokenized Treasuries, through the same prime brokerage relationship they already use.
- **Settlement:** Talos integrates with DLX, Broadridge's "always-on, multi-asset digital operating system for tokenized finance," whose settlement orchestrator is to settle atomically onchain and connect that activity to books and records, interest calculations and P&L reporting.

This is an announced workflow, not a launched service; the release gives no go-live date. In it Broadridge says it processes "more than \$350 billion in tokenized repo daily," a different figure from the \$360B quoted on 2 Nov above; both are Broadridge's own counts.

It is one of six NYSE transfer agent partners as of 2 Nov 2026 ([[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#transfer-agent-partners|NYSE / ICE]]).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

- <https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/>

# Chainlink tokenized equity feeds
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds
description: Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: live
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Chainlink tokenized equity feeds |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Tokenized Equity Feeds; Data Streams |
| structure | Oracle |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | n/a |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.*

Feeds combine the underlying 24/5 equity price with the issuer's [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] and respect issuer-controlled oracle pauses; issuer-specific pages exist for Coinbase [[concepts/glossary#b20|B20]] and Robinhood ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds)).

Data Streams price regular, extended and overnight sessions with market-status flags and staleness checks ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/rwa-streams/24-5-us-equities-user-guide)). For splits: pause the feed, stage the new multiplier, unpause; the issuer coordinates timing and Chainlink provides no corporate-action calendar ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/tokenized-asset-streams/handling-stock-splits)).

In an 11 Nov 2026 comment letter on the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], Chainlink Labs proposed FAQs and nonbinding principles on comparable TSV trade reports, corporate-action reconciliation across systems, and how TSVs should assess external data used for pricing and controls. Chainlink is a vendor of these services; the letter is advocacy, not a product specification ([Chainlink Labs](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1133160-4036827.pdf)).

Separately, on 19 Nov 2026 Chainlink said UBS used the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) in a production pilot to automate lifecycle servicing for a tokenized structured note on Ethereum, including real-time visibility of coupon entitlements, barrier proximity and product status. This is a structured note, not a stock-token price feed. Settlement using UBS digital money is described as future automation, not a live feature ([Chainlink / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/chainlink-develops-blockchain-solution-with-ubs-for-the-2-trillion-global-structured-products-market-302944470.html)).
