# DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot
description: The DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) went live on 28 Oct 2026. DTC turns eligible DTC-held securities into tokenized entitlements on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network, under an 11 Dec 2025 SEC no-action letter.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle); Solana planned for the second half of 2027 (DTCC, 12 Nov 2026)
status: pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)
last_updated: 2026-11-18
last_checked: 2026-11-18

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle); Solana planned for the second half of 2027 (DTCC, 12 Nov 2026)  
> **Status:** pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-18  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS; Tokenized Entitlements) |
| structure | Security entitlements recorded on DLT |
| chains | At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle); Solana planned for the second half of 2027 (DTCC, 12 Nov 2026) |
| who_can_buy | DTC participants (20 signed at launch, 28 Oct 2026); clients of Participants cannot submit conversion orders or independently register wallets (DTCC FAQs, retrieved 14 Nov 2026) |
| num_assets | 34 securities at launch (~\$30T eligible): select Russell 1000 equities, ETFs, Treasuries |

*In plain English: DTC, the US central securities depository, is testing tokenized versions of shares it already holds.*

DTC operates a tokenization pilot under a 11 Dec 2025 SEC no-action letter ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)); 24X Exchange filed rules referencing it ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/self-regulatory-organization-rulemaking/sr-24x-2026-20)).

## What is the DTCC Tokenization Service?
The DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) is a DTC service, live since 28 Oct 2026, that converts eligible DTC-held securities into tokenized security entitlements on the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network, and back again ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). Only DTC Participants use it directly (20 had signed agreements at launch), and it operates under an SEC staff no-action letter dated 11 Dec 2025 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live); [SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf)).

## DTC no-action letter (11 Dec 2025)
Staff relief lets DTC participants record security entitlements on [[concepts/glossary#dlt|DLT]] ("Tokenized Entitlements") for Russell 1000 stocks, major-index [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] and Treasuries; tokens have no collateral or settlement value for Net Debit Cap / Collateral Monitor ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf); [Mayer Brown](https://www.mayerbrown.com/-/media/files/perspectives-events/publications/2025/12/sec-staff-no-action-relief-for-dtc-pilot-provides-a-pathway-for-tokenized-securities.pdf)). The letter is withdrawn three years from the date DTC launches the service ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf)).
## Live (28 Oct 2026)
DTC launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) on 28 Oct 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). Tokenized security entitlements convert between traditional and tokenized form and go to users' wallets of choice, keeping the ownership rights, investor protections and economic entitlements of the traditional securities ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).

- **Participants:** 20 DTC participants have signed agreements: Alpaca, Apex Clearing Corporation, Barclays, Bank of America, BNP Paribas, Brown Brothers Harriman, Citadel Securities, Citi, Clear Street, DriveWealth, Edward Jones, Fidelity Investments, Interchange Clearing, J.P. Morgan, Marex, Mirae Asset Securities (USA) Inc., Morgan Stanley, State Street, UBS and Velocity Capital LLC. More will be onboarded on a rolling basis ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
  - Participant Interchange Clearing runs execution, clearing and custody on one real-time platform with direct DTC and NSCC links ([Interchange](https://www.interchange.com/blog/interchange-clearing-to-access-the-dtcc-tokenization-service)).
  - After go-live, Morgan Stanley said it is among the first banks to tokenize "U.S. Equity and U.S. Treasuries" through DTS ([Morgan Stanley on X](https://x.com/MorganStanley/status/2117727271377125454), 3 Nov 2026). A quote card on that post, from Amy Oldenburg, Head of Digital Assets Strategy, says the experience "will inform the continued development of the firm's digital asset capabilities as the market evolves." The Block reported that Morgan Stanley expects to support tokenized equities on its alternative trading system in the first quarter of 2027, later than its previous H2 2026 target, and that Oldenburg had told The Block the previous month the bank was building the necessary infrastructure ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-11-04-morgan-stanley-among-first-banks-to-tokenize-us-equities-treasurys-through-dtccs-service-432633), 4 Nov 2026). The ATS date is The Block's reporting, not the X post.
  - Société Générale said its Prime Services & Clearing division accepted USD 10 million of tokenized US Treasuries as collateral on Canton, "using assets tokenized as part of the soft launch" of DTCC's Tokenization Service, and that it intends to develop recurring collateral movements and, over time, explore agency and principal repo, subject to internal approvals and regulatory requirements ([Société Générale](https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/fileadmin/user_upload/groupe_AMER/pdf/Societe_Generale_Completes_Tokenized_US_Treasury_Collateral_Transaction_on_Canton.pdf), 2 Nov 2026).
  - Alpaca said it joined DTCC's Industry Working Group in May 2026 and that, in the July 2026 production event, it helped partners tokenize DTC-held SPY and CRCL holdings on the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network, then redeem them through Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network ([Alpaca](https://alpaca.markets/blog/alpaca-joins-launch-of-dtcc-tokenization-service/), 29 Oct 2026). Those ticker names and the July activity are Alpaca's account.
- **Networks:** Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network today, with more networks in 2027 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). On 12 Nov 2026 DTCC said it plans to connect the Tokenization Service to Solana's L1, with DTC-tokenized assets expected to be available on Solana in the second half of 2027. The integration is expected to support rapid conversion of eligible DTC-custodied assets into tokenized form and related token lifecycle functionality. DTCC says tokens on Solana, and on all blockchain networks integrated with the service, will retain the same investor protections, ownership rights and regulatory safeguards that apply to traditionally held securities ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-to-connect-with-solana)). DTCC's product FAQs, retrieved 14 Nov 2026, still name only the Canton Network and Hyperledger Besu as networks Participants can register wallets on, and say DTC "expects to add additional networks in 2027"; that FAQ does not name Solana, Stellar or Arc ([DTCC FAQs](https://www.dtcc.com/products-and-services/digital-assets/tokenization/hub)). A 12 Aug 2026 DTCC framework describes the risk-based, SIFMU-aligned process DTC uses to evaluate Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks for its digital asset services, including early risk screening, client demand and operational fitness; the framework itself does not name any specific chain ([DTCC](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/evaluation-framework-l1-l2-blockchain-networks.pdf/8e9c53b2965e11f19a98ca3087bcb34c)).
- **Ecosystem:** collaborators and partners include BitGo Bank & Trust, Blockdaemon, Broadridge, DFNS, DRW, Fireblocks, HIFI, Kaleido, Matter Labs, [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo]], Prometheum Capital, Talos, Taurus, Temple Digital Group, Tradeweb, Transcend and Virtu ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
- **Design input:** more than 150 firms in the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
- **Scale:** DTC has more than \$114T in assets under custody ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).

Scope at launch follows the Day 1 tear sheet below ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)).

## Progress
DTCC said the service was designed with feedback from more than 50 firms, with limited production trades planned for July 2026 and launch in October 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-advances-development-of-new-tokenization-service)). About 40 firms took part in live production trades; the 28 Oct go-live release says "more than 30 firms" completed the initial limited-production trades ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/digital-assets/tokenization/live-production-trades); [DTCC press](https://www.dtcc.com/news/2026/july/15/dtcc-turns-tokenization-into-reality)).

On 23 Oct 2026 DTCC posted a Day 1 product tear sheet and an online user guide to its Learning Center ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)).

On 17 Nov 2026 Talos, Marex and [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]] announced the first named trading and financing workflow built on the service: Talos RFQ execution, Marex prime brokerage and Broadridge's DLX settlement orchestrator, starting with financing tokenized U.S. Treasuries beyond market hours. The three firms took part in DTCC's July 2026 production transactions; no go-live date was given ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-to-enable-institutional-trading-of-dtcc-tokenized-securities)). Separately, Alpaca's co-founder said Alpaca clients can now use its API to mint DTCC tokens from eligible securities they already hold (his claim, as reported by [The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-17-alpaca-says-tokenization-network-tops-10-billion-minting-redemption-volume-442667)).

Before launch, no go-live date was public; The Block (8 Oct 2026) reported launch was expected that month ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/tokenization-briefing/2026-10-08-dtcc-brings-tokenization-us-markets-417839), secondary).

## Scope at launch (Oct 2026)
DTCC's Day 1 tear sheet (23 Oct 2026) says **34** securities are available to tokenize at launch ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)); its earlier at-a-glance sheet said 25 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)), and DTCC does not explain the change.

Other launch terms in the at-a-glance sheet, unchanged in the tear sheet:  about \$30T eligible, backed 1:1 by securities held at DTC, same [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]] and the same rights and investor protections as book-entry securities, and 24/7 peer-to-peer transfers between DTC-registered [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallets]] on the same chain ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Live at launch: Canton Network (CIP-56) and Besu, DTCC's private network ([[concepts/glossary#erc-20|ERC-20]]); Stellar and Circle's Arc are anticipated in 2027 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). A 12 Nov 2026 DTCC release adds Solana, planned for the second half of 2027 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-to-connect-with-solana)). Eligible assets start with select large-cap Russell 1000 equities, select ETFs and a select set of Treasury bills, notes and bonds ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Conversion orders run Monday to Friday, 2 a.m.-6 p.m. ET ([DTC notice DAS-001](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/DAS-001/8a31d732d2d311f1a30ef632b7f70f6d)), targeting 15 minutes or less; tokens carry transfer restrictions; official books and records stay with DTC; Treasury distributions and maturities pay in fiat to participants' traditional accounts ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Roadmap for 2027 and beyond (indicative): equity/ETF corporate actions, a consolidated stock record, on-chain [[concepts/glossary#netting|netting]] and digital cash ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). Coverage: [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/dtcc-tokenization-service-launch-october/) (news).

Firm counts differ by stage, and all of them come from DTCC: more than 50 firms gave design feedback; its July live-trades page says about 40 firms took part; its 28 Oct go-live release says "more than 30 firms" completed the initial limited-production trades. DTCC doesn't explain the gap, so both figures are shown with their source.

## How the service works (DTCC FAQs)
DTCC's Tokenization Service FAQs, retrieved 14 Nov 2026, add operational detail that is not in the go-live release or the Day 1 tear sheet ([DTCC FAQs](https://www.dtcc.com/products-and-services/digital-assets/tokenization/hub)):

- When a Participant submits a conversion order, DTC moves the traditional securities entitlements into the **DTC Digital Omnibus Account**, the account on DTC's traditional books and records that holds, in aggregate, the underlying entitlements represented by DTC-issued tokens, and mints a corresponding token into the Participant's DTC-registered wallet. ComposerX LedgerScan, a DTCC Digital Assets product, tracks token movements across approved networks; LedgerScan combined with DTC's traditional books and records is described as providing a complete picture of a Participant's traditional and tokenized positions.
- Only DTC Participants may submit conversion orders, and only Participants may register and control wallets through DTS. DTC does not provide digital wallets; Participants may use a third-party provider or a self-custodied wallet, which must be registered before access. Clients of Participants cannot submit instructions to DTC or independently register or control wallets. DTC members for which DTC performs tax reporting or withholding are currently ineligible.
- Conversion orders run Monday to Friday, 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET, excluding holidays, and cannot be submitted outside those hours, consistent with the earlier DAS-001 window ([DTC notice DAS-001](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/DAS-001/8a31d732d2d311f1a30ef632b7f70f6d); [DTCC FAQs](https://www.dtcc.com/products-and-services/digital-assets/tokenization/hub)).
- Token transfers are 24/7 between DTC-registered wallets on the same supported network. During conversion hours, a token may move to a registered wallet on another approved network by being burned on the source network and minted on the destination network; the FAQs say this is done "without relying on unsupported bridge protocols."
- DTS is a free-of-value service: DTC does not process the cash side of a transaction, and Participants may use the on-chain cash solution of their choice. Tokenized securities cannot be used directly in traditional end-of-day settlement at DTC, or in NSCC or FICC clearing, until they are converted back to book-entry form.
- On-chain coupon payments "are not currently available and remain in development"; coupon payments continue in traditional currency to the Participant's traditional DTC account. Where a corporate action is not yet supported digitally, the tokenized position is converted back to book-entry form before the record date, and DTC will not automatically create a new token afterwards; the Participant must submit a new conversion request.
- DTC "maintains administrative control over DTC-issued tokens, including the ability to claw back or force transfer tokens if they are lost or stolen."
- The FAQs say DTC currently supports a select subset of eligible securities based on Participant demand, with a goal of expanding over time. The July 15, 2026 production event, in DTCC's description, included collateral pledge, securities lending, U.S. Treasury repo and delivery-versus-payment (DVP), equity DVP, equity token transfers, equity delivery-versus-delivery (DVD), and central counterparty (CCP) margin through the DTCC Collateral AppChain, which the FAQs describe as a separate DTCC product.

## DRS modernization (SR-DTC-2026-012)
DTC filed on 29 Sep 2026 to modernize the [[concepts/glossary#direct-registration-system-drs|Direct Registration System (DRS)]], which moves shares between [[concepts/glossary#cede--co|Cede & Co.]] and the holder's own name on the issuer's books; the SEC published notice on 5 Oct 2026 (Release 34-106552) ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). The aim is to cut processing "from days to minutes" by retiring legacy terminal and batch-file methods, offering DRS through DTC's SPA screens plus API and MQ messaging, automating the Deliver Order after a transfer agent approves a deposit, and adding status tracking and an audit trail ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). Only a DTC participant can start a withdrawal ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). The SEC notice gave an expected implementation date of 13 Nov 2026, and no later than January 2027 ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). On 6 Nov 2026, DTC Important Notice B#25240-26 postponed that November 2026 implementation. Subject to regulatory approval, DTC expects to implement the changes no later than 30 Jun 2027, and will announce the specific date in a later Important Notice. Until then, Participants must keep using existing legacy PTS/PBS and batch-file channels; API and MQ testing continues. The notice does not say the SEC has approved SR-DTC-2026-012 ([DTC notice B#25240-26](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/25240-26/306b2894da2f11f192c2a2d2c72ada28)).

Securitize's 25 Oct comment letter notes the filing does not mention DTC's tokenization service, and asks for a one-step burn-and-withdraw instruction, published processing times, [[concepts/glossary#dwac|DWAC]] modernization, a broker timing expectation, and a fast return to [[concepts/glossary#street-name|street name]] ([[issuers/securitize|Securitize]]; [Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/SR-DTC-2026-012/srdtc2026012-1108719-3924407.pdf)).

## Watch
- Go-live: done, 28 Oct 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). Next: new participants, added securities beyond the launch 34, and 2027 networks (Stellar, Arc, and Solana in the second half of 2027).
- DRS modernization: the November 2026 implementation was postponed. Watch for the later Important Notice with the exact date (expected no later than 30 Jun 2027, subject to regulatory approval), whether the SEC approves SR-DTC-2026-012, and whether DTC responds to the Securitize letter ([DTC notice B#25240-26](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/25240-26/306b2894da2f11f192c2a2d2c72ada28)).
- First named users: 20 participants named 28 Oct 2026 (see Live). After go-live, Morgan Stanley said it had tokenized US equities and Treasuries through DTS (company claim, [Morgan Stanley on X](https://x.com/MorganStanley/status/2117727271377125454)); Société Générale described a \$10 million tokenized-Treasury collateral use on Canton from the soft launch ([Société Générale](https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/fileadmin/user_upload/groupe_AMER/pdf/Societe_Generale_Completes_Tokenized_US_Treasury_Collateral_Transaction_on_Canton.pdf)); Alpaca described July trial activity in SPY and CRCL (company claim, [Alpaca](https://alpaca.markets/blog/alpaca-joins-launch-of-dtcc-tokenization-service/)). Watch for which participants tokenize client positions on an ongoing basis.
- Kimber Digital Securities LLC, a Plume affiliate, said on 10 Nov 2026 that it is now an SEC-registered broker-dealer and a FINRA member, that Plume has been a member of the DTCC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group since August, and that it plans tokens which would record a customer's security entitlement against the firm, with a matching entitlement at DTC. The release states that access to DTC tokenized entitlements is under development and may not yet be available, and it does not give a launch date ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/kimber-digital-securities-becomes-a-registered-broker-dealer-bringing-real-us-securities-onchain-302935166.html)).

# Fairmint
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/fairmint
description: Fairmint is a transfer agent: the firm that keeps a company's official list of shareholders.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: Canton
status: Transfer agent for tokenized CNTN; first trades 4 Nov 2026
last_updated: 2026-11-20
last_checked: 2026-11-20

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** Canton  
> **Status:** Transfer agent for tokenized CNTN; first trades 4 Nov 2026  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-20  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Fairmint |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | Onchain Transfer Agent services; Open Cap Table Protocol (OCP) |
| structure | Transfer agent keeping the official onchain shareholder register (issuer-sponsored shares) |
| chains | Canton |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Fairmint is a transfer agent: the firm that keeps a company's official list of shareholders. For Canton Strategic Holdings (CNTN), it keeps that list onchain, so the token is recorded on the company's own register.*

Fairmint TA LLC (formerly Fair FP LLC) is an SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]], file no. 084-06901, and a subsidiary of Fairmint, Inc. ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)). Its own letter says it has been registered since 15 Dec 2023 ([Fairmint letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1120639-3987647.pdf)); this wiki has not checked the SEC's register independently.

## Role in the CNTN trades (4 Nov 2026)
- Fairmint issued CNTN's [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored]] tokenized shares for the company, keeps the official onchain ownership record on [[concepts/glossary#canton|Canton]], operates the [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allow list]] of verified holders and wallets, and applies the company's transfer controls ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- It is not the venue. TSV LLC runs the venue, using the Tradecraft [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMM]] protocol ([Fairmint](https://www.fairmint.com/blog/fairmint-brings-public-equity-onchain-with-canton-strategic-holdings/)). See [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc|TSV LLC]].
- Fairmint describes its model as different from a wrapper: "the onchain record is the official ownership record. It is not a mirror of a separate offchain database" ([Fairmint](https://www.fairmint.com/blog/what-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-stock-looks-like-cntn-selects-fairmint/), Fairmint's description).

## Fairmint TSV (announced plans, Nov 2026)
On 20 Nov 2026 Fairmint announced plans for Fairmint TSV LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary, to operate a tokenized securities venue for automated market makers trading issuer-sponsored shares recorded by Fairmint TA LLC ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html)). This is an announced plan, not a live venue.

- The shares would be authorized by the issuer and recorded by Fairmint TA, an SEC-registered transfer agent (file no. 084-06901), so each holder appears on the issuer's register. Venue activities would be separate from Fairmint TA's transfer-agent services ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html)).
- Trading would start on [[concepts/glossary#canton|Canton]], with Ethereum planned next. Tradecraft, developed by Obsidian Software LLC, would be the first AMM; the release says Tradecraft's technology already powers the existing [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc|TSV LLC]] venue ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html)).
- Fairmint TSV LLC intends to operate under the SEC [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] (Release No. 34-106402). It has not begun trading, and launch is subject to the exemption's requirements, including the required public notice, as well as final agreements and operational readiness. Initial securities, eligible participants and the launch date will be announced when finalized ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/20/3407521/0/en/fairmint-announces-plans-for-fairmint-tsv-a-venue-connecting-amms-to-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-shares-with-tradecraft-as-first-amm.html)). Fairmint's own post describes it as "a proposed venue under the SEC's temporary Innovation Exemption" that "is not registered with or approved by the SEC and has not begun operating" ([Fairmint on X](https://x.com/fairmint/status/2123827910301700373)).
- As of 2:59 PM ET on 20 Nov 2026, Fairmint TSV does not appear on the SEC's list of persons that have submitted written notice of intent to operate as a TSV. That list names TSV LLC (23 Sep 2026), OKXICE TSV (4 Oct 2026), Kephas Corporation d/b/a Perpetuals.com (14 Oct 2026) and Formation Securities LLC (9 Nov 2026) ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/about/divisions-offices/division-trading-markets/innovation-exemption)).

## How the register works (Fairmint's own description)
- Holders are registered shareholders on the official register, not beneficial owners through a broker-dealer, per Fairmint's CEO ([Joris Delanoue on X](https://x.com/Joris_DLN/status/2117932047511539849), attributed).
- If a holder loses their wallet key, "the transfer agent can verify it's you & restore your shares", per the CEO ([Joris Delanoue on X](https://x.com/Joris_DLN/status/2116483159587992022), attributed).
- A company can move its existing register onchain without issuing new shares; Fairmint says it reconciles the existing record and handles the handover from the current transfer agent ([Fairmint on X](https://x.com/fairmint/status/2118818224124911923), attributed).
- Fairmint says it uses Canton because selective disclosure lets each authorized party see only the relevant records ([Fairmint on X](https://x.com/fairmint/status/2119475051497918475), attributed).
- Worked example with the permissions and recovery path: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#issuer-sponsored-register-permissions-and-recovery|Reference architecture]].

## Proposal to the SEC (not law)
On 3 Nov 2026 Fairmint asked the SEC, in its transfer agent rules comment letter, to define "exclusive control" by function, to let co-transfer agents keep the record for tokenized positions across several venues under one recordkeeping agent, and to allow transfers to be registered once payment settles ([Fairmint letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1120639-3987647.pdf)). **Proposed by Fairmint, not current law or production.** Summary: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#proposed-by-fairmint-not-current-law-or-production|Reference architecture]].

By contrast, Metrika's letter on the same proposal focuses on a master securityholder file kept on a public chain the transfer agent does not control, and asks the SEC to treat exclusive control as covering the token's privileged functions (issue, cancel, freeze, force-transfer) and the off-chain address-to-holder mapping ([Metrika letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1119921-3984266.pdf)). Comment letters are advocacy, not law.

## Developer tooling
Fairmint publishes the Open Cap Table Protocol. Its Canton SDK quickstart authorizes an issuer party with the OCP Factory, creates the issuer and cap table in one transaction, and reads it back as Open Cap Format data on a local Canton sandbox ([OCP quickstart](https://opencaptableprotocol.org/sdk/canton/quickstart/)). This is register tooling, not a trading API. On 9 Nov 2026 the [SDK repository](https://github.com/Fairmint/ocp-canton-sdk) and [contracts repository](https://github.com/fairmint/open-captable-protocol-daml) showed an Apache-2.0 licence; check before reuse.

## Interests
Fairmint's CEO Joris Delanoue was elected General Director of the Canton Foundation in Dec 2025 ([Fairmint](https://www.fairmint.com/press/fairmint-ceo-joris-delanoue-elected-general-director-of-the-canton-foundation/)), so its Canton commentary comes from an interested party.

## What this means for holders
- On CNTN, the token is recorded on the company's own register by its transfer agent, per the company and Fairmint ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- Only holders whose identity and wallet Fairmint has verified and approved can hold or trade ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- Key recovery through the transfer agent is Fairmint's stated approach, not a guarantee this wiki has tested ([Joris Delanoue on X](https://x.com/Joris_DLN/status/2116483159587992022)).
- Reference information only, not investment advice.

# tZERO
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/tzero
description: tZERO builds the record-keeping and trading plumbing for tokenized shares, and is lined up to be one of NYSE's approved token record-keepers.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: NYSE design partner (MOU, Aug 2026); approval pending
last_updated: 2026-11-13
last_checked: 2026-11-13

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** NYSE design partner (MOU, Aug 2026); approval pending  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-13  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | tZERO |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | Tokenized securities infrastructure (transfer agent and broker-dealer) |
| structure | Digital transfer agent and broker-dealer infrastructure |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: tZERO builds the record-keeping and trading plumbing for tokenized shares, and is lined up to be one of NYSE's approved token record-keepers.*

On 31 Aug 2026 tZERO and ICE signed an MOU making tZERO a design partner for the [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] and broker-dealer infrastructure of NYSE's planned tokenized securities platform. Once regulatory, technology and operational requirements are met, tZERO is expected to be designated an approved digital transfer agent and subscriber ([tZERO](https://www.tzero.com/news/tzero-and-ice-agree-to-collaborate-on-infrastructure-for-public-tokenized-securities-markets)).

ICE is also investing in tZERO's latest funding round (amount not disclosed) and gets a licence to tZERO's blockchain patent portfolio, 23 patent families and 103 patents covering compliance-aware transfers, upgradeable smart contracts and corporate-action handling. The two will look at using tZERO tokenized assets as collateral at ICE's clearing houses ([tZERO](https://www.tzero.com/news/tzero-and-ice-agree-to-collaborate-on-infrastructure-for-public-tokenized-securities-markets)).

It is one of six NYSE transfer agent partners as of 2 Nov 2026 ([[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#transfer-agent-partners|NYSE / ICE]]; [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nyse-expands-tokenization-push-with-firms-serving-nearly-99-of-sp-500/)).

On 11 Nov 2026 tZERO said the CFTC approved the registration of its wholly owned subsidiary tZERO DCM, LLC as a Designated Contract Market, following the 16 Oct 2026 registration of tZERO DCO, LLC as a Derivatives Clearing Organization. tZERO says those approvals satisfy the first earn-out milestone in its 31 Oct 2026 merger agreement with FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. This is a derivatives-market registration, not a tokenized-securities product launch ([tZERO](https://www.tzero.com/news/tzero-receives-cftc-approval-to-operate-regulated-derivatives-exchange-and-achieves-first-earn)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Uniswap v4 permissioned pools
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/uniswap-permissioned-pools
description: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: unknown
last_updated: 2026-11-11
last_checked: 2026-11-11

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** unknown  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-11  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Uniswap v4 permissioned pools |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | PermissionedHooks |
| structure | Permissioned AMM hook |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Allowlisted addresses (issuer-defined) |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.*

An open-source Uniswap v4 hook standard for compliant trading of tokenized [[concepts/glossary#rwa|RWAs]] and equities; issuer [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allowlists]] are enforced on every swap and liquidity [[concepts/glossary#mint|mint]] ([Uniswap](https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4)).

A Permissions Adapter holds the real asset and issues a virtual token to PoolManager; PermissionedHooks checks an IAllowlistChecker ([architecture](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture); [source](https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol)).

It is the [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMM]] primitive used by the first [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice ([[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE]]).

On 10 Nov 2026 Uniswap Labs published a post on how it reads [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] TSV conditions (fee disclosure, access controls, symbol and volume caps, and trading halts) as mappable to Uniswap v4 hooks and the Permissioned Pools hook, and on correlated pairs such as a stock against SPY. The post is Uniswap's framing, not a TSV notice; it says Uniswap Labs does not operate, control, or have a role in the operation of any tokenized securities venue. Vendor metrics in the same post, attributed as such: more than $20 billion in stock tokens traded on the Uniswap Protocol to date, and, since August, more than 40 tokenized stocks and ETFs with SPY pools on Robinhood Chain, with over $900 million in volume across 130,000 wallets ([Uniswap](https://blog.uniswap.org/building-a-tokenized-securities-venue-on-uniswap)).

On 5 Nov 2026 Groma opened a permissioned GRO/USDC pool on Base through Uniswap's permissioned pool infrastructure, letting verified investors buy and redeem GromaCoin, an equity stake in a residential real-estate trust, directly with the trust at NAV ([Groma](https://groma.substack.com/p/bringing-real-estate-to-uniswap-introducing)). It is a real-estate token, not a listed stock. Venue designs compared: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]].

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4>
- <https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture>
- <https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol>
- <https://groma.substack.com/p/bringing-real-estate-to-uniswap-introducing>
- <https://blog.uniswap.org/building-a-tokenized-securities-venue-on-uniswap>

*Last checked 2026-11-11. Headline fields only; `unknown` means not yet verified from a source.*

# Vertalo
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/vertalo
description: Vertalo keeps companies' official shareholder records and links tokens to them, so token holders get dividends and votes.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: operating (platform since 2019)
last_updated: 2026-11-02
last_checked: 2026-11-02

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** operating (platform since 2019)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-11-02  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Vertalo |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | Transfer agency and tokenization platform |
| structure | SEC-registered transfer agent |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Vertalo keeps companies' official shareholder records and links tokens to them, so token holders get dividends and votes.*

Vertalo is an SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] whose platform links tokenized securities to the shareholder records that carry a holder's dividends and votes ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)). It launched its platform in 2019 and is led by founder and CEO Dave Hendricks ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)). Its registration is on SEC EDGAR as Vertalo, Inc. /TA/, filed on Form TA-1 in Nov 2019, with an annual Form TA-2 last filed in Jul 2026 ([SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001793379); [TA-1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1793379/000173809119000002/0001738091-19-000002-index.htm); [TA-2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1793379/000179337926000001/0001793379-26-000001-index.htm)).

On 26 Oct 2026 it joined the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]]. Hendricks said [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]] work because the shareholder records and the token agree, and that this agreement drives routine [[concepts/glossary#corporate-action|corporate actions]] ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# 2026-11-20: UK enabling amendment (Woolard letter), Chainlink–UBS structured notes, HSBC RedCoin tokenised fund
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-20-woolard-chainlink-ubs-hsbc-redcoin
last_checked: 2026-11-20

- [[concepts/international|International regimes]], [[topics/rules-by-jurisdiction|Rules by jurisdiction]], [[topics/regulation|Regulation]] and [[topics/legal-structures|Legal structures]]: on 18 Nov 2026 Chris Woolard, the UK Wholesale Digital Markets Champion, welcomed an enabling amendment the government had laid to the Financial Services and Markets Bill, "which will enable legislation to adapt to technological change." He said greater clarity is still needed for settlement finality, and that "the treatment of registers in the Companies Act... could prevent the issuance of digitally native equities." His second report is due in July 2027. The letter does not say the amendment has been enacted ([letter](https://www.theglobalcity.uk/PositiveWebsite/media/research-downloads/20261118_CW-Letter.pdf)).
- [[infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds|Chainlink tokenized equity feeds]] and [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|Corporate actions]]: on 19 Nov 2026 Chainlink said UBS used the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) in a production pilot to run lifecycle servicing for a tokenized structured note on Ethereum, including real-time visibility of coupon entitlements, barrier proximity and product status. This is a structured note, not a stock. Settlement using UBS digital money is described as future automation, not a live feature ([Chainlink / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/chainlink-develops-blockchain-solution-with-ubs-for-the-2-trillion-global-structured-products-market-302944470.html)).
- [[concepts/international|International regimes]] and [[comparisons/buidl-precedent|BUIDL]]: on 19 Nov 2026 HSBC said eligible customers can use HSBC RedCoin (RCHKD), its licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, to buy Class SD, a tokenised unit class of the HSBC Global Money Funds – Hong Kong Dollar, from a minimum of HKD 100. HSBC tokenises the class and custodies both the stablecoin and Class SD. This is a tokenised money market fund, not a tokenized stock ([HSBC](https://www.about.hsbc.com.hk/news-and-media/hsbc-redcoin-expands-into-wealth-with-tokenised-fund-access)).

# 2026-11-19: How Anthropic's IPO-day tokenized products were built
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-19-anthropic-ipo-tokenized-products
last_checked: 2026-11-19

- [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|Implementations by model]] replaces its one-line Anthropic note with a sourced comparison of ANTon (Ondo), ANTx (xStocks, via Kraken IPO Access, a reported Binance Wallet campaign and OKX xANT), Dinari dShares, Coinbase ANTc, Backpack ANT and pre-IPO perpetuals, by what you hold, issuer, backing claim, who can buy and rights ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html); [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access); [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/exchanges/binance-wallet-500m-anthropic-ipo-xstocks-token-sale/); [OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/help/okx-to-list-xant-for-spot-trading-and-convert-ant-pre-ipo-futures); [Dinari FAQ](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/anthropic-ipo-faqs); [Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf); [Sunrise docs](https://docs.sunrise.xyz/equities/backpack-securities); [Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm); [Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13704655-unauthorized-anthropic-stock-sales-and-investment-scams); [Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents); [trade.xyz](https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md); [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/pre-ipo-perpetual-futures-faq)).
- Anthropic's own statements are recorded neutrally: the final prospectus (424B4) does not mention tokenized shares ([Anthropic 424B4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074944/anthropicpbc-424b4.htm)); its Help Center warns that sellers of "tokenized securities" may be offering something with no value because of transfer restrictions ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13704655-unauthorized-anthropic-stock-sales-and-investment-scams), a page written about private stock); and its authorized-broker list for the retail offerings names no tokenizer or crypto platform ([Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents)). Ondo says it is not a participant in the IPO and that ANTon is not issued or sponsored by Anthropic ([Ondo release](https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/ondo-stocks-to-launch-anton-with-247-mint-and-redeem-live-on-ipo-day-302943767.html)).
- [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo]], [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]], [[issuers/dinari|Dinari]], [[issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks|Coinbase]] and [[issuers/backpack|Backpack]] each get a short Anthropic section; Coinbase's page now names the ADGM issuer, Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd, from the ANTc prospectus ([Coinbase prospectus](https://www.adgm.com/globalassets/market-disclosure/content/prospectus/coinbase-onchain-spv-ltd---prospectus-antc---18nov2026.pdf)). [[platforms-venues/kraken|Kraken]] and [[platforms-venues/hyperliquid-equity-perps|equity perps]] note their IPO Access and pre-IPO perpetual rules ([Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/anthropic-ipo-access); [trade.xyz](https://docs.trade.xyz/perpetuals/markets/pre-ipo-perpetuals.md); [Kraken](https://support.kraken.com/articles/pre-ipo-perpetual-futures-faq)).
- Binance Wallet's terms are labeled reported: Binance's own FAQ page could not be retrieved, so they rest on Bitcoin.com and CoinDesk ([Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/exchanges/binance-wallet-500m-anthropic-ipo-xstocks-token-sale/)). Dinari's voting claim is cited as Dinari's own.

# 2026-11-18: IOSCO 2026 report, senators' Innovation Exemption letter, DTCC-token financing stack, and settlement-design views
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-18-iosco-senators-dtcc-financing
last_checked: 2026-11-18

- IOSCO's 2026 monitoring report (FR/06/26) now replaces the 2025 report where the wiki describes how far tokenization has got. It calls tokenization "transitional and fragmented," separates "mirroring" tokens from tokens whose chain records ownership, and puts tokenized equities at about \$1.7B on 30 Jun 2026, citing RWA.xyz ([IOSCO](https://www.iosco.org/library/pubdocs/pdf/IOSCOPD832.pdf)). Updated: [[overview|Overview]], [[concepts/legal-taxonomy|Legal taxonomy]], [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|Corporate actions]], [[concepts/international|International]], [[topics/who-can-buy|Who can buy]].
- Four senators asked SEC Chairman Atkins 13 questions about the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], on AML/KYC, token-level transfer restrictions and issuer opt-outs, and urged notice-and-comment rulemaking ([letter](https://www.alsobrooks.senate.gov/news/press-releases/alsobrooks-leads-colleagues-in-pushing-sec-for-answers-transparency-on-tokenized-stock-change/)). SEC Trading and Markets Director Jamie Selway, speaking for himself, said a permanent rule proposal has "got to be a 2027 event" ([video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mwAidpXpJJ4&t=4255s)). Coin Center's comment letter is added to the comment file ([Coin Center](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1145899-4073428.pdf)).
- Talos, Marex and [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]] announced an RFQ, prime-brokerage and atomic-settlement workflow for financing DTCC-tokenized Treasuries beyond market hours; no go-live date was given ([Broadridge](https://www.broadridge.com/press-release/2026/broadridge-to-enable-institutional-trading-of-dtcc-tokenized-securities)). Updated: [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC Tokenization Service]], [[topics/settlement-and-matching|Settlement & matching]], [[comparisons/trading-venue-architectures|Trading venue architectures]].
- [[topics/settlement-and-matching|Settlement & matching]] adds Fed Governor Waller's view that net and batch settlement will stay useful alongside atomic settlement ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/waller20261117a.htm)), the SIFMA and Deloitte digital-cash white paper ([SIFMA and Deloitte](https://www.sifma.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Digital-Cash-White-Paper-SIFMA-and-Deloitte.pdf)), and the MAS and Bundesbank Project Simbolon cross-ledger PvP proof of concept ([MAS](https://www.mas.gov.sg/-/media/mas-media-library/development/fintech/project-simbolon/project-simbolon-insights-note.pdf)). [[topics/regulation|Regulation]] notes the CFTC's 15 Dec 2026 roundtable on 24/7 trading ([CFTC](https://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/9327-26)).
- [[issuers/superstate-opening-bell|Superstate]] records Invesco's IROXX, the first registered fund on FundOS, whose prospectus makes the token records plus an offchain identity register the official register ([IROXX prospectus, 485BPOS](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/205007/000110465926117813/tm2627770d1_485bpos.htm)), and Exposure on Solana, an announced design where only minting and burning are permissioned; no Exposure Token is live yet ([Superstate](https://superstate.com/newsroom/superstate-formation-and-corda-join-forces-to-launch-exposure-the-official-solana-rwa-launchpad)).
- Short items: [[standards/erc-3643|ERC-3643]] cross-chain compliance aligned with Swift standards ([ERC-3643 Association](https://www.erc3643.org/news/interoperable-compliance-for-on-chain-capital-markets-aligned-with-swift-standards)); HKMA and Swift on Project Ensemble ([HKMA](https://www.hkma.gov.hk/eng/news-and-media/press-releases/2026/11/20261116-4/)); [[issuers/wisdomtree|WisdomTree]] funds registered in Singapore ([Synthesys](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/synthesys-announces-collaboration-with-wisdomtree-following-registration-of-three-tokenized-funds-in-singapore-302940804.html)); Alpaca's own claim of more than \$10B in cumulative mint and redeem volume, not trading volume, noted on [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]] and [[comparisons/reported-trading-volume-by-venue|reported volumes]] ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-17-alpaca-says-tokenization-network-tops-10-billion-minting-redemption-volume-442667)); [[issuers/securitize|Securitize]]'s broker-dealer FINRA custody approval from its 10-Q ([Securitize 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2094496/000162828026073910/secz-20260930.htm)); a one-line CFTC DCM/DCO note on [[issuers/backpack|Backpack]] ([CFTC](https://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/9327-26)).
- [[issuers/securitize|Securitize]] completed its acquisition of River One, a New York asset-backed warehouse lender, its first acquisition since listing in July 2026 ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Completes-Acquisition-of-River-One-Expanding-Into-6-Trillion-Asset-Backed-Finance-Market/default.aspx)).

# 2026-11-16: Zelle demonstrates a $1.25 million ZelleUSD confidential transfer on Solana devnet
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-16-zelleusd-solana-breakpoint
last_checked: 2026-11-16

- On 16 Nov 2026 Zelle demonstrated a confidential transfer of $1.25 million in ZelleUSD (ZLUSD) on stage at Solana Breakpoint, between demo banks labeled Bank Alpha and Bank Beta. The official @solana video of the demo is marked "Solana devnet." This is a stablecoin cash-leg example, not a tokenized deposit or a tokenized security. ZelleUSD is issued for Zelle by Anchorage Digital Bank and is already minted on Solana; Anchorage's 30 Sep 2026 reserve report records 85,151 redeemable tokens outstanding and states that the Solana contract is 7NNkMtGACBbwJdMRYD2KchTKm2xBwnsb4bT7YSfRUWZ4. Zelle's 11 June 2026 release said India would be the first country where U.S. consumers can use Zelle to send money overseas, with initial availability expected before the end of 2026, but that release does not say the corridor uses ZelleUSD, and no launch date has been given ([Zelle release](https://www.zelle.com/press-releases/zelle-heads-to-india-unveils-zelleusdsm-stablecoin-other-markets), [Anchorage ZLUSD attestations](https://www.anchorage.com/platform/zlusd-reserve-attestations), [30 Sep 2026 ZLUSD Reserve Report](https://learn.anchorage.com/09.30.26_ZLUSD-Stablecoin-Attestation-Report-signed.pdf), [@solana](https://x.com/solana/status/2122284580405236216)).
- Updated: [[topics/settlement-and-matching|Settlement & matching]], [[concepts/international|International regimes]].

# 2026-11-16: Innovation Exemption comment letters, Ondo Off-Hours snapshot, B20 policy registry, and Cambodia bond PoC
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-16-sec-letters-ondo-offhours
last_checked: 2026-11-16

- Five later letters in the SEC Innovation Exemption comment file (4-927) are now recorded on the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] page. Securitize (12 Nov) asks the SEC to require permissioning in the token itself rather than only in a pool allowlist, with freeze, burn and reissue as the fallback, and also to permit PropAMMs, define "permissionless," and let issuers waive the 30-day wait ([Securitize](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-32/4927-1134705-4042498.pdf)). Chainlink Labs (11 Nov), a vendor of the services it discusses, proposes FAQs on comparable trade reports, corporate-action reconciliation and pricing data ([Chainlink Labs](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1133160-4036827.pdf)). Shadow SEC Statement No. 17 (filed 10 Nov; statement dated 19 Oct), by five securities-law scholars including former SEC General Counsel John C. Coates, argues that the order is a legislative rule that skipped APA notice and comment and will fragment liquidity ([Shadow SEC Statement No. 17](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1131060-4029687.pdf)). The American Securities Association (6 Nov) puts the opposing view, including offshore Covered Firm affiliates and cybersecurity as disclosure-only; hack figures in that letter are reported by TRM Labs, with ASA also citing CBS News as saying Chainalysis concurs in the attribution ([ASA](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1122019-3994146.pdf)). Matter Labs (4 Nov) asks that validity (zero-knowledge) proofs verified on a public chain be able to satisfy the public, permissionless ledger condition ([Matter Labs](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1121099-3989526.pdf)). The Securitize, Chainlink, Shadow SEC and Matter Labs letters are also noted on the related token-primitives, who-can-buy, venue-architecture, Securitize, corporate-actions, Chainlink, reference-architecture and regulation pages. Comment letters are advocacy, not law.
- [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo Stocks]] no longer describes Off-Hours trading only as covering "a select set of assets." A 16 Nov 2026 snapshot of Ondo's Off-Hours docs lists 32 enabled assets on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana, for weekend, holiday and early-close sessions, with instant mint and redeem and dynamic per-asset limits ([Ondo Off-Hours](https://docs.ondo.finance/ondo-stocks/off-hours-trading)). The same snapshot is noted on the settlement and reference-architecture pages. The list and limits can change.
- The [[concepts/token-primitives|token primitives]] page now records Base's B20 Policy Registry: policy scopes default to always-allow, one shared allowlist or blocklist can bind many tokens, and the events include seize, a freeze-style blocked burn, and pause. That design is contrasted with ERC-3643 and with Securitize's token-level permissioning ask ([Base updatePolicy](https://docs.base.org/specifications/b20/reference/interfaces/ib20/update-policy)). A short note is also on the [[issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks|Coinbase]] page.
- [[concepts/international|International regimes]] now includes Cambodia: on 13 Nov 2026 SBI Holdings said it had signed an MOU with the National Bank of Cambodia for a government bond tokenization proof of concept on Canton, with the central bank as registrar and small-unit retail holdings through local banks. This is an MOU for a PoC, not a live service ([SBI Holdings](https://www.sbigroup.co.jp/news/pdf/2026/1113_a.pdf)).

# 2026-11-16: DBS and Kinexys by J.P. Morgan launch 24/7 cross-border tokenized-deposit transfers
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-16-dbs-kinexys-tokenised-deposits
last_checked: 2026-11-16

- On 16 Nov 2026 DBS and Kinexys by J.P. Morgan launched a commercially ready interoperability solution for instant USD transfers between blockchain-based accounts in the United States and Singapore, including on weekends. This is the cash leg, not a tokenized security: it connects DBS Token Services with Kinexys's account-based permissioned tokenized-deposit network. The DBS release says the solution "leverages Partior for settlement orchestration," and that the two banks are founding shareholders of Partior. Ant International is the inaugural client. On-network transfers are described as 24/7/365; moving funds between traditional demand-deposit accounts and Blockchain Deposit Accounts still has a three-hour downtime every Saturday from 3–6 p.m. ET ([DBS release](https://www.dbs.com/newsroom/DBS_and_Kinexys_by_JP_Morgan_launch_industry_first_247_interoperability_solution_for_cross_border_tokenised_deposit_transfers)).
- Updated: [[topics/settlement-and-matching|Settlement & matching]], [[concepts/international|International regimes]].

# 2026-11-16: Coinbase and Broadridge propose an open standard for onchain shareholder communications
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-16-coinbase-broadridge-onchain-rights
last_checked: 2026-11-16

- On 16 Nov 2026 Coinbase and Broadridge published a jointly developed open technical standard, Onchain Rights, for delivering shareholder communications to wallets holding tokenized shares, and said they submitted it as an EIP for review. Broadridge also launched a data oracle that gives participating firms aggregate evidence of distribution. The standard's own docs say the specifications "communicate the action" and do not establish legal rights, calculate entitlement, determine eligibility, or submit votes; onchain voting is the next phase. As of 16 Nov 2026 the EIP texts and the canonical JSON schema were not yet published on the project's site ([Broadridge / PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/coinbase-and-broadridge-publish-proposed-standard-for-onchain-shareholder-communications-broadridge-launches-data-oracle-302939893.html); [Onchain Rights docs](https://www.onchainrights.org/docs)).
- Updated: [[infrastructure/broadridge|Broadridge]], [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|Corporate actions & dividends]], [[issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks|Coinbase tokenized stocks]], [[concepts/token-primitives|Token primitives]].

# 2026-11-14: DTCC Tokenization Service FAQs, DRS postponement, first named uses, and OKXICE context
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-14-dtcc-okxice-sources
last_checked: 2026-11-14

- DTCC's Tokenization Service FAQs are now recorded on the [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC Tokenization Service]] page: the DTC Digital Omnibus Account, Participant-only conversion orders and wallet registration, inter-network burn-and-mint during conversion hours, ComposerX LedgerScan, a free-of-value cash leg, destokenization before unsupported corporate-action record dates, and claw-back or force-transfer if a token is lost or stolen ([DTCC FAQs](https://www.dtcc.com/products-and-services/digital-assets/tokenization/hub)). The FAQs still name only Canton and Hyperledger Besu as live networks and say additional networks are expected in 2027; they do not overwrite the 12 Nov 2026 plan to connect the service to Solana in the second half of 2027. A 12 Aug 2026 DTCC framework describes how it evaluates Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks and does not name specific chains ([DTCC](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/evaluation-framework-l1-l2-blockchain-networks.pdf/8e9c53b2965e11f19a98ca3087bcb34c)).
- DTC Important Notice B#25240-26, dated 6 Nov 2026, postponed the November 2026 DRS modernization go-live. Subject to regulatory approval, DTC expects to implement no later than 30 Jun 2027, and will announce the specific date in a later notice. The notice does not say the SEC has approved SR-DTC-2026-012 ([DTC notice](https://files.dtcc.com/download/assets/25240-26/306b2894da2f11f192c2a2d2c72ada28)). The same timeline is updated on the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]] page.
- After go-live, Morgan Stanley said it is among the first banks to tokenize US equities and Treasuries through the service ([Morgan Stanley on X](https://x.com/MorganStanley/status/2117727271377125454)). The Block reported that the firm expects to support tokenized equities on its alternative trading system in the first quarter of 2027, later than its previous H2 2026 target; that ATS date is The Block's reporting ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-11-04-morgan-stanley-among-first-banks-to-tokenize-us-equities-treasurys-through-dtccs-service-432633)). Société Générale described accepting \$10 million of tokenized US Treasuries as collateral on Canton from the service's soft launch ([Société Générale](https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/fileadmin/user_upload/groupe_AMER/pdf/Societe_Generale_Completes_Tokenized_US_Treasury_Collateral_Transaction_on_Canton.pdf)). Alpaca described July trial activity tokenizing SPY and CRCL on Canton and Besu ([Alpaca](https://alpaca.markets/blog/alpaca-joins-launch-of-dtcc-tokenization-service/)). Those named uses are the companies' own claims.
- On [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]], Applied Optoelectronics is recorded as the one issuer in this record to have given an on-the-record objection reason, via a spokesperson quote in Fortune; the page keeps the official 5 Nov notice count of 67 objectors and does not adopt Fortune's counts ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/11/05/apple-home-depot-list-objectors-tokenized-stock-plan-nyse-owner/)). ICE's 5 Mar 2026 minority investment in OKX, at a stated \$25 billion valuation with an ICE board seat, is now noted as distinct from the 50/50 OKXICE LLC joint venture and from NYSE's separate tokenized-equities platform ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/ICE-Makes-Investment-in-OKX-Establishing-Strategic-Relationship/)). Securitize's already-ingested 13 Nov article is cross-cited for its claim that Convertible Entitlement Tokens are the mechanism supporting the OKXICE launch ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)).

# 2026-11-13: Securitize describes TSV APIs, dual CET wording, and Formation support
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-13-securitize-tsv-apis
last_checked: 2026-11-13

- A 13 Nov 2026 article on Securitize's Medium publication describes APIs that [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] operators can integrate for investor onboarding and permissioning (SecId), market-maker inventory (CET Underlying), and corporate actions, and points to current developer documentation at [developers.securitize.io](https://developers.securitize.io) ([Securitize](https://medium.com/securitize/the-tsv-stack-you-bring-execution-and-liquidity-we-bring-the-stock-b2cb64c744ed)). The same site also documents a Stocks API. The Corporate Actions API and the Stocks API are labelled Beta in the current docs; the Corporate Actions API is in development and subject to change before 1.0.0, and the Stocks API's paths, fields and errors can change before release.
- In that article, CET is used both as a custodial entitlement token and, at Securitize, as a convertible entitlement token. Minting and burning of inventory happen through Securitize, outside the venue. On supported EVM deployments the article describes display multipliers based on ERC-8056 for splits, and Scaled UI Amount on Solana.
- Securitize says this is the mechanism it is using to support the [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]] launch, and the same infrastructure it is leveraging in its work supporting [[platforms-venues/formation-securities|Formation's TSV]], including for stocks and ETFs. The stocks-and-ETFs wording is Securitize's; Formation's official 9 Nov 2026 notice still names only FWDI, GLXY and EXOD and does not mention ETFs.
- The article's 30-day notice discussion is recorded with its own caveat: the SEC expects a venue to be operationally ready when the notice is published, so the notice period is not the build window.

# 2026-11-13: NYSE Avalanche interviews — Blaugrund on planned features, Ava Labs claims on testing and a dedicated L1
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-13-nyse-avalanche-interviews
last_checked: 2026-11-13

- An Avalanche Originals interview with Michael Blaugrund of the New York Stock Exchange, uploaded 9 Nov 2026, is now on the [[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#settlement-ledger-avalanche|NYSE / ICE tokenized securities]] page, using Avalanche's official transcript. Blaugrund described Pillar as NYSE's matching system, said post-trade still runs on mainframes, and said the planned platform is meant to allow 24/7 trading, fractional share orders, dollar-denominated orders, settlement versus stablecoin, and immediate reuse of sale proceeds ([Avalanche Originals](https://www.avalanche.com/originals/the-invisible-layer-of-global-financial-infrastructure/)).
- Dennis Lee's line about "picking the right technology for each job" is now also on that page, from his 9 Nov statement ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/09/nyse-picks-avalanche-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-amid-wall-street-s-blockchain-race)). John Nahas of Ava Labs said NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche ([Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/interview/ava-labs-nyse-general-purpose-chains), 10 Nov; also to [Paul Barron](https://www.paulbarronnetwork.com/network-update/nyse-chooses-avalanche-for-tokenized-equities-interview-ava-labs-john-nahas), 9 Nov). That duration is Ava Labs' account; NYSE has not published a testing timeline.
- Nahas also told Paul Barron that "exclusivity" means NYSE is building its own Avalanche layer-1 as the backbone of the 24/7 ATS, and described a general AVAX burn per L1 validator while declining NYSE-specific token operations. Official NYSE and ICE materials do not say that, and Avalanche's own [NYSE page](https://www.avalanche.com/nyse/) defines an L1 only in general. Those points are attributed to Ava Labs. No launch date was added; Nahas left timing to NYSE and its regulators.
- The split-layer example in [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]] now cites Blaugrund for Pillar and attributes the dedicated-L1 description to Ava Labs. The catalog one-liner, which had been cut off at "Sep", is completed.

# 2026-11-13: Transfer-agent comments, in-kind redemption, new jurisdictions, and catalog updates
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-13-friday-ingestion
last_checked: 2026-11-13

- Metrika's 3 Nov 2026 comment letter on the SEC transfer agent proposal (File S7-2026-30) is now recorded on the [[topics/regulation|regulation]], [[topics/custody|custody]] and [[build/trading-reference-architecture|reference architecture]] pages. It addresses keeping the master securityholder file on a public chain the transfer agent does not control. Comment letters are advocacy, not law. Network-incident figures in the letter are Metrika's monitoring data ([Metrika letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1119921-3984266.pdf)).
- [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo]] describes an institutional in-kind conversion through Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network that returns shares rather than cash, alongside the existing USDon/USDC mint and redeem path, and a planned Spout covered-call lending use of that route when Spout launches on Solana ([Ondo](https://ondo.finance/blog/ondo-stocks-as-collateral-on-spout)).
- New jurisdiction entries: Bermuda, where the Bermuda Monetary Authority intends to amend existing laws for asset tokenisation rather than create a separate regime ([stakeholder letter](https://www.bma.bm/viewPDF/documents/2026-11-06-14-04-05-Stakeholder-Letter---Feedback-on-the-Consultation-Paper-on-Asset-Tokenisation.pdf), 6 Nov 2026); and Japan, where the FSA's FY2026 study group is an agenda under an on-chain finance forum, not yet rules ([FSA deck](https://www.fsa.go.jp/singi/digital_2026/shiryo/261020/jimukyoku.pdf)). Ireland's November 2026 Feedback Statement to Discussion Paper 12 is noted in one line under the EU section ([Central Bank of Ireland](https://www.centralbank.ie/docs/default-source/publications/discussion-papers/discussion-paper-12/feedback-statement-discussion-paper12.pdf?sfvrsn=b6b0741a_16)).
- The [[infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot|DTCC Tokenization Service]] is planned to connect with Solana, with DTC-tokenized assets expected there in the second half of 2027 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-to-connect-with-solana)).
- Securitize and Ethena Labs launched a 24/7 liquidity facility for BlackRock's BUIDL, with \$50 million of initial inventory and a stated maximum capacity of \$100 million ([Securitize](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-and-Ethena-Launch-100-Million-Liquidity-Facility-for-BlackRocks-BUIDL/default.aspx)). This is a fund, not a stock token.
- [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]] now records a native OP Mainnet deployment of its catalog and a 11 Nov 2026 Payward release stating that all 40 DAX constituents are tokenized and available on 360X, a Deutsche Börse company, along with Xetra-Gold. Catalog and volume figures are quoted with each source's date, because the 11 Nov Payward releases and the 12 Nov 2026 Optimism blog give different counts ([Optimism](https://optimism.io/blog/xstocks-native-op-mainnet-ether-fi-launch), [Payward](https://www.payward.com/press-release/xstocks-dax-40)).
- [[issuers/securitize|Securitize Stocks]] is now 25 equities, after a 2 Nov 2026 second wave of 13 names on Solana ([Securitize, 2 Nov 2026](https://investors.securitize.io/news/news-details/2026/Securitize-Expands-Onchain-U-S--Stock-Offering-to-25-Equities/default.aspx)).
- [[infrastructure/tzero|tZERO]] reports CFTC approval of tZERO DCM, LLC as a Designated Contract Market on 11 Nov 2026, following tZERO DCO, LLC's 16 Oct 2026 registration. This is a derivatives-market registration, not a tokenized-securities product launch ([tZERO](https://www.tzero.com/news/tzero-receives-cftc-approval-to-operate-regulated-derivatives-exchange-and-achieves-first-earn)).

# 2026-11-13: Alpaca CEO describes a planned prime brokerage business and a mid-October SPV-wrapped market-size estimate
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-13-alpaca-prime-brokerage
last_checked: 2026-11-13

- In a 15 Oct 2026 interview on NYSE Live, Alpaca's co-founder and CEO, Yoshi Yokokawa — not NYSE staff — said the firm planned to launch a prime brokerage business "next year" (the host's wording; the interview date implies 2027) to support market-maker liquidity with financing, margin, and multiple asset classes. That is a plan described in the interview, not a launch. The same interview is now noted on the [[build/trading-reference-architecture#primary-market-mint-and-redeem-broker-custodied-model|ITN mint and redeem]] section and on [[topics/custody|Custody]] for his description of Alpaca's clearing and custody role, including a clearing-broker license and DTC membership as Alpaca's own account ([NYSE Live](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c8VAgn88uqs)).
- Yokokawa also put US equities tokenized as SPV-wrapped tokens at about \$3.5B, against an approximately \$86T US equity market cap, which he said was less than one basis point. That is his estimate as of mid-October 2026, not a verified market figure, and it sits alongside Bitquery's 31 Oct \$3.2B third-party estimate on [[topics/who-can-buy|Who can buy]].

# 2026-11-11: OKXICE TSV announced launch beginning 23 November
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-11-okxice-nov-23-launch
last_checked: 2026-11-11

- [[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE TSV]]: OKX announced that trading for eligible U.S. customers is due to begin on 23 November 2026, with more than 70 assets expected to be listed, including 59 Direxion ETFs, Strategy common and preferred shares, Better.com, and Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood, BitGo and Securitize (the last six are on the 4 Oct list and were not among the 67 objectors on the 5 Nov notice). Securitize is named as the tokenizer; tokens are described as security entitlements backed 1:1, held in self-custodial wallets, on Uniswap v4 pools on X Layer. Access is limited to eligible U.S. OKX Inc. customers with a CeDeFi Wallet, identity verification and OKXICE onboarding ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/en-us/learn/okxice-tsv-launch)). A spokesperson said not all assets will be available at the start ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/10/okxice-to-debut-tokenized-stock-trading-with-strategy-coinbase-circle-this-month)). CoinDesk's 56-of-62 objector tally differs from the notice's 67; CoinDesk's "second venue after TSV LLC" claim is attributed to CoinDesk.

# 2026-11-10: Implementations table now says what a holder can redeem into
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-10-redeem-into-column
last_checked: 2026-11-10

- The [[comparisons/implementations-by-model|implementations compared by model]] table now includes a "What can you redeem into?" column, sourced from issuer docs (and, where this pass did not re-open those docs, from existing vault pages).
- [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]]: after KYC, redeem with the issuer for USDC, USDG or USDT ($5,000 minimum stated for direct issuer flow) or in-kind shares into an Alpaca brokerage account via xPort ([FAQ](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/frequently-asked-questions); [Market Flow](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/market-flow); [xPort](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/issuance-and-redemption/in-kind-flow-xport)).
- [[issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens|Robinhood Stock Tokens]] (Jersey): cash only; the prospectus excludes physical delivery of the underlying ([base prospectus, 25 June 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf)). EU Classic Stock Tokens are a separate product: sell back to Robinhood Europe in the app for EUR; they cannot be redeemed for shares ([KID, 1 July 2026](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/stock_tokens_kid_eu.pdf); [EU FAQ](https://robinhood.com/eu/en/support/articles/stock-tokens-faq/)).
- [[issuers/dinari|Dinari dShares]]: sell or burn for payment tokens (stablecoin proceeds); the custodian sells the share. No in-kind delivery found in issuer docs ([placing orders](https://docs.dinari.com/docs/placing-orders); [dShares](https://dinari.com/dshares)).
- [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo Stocks]] already recorded the same point: redeem with Ondo for USDon or USDC; notes, not title to the share.

URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-10-ondo-stocks-page-update
last_checked: 2026-11-10

# 2026-11-09: NYSE picks Avalanche as the settlement ledger for its planned tokenized platform
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-09-nyse-avalanche-settlement-ledger
last_checked: 2026-11-09

- NYSE and Ava Labs said Avalanche will provide the core ledger technology for the clearing firm on the NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform, which still needs regulatory approval ([NYSE on X](https://x.com/NYSE/status/2119812983224213903); [Ava Labs](https://www.avalanche.com/about/blog/wall-streets-next-chapter-is-being-built-on-avalanche)). Stocks may be issued on several chains, and matching stays on NYSE's existing Pillar engine (news reports: [The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-09-nyse-settle-tokenized-stocks-avalanche-planned-24-7-market-436208); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/09/nyse-picks-avalanche-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-amid-wall-street-s-blockchain-race)). The Wall Street Journal reports a fourth-quarter launch target without stating the year.
- WSJ detail: Avalanche is the only settlement chain (issuance still multi-chain); NYSE picked it after testing several providers for speed, throughput and a permissioned network that meets compliance rules ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/finance/regulation/nyse-to-settle-tokenized-stocks-on-avalanche-blockchain-038ce412)).
- Updated: [[platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform#settlement-ledger-avalanche|NYSE / ICE tokenized securities]] (chains now settlement ledger Avalanche, issuance multi-chain) and a split-layer example in [[build/trading-reference-architecture#how-venues-match-and-settle|How venues match and settle]].

# 2026-11-05: Nasdaq, Coinbase and Fairmint comment on the SEC's transfer agent proposal
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-05-transfer-agent-comment-letters
last_checked: 2026-11-05

- Comment letters on the SEC's proposed transfer agent rules (File S7-2026-30) pull in different directions: Nasdaq asks for interoperable onchain and offchain master files and fungibility at the recordkeeping layer ([Nasdaq](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1122619-3995826.pdf)); Coinbase asks that holders be identifiable by wallet address without a mandatory name and mailing address ([Coinbase](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1119719-3983946.pdf)); Fairmint proposes per-venue co-transfer agents and a functional test of "exclusive control" ([Fairmint](https://www.sec.gov/comments/S7-2026-30/s7202630-1120639-3987647.pdf)).
- These are advocacy, not law. See [[topics/regulation|Regulation]] and [[build/trading-reference-architecture#proposed-by-fairmint-not-current-law-or-production|Proposed by Fairmint, not current law or production]].
