# 2026-11-04: First tokenized CNTN trades on TSV LLC
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-04-first-tokenized-cntn-trades-tsv
last_checked: 2026-11-04

- Canton Strategic Holdings (Nasdaq: CNTN) announced the first trades of its issuer-sponsored tokenized common stock on TSV LLC, in a permissioned pool on the Tradecraft AMM, settled atomically on Canton. Five North (seller) moved its position from a broker-dealer account onto the company's onchain register; DRW Cumberland bought; Flowdesk provided liquidity. Size and price were not disclosed ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- Fairmint TA LLC, the company's SEC-registered transfer agent, keeps the official onchain record and the allow list of verified holders and wallets ([CNTN release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-trades-of-tokenized-us-equity-under-sec-innovation-exemption-executed-on-the-canton-network-302929795.html)).
- Updated: [[platforms-venues/tsv-llc|TSV LLC]]. New page: [[infrastructure/fairmint|Fairmint]]. Worked example: [[build/trading-reference-architecture#issuer-sponsored-register-permissions-and-recovery|Issuer-sponsored register]].

# 2026-11-02: Australia's central bank consults on settling tokenised assets

- Australia added as a jurisdiction (no securities rule collected). The Reserve Bank of Australia's consultation (3 Sep to 30 Oct 2026) sets out ways to link token platforms to its RITS settlement system for delivery versus payment, without choosing one ([RBA](https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/tokenised-money/the-role-of-rits-in-supporting-settlement-in-a-tokenised-ecosystem/pdf/the-role-of-rits-in-supporting-settlement-in-a-tokenised-ecosystem.pdf)). # 2026-11-02: South Korea's tokenized securities regime added
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-11-02-korea-tokenized-securities-rules
description: holders: Korea will treat security tokens as securities from 4 Feb 2027, starting with institutional funds and bonds and some fractional products, with a…
last_checked: 2026-11-02

holders: Korea will treat security tokens as securities from 4 Feb 2027, starting with institutional funds and bonds and some fractional products, with a KRW100m yearly cap for retail buyers on each OTC exchange.

- South Korea added as a jurisdiction. The FSC's roadmap (4 Sep 2026) sets three phases from Feb 2027 ([FSC](https://fsc.go.kr/eng/pr010101/87653)); its draft rules (1 Oct 2026, comments to 11 Nov) cover shared ledgers with KSD, issuer account managers and retail caps ([FSC](https://fsc.go.kr/eng/pr010101/87834)). See [[concepts/international|International regimes]], [[topics/rules-by-jurisdiction|Rules by jurisdiction]] and [[topics/regulation|Regulation]].

# 2026-10-31: IMF publishes the first official data on tokenized-stock trading
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-10-31-imf-gfsr-scaling-tokenization
description: holders: Tokenized stocks track the real share closely, but more than half of trading happens while US markets are closed, so prices can move before the…
last_checked: 2026-10-31

holders: Tokenized stocks track the real share closely, but more than half of trading happens while US markets are closed, so prices can move before the market opens.

- The IMF's October 2026 Global Financial Stability Report (ch. 3) puts public tokenized assets, not counting repo, at about \$65B and tokenized stocks at about \$2.3B, with Ondo and xStocks over 70% of that. About 80% of tokenized-stock trades are smaller than one share. The IMF calls the risks to the system limited for now ([IMF GFSR Oct 2026, ch. 3](https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/publications/gfsr/2026/october/english/ch3.pdf)). See [[overview|Overview]].

# 2026-10-31: Bank of England consults on tokenised collateral at clearing houses
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-10-31-boe-tokenised-collateral-ccps
description: holders: No direct change for token holders yet; it could make tokenised bonds and funds more usable as margin in UK clearing over time.
last_checked: 2026-10-31

holders: No direct change for token holders yet; it could make tokenised bonds and funds more usable as margin in UK clearing over time.

- On 29 Oct 2026 the Bank of England consulted on what it expects from UK clearing houses (CCPs) that want to accept tokenised versions of collateral they can already take. It says current rules are no barrier and proposes no new regime; responses close 12 Feb 2027 ([Bank of England CP](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/paper/2026/cp/supervisory-expectations-for-ccps-seeking-to-accept-tokenised-collateral)). # 2026-10-30: First supportive comment letters on the Innovation Exemption
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-10-30-comment-letters-solana-malinova-park
last_checked: 2026-10-30

- Solana Policy Institute (22 Oct 2026) backs the order and asks the SEC to define "public, permissionless distributed ledger" by who controls ordering, validation, finality and rule changes ([Solana Policy Institute](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1106380-3893468.pdf)).
- Academics Katya Malinova and Andreas Park (23 Oct 2026) say the volume caps block the arbitrage that keeps token prices in line and raise trading costs; they ask for the caps to be removed or set per stock ([Malinova and Park](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1107499-3908312.pdf)).
- DeFi Education Fund (16 Oct 2026) welcomes the order and asks for safe harbors for decentralized exchange developers ([DeFi Education Fund](https://www.sec.gov/comments/4-927/4927-1096319-3852226.pdf)).
- Updated: [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], glossary (Public, permissionless ledger).

# 2026-10-29: OKXICE objections reach 38; how issuer opt-outs work; Better Markets letter
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-10-29-okxice-38-objectors-opt-out
last_checked: 2026-10-29

- OKXICE TSV: 38 issuers have objected as of its 28 Oct notice, up from 22 on 23 Oct; new names include JPMorgan, AMD, Coca-Cola, Dell, Eli Lilly and Walmart. Still no trading start date ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.28.pdf)).
- Innovation Exemption: issuers have 30 calendar days from a venue's notice to object, directly to that venue; opt-outs are per venue with no blanket option. Nasdaq says it intends to opt itself out of TSVs ([Nasdaq FAQ](https://www.nasdaq.com/docs/listings/faq-sec-innovation-exemption)).
- Comment file 4-927: Better Markets calls the order the biggest rewrite of equity trading rules since Reg NMS and urges the SEC to withdraw it and use notice-and-comment rulemaking ([Better Markets](https://bettermarkets.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Better-Markets-Comment-Letter-SEC-Innovation-Exemption.pdf)).

- Day 1 scope: 34 securities, 1:1 backed by DTC holdings, conversions 2 a.m.-6 p.m. ET business days targeting 15 minutes or less, 24/7 transfers between registered wallets ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)).

# 2026-09-17: SEC issues the Innovation Exemption for tokenized NMS stock
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-09-17-sec-innovation-exemption
last_checked: 2026-09-17

- The SEC issued an order (Rel. 34-106402) exempting Tokenized Securities Venues from the exchange definition and certain liquidity providers from the dealer definition; it expires five years after publication ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-90-sec-issues-innovation-exemption-facilitate-trading-tokenized-nms-stock-request-comment)).
- Published at 91 FR 60168 on 22 Sep 2026; comments go to File 4-927 ([Federal Register](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/09/22/2026-19388/order-granting-temporary-conditional-exemptive-relief-pursuant-to-section-36a1-of-the-securities)).
